## Setting up Air

> Source: https://docs.athelas.com/air_onboard/getting_started_with_air/set_up.md

# Setting up Air

Welcome to Air, your simple and powerful way to manage patients, schedules, and operations in one place.

### <Icon icon="laptop" iconType="duotone" color="#F9345F" size={23} />  Log-in to Air

<Card title=" ">
  Air by Athelas can be accessed through the [**Insights page.**](https://insights.athelas.com/v2/login?redirect_to=/my_account)

  * **Login credentials** are created and managed by your site administrators. Please contact your admin to get started.
  * For additional help, reach out to our support team at [**support@getathelas.com**](mailto:support@getathelas.com).

      <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/6hQzJrk7rDj1b_aq/images/air_onboard/getting_started_with_air/set_up/set_up_2.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=6hQzJrk7rDj1b_aq&q=85&s=a6eac359f00f642303170f519ea4214e" alt="Login Web" width="2048" height="1109" data-path="images/air_onboard/getting_started_with_air/set_up/set_up_2.webp" />
</Card>

### <Icon icon="circle-dot" iconType="duotone" color="#F9345F" size={23} />  Overview of Air

<Card title=" ">
  Once logged in, you can access both **Air (EHR)** and **Insights (RCM platform)** from the same site.

  <Danger>
    ✨**Smart Tip:**  Use **Cmd + K** (Mac) or **Ctrl + K** (PC) to open the search function. You can quickly search by patient name, provider, or section.
  </Danger>

  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/6hQzJrk7rDj1b_aq/images/air_onboard/getting_started_with_air/set_up/set_up_2.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=6hQzJrk7rDj1b_aq&q=85&s=a6eac359f00f642303170f519ea4214e" alt="Overview Web" width="2048" height="1109" data-path="images/air_onboard/getting_started_with_air/set_up/set_up_2.webp" />

  **Key Tabs within Air**

  * **Calendar** *(all users)* – View the schedule by provider or facility.
  * **Patients** *(all users)* – Access patient demographics, appointments, attachments, and more.
  * **Inbox** *(providers)* – Manage open notes.
  * **Preferences** *(company admins)* – Configure site-wide settings such as default calendar times and alerts.
  * **Interventions** *(company admins)* – Manage the library of interventions and intervention groups.

  Additional sections include Insights (Performance Analysis, Reports, etc.), Utilities (Faxes, Messages, Lead Tracker, Templates, etc) and Automations (Patient Workflows, etc.).
</Card>

## Notifications Center

> Source: https://docs.athelas.com/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/insights_notifications.md

# Notifications Center

The Air Notifications Center is the central location for all notifications from sources like patient channels, messages, tasks, and medications. It is located at the bottom of the sidebar and is visible from every Insights page.

The Notifications Center shows a count of all unread messages and tasks, clearly surfacing any important action items that need your attention. Clicking the **Notifications** button displays a popup with all notifications.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP/images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/insights_notifications/insights_notifications_1.gif?s=758c324ee4ce468ee06eec13ddb6c5c1" alt="Notifications Center in sidebar" width="800" height="402" data-path="images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/insights_notifications/insights_notifications_1.gif" />

## Messages in the Notifications Center

From the Notifications Center, you can view a preview of any unread messages.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP/images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/insights_notifications/insights_notifications_2.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP&q=85&s=6a4b15b3b6292ff1f02afff8c560f1b6" alt="Message preview in Notifications Center" width="576" height="613" data-path="images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/insights_notifications/insights_notifications_2.webp" />

Clicking **View** on the message takes you directly to the message in the **Messages** tab.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP/images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/insights_notifications/insights_notifications_3.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP&q=85&s=95d69d4dd3fd3d9a5bee82eca6c956a1" alt="View message in Messages tab" width="1220" height="844" data-path="images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/insights_notifications/insights_notifications_3.webp" />

## Tasks in the Notifications Center

From the Notifications popup, you can also view any tasks assigned to you. Clicking **View** on the task takes you to **My Tasks** in the **Tasks** tab.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP/images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/insights_notifications/insights_notifications_4.gif?s=42f9308d61e5d8730ae95997793cd058" alt="Tasks in Notifications Center" width="800" height="402" data-path="images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/insights_notifications/insights_notifications_4.gif" />

## Patient Channels

Insights supports patient-level notes called **Patient Channels** that staff can use to communicate about a patient's profile and share information outside of visit notes or appointment notes. Patient Channels consist of: **EHR notes**, **Insights notes**, and **Universal notes**.

### <Icon icon="notes-medical" iconType="duotone" color="#F9345F" size={23} />  EHR Notes

A patient's EHR notes can be accessed by clicking the notes icon in the top right corner of any patient profile page — for example, **Demographics**, **Appointments**, or **Medications**. You can tag other users in messages or attach documents. Any messages posted in EHR notes are visible across all other patient pages by other users.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP/images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/insights_notifications/insights_notifications_5.gif?s=34a724d5d984eb51c8805ac3aadd5b14" alt="EHR notes across patient pages" width="800" height="402" data-path="images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/insights_notifications/insights_notifications_5.gif" />

### <Icon icon="dollar-sign" iconType="duotone" color="#F9345F" size={23} />  Insights Notes

Insights notes are patient-level notes accessed from Insights pages like **Patient Responsibility**, **Claim Details**, or **Encounter Details**. Each of these patient-level pages is kept separate to avoid crossing communication lines for different activities or personas.

### <Icon icon="globe" iconType="duotone" color="#F9345F" size={23} />  Universal Notes

In any patient-level note, you can toggle the globe icon to create a **Universal Note**. Universal Notes appear across EHR notes and all Insights notes.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP/images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/insights_notifications/insights_notifications_6.gif?s=e771c840e2b1b91c6ff2223120aff865" alt="Universal note toggle" width="800" height="402" data-path="images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/insights_notifications/insights_notifications_6.gif" />

### Accessing Patient Channels

Patient Channels can also be accessed through **Messages**, in the **Patient Channels** tab. From here, you can see all Patient Channels, including any EHR or Universal notes. You can send EHR notes or Universal notes directly from this view.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP/images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/insights_notifications/insights_notifications_7.gif?s=9c9bd3f07ce840a68fe757d044afac72" alt="Patient Channels accessed from Messages" width="800" height="402" data-path="images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/insights_notifications/insights_notifications_7.gif" />

From Patient Channels, you can navigate to the patient's **Appointments** page by clicking the patient's name, or immediately view the patient's **appointments**, **cases**, **insurance**, or **prior authorizations** in the same window by clicking the icons in the top right.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP/images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/insights_notifications/insights_notifications_8.gif?s=716c4755587583258eaa83b0b3e09e2d" alt="Patient Channels quick-view icons" width="800" height="402" data-path="images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/insights_notifications/insights_notifications_8.gif" />

### FAQ

<Accordion title="Where is the Notifications Center located?">
  It lives at the bottom of the sidebar and is visible from every Insights page. The badge count reflects unread messages and pending tasks combined.
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="What's the difference between an EHR note, an Insights note, and a Universal note?">
  **EHR notes** live on patient profile pages (Demographics, Appointments, Medications) and are visible to clinical staff across those EHR pages. **Insights notes** live on Insights-side pages (Patient Responsibility, Claim Details, Encounter Details), scoped to billing/RCM work. **Universal notes** are the cross-cutting variant — toggle the globe icon on any patient-level note and it appears in both EHR and Insights contexts.
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="Can I tag other users in a Patient Channel note?">
  Yes. Both EHR notes and Universal notes support tagging users and attaching documents. Tagged users receive a notification in the Notifications Center.
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="Is there a way to see all patient notes without opening each profile?">
  Yes — open **Messages** and switch to the **Patient Channels** tab. You can browse every patient channel from there, and send new EHR or Universal notes inline.
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="Why do I still see a notification count when I've read the messages?">
  The badge reflects unread messages **and** unfinished tasks. If the count persists after reading messages, check the Tasks section of the popup for pending items.
</Accordion>

# Troubleshooting

Get help fast with Athelas AI and our user guides.

## View your Patient's Information

> Source: https://docs.athelas.com/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_info.md

# View your Patient's Information

Once you check in a patient, you can view past visit summaries and detailed patient information.

### <Icon icon="note" iconType="duotone" color="#F9345F" size={23} />  View a Summary of Past Visits

**AI-Generated Summary**

<Card title=" ">
  <Danger>
    ✨**Smart Tip:** Scroll through the *Subjective* section of the Chart Note to review an AI-generated summary of previous appointments.
  </Danger>

  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/GiW28T6RvbTPtLoc/images/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_info/patient_info_3.gif?s=275cc0cfde56ef1dac05a88ea43942e7" alt="19 Ai Summary2 Gi" width="1920" height="1016" data-path="images/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_info/patient_info_3.gif" />
</Card>

<Accordion title="Alternate method: Review past visit Chart Notes">
  * Open **Chart Notes**.
  * Click on the **Appointments** tab at the top.
  * Click on the **square icon** (to the right of the calendar icon) to open the Chart Note for the desired appointment.

  **Note**: From this page, you can also view past [Billing and Plan of Care](https://air_athelas.mintlify.app/patient_details/patient_appts#preview-past-billing-and-plan-of-care-documents) documents by clicking on the "eye" icon to the left of the date.

  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/GiW28T6RvbTPtLoc/images/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_info/patient_info_1.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=GiW28T6RvbTPtLoc&q=85&s=2b014e7bf2cb0cdf15cc5ad3b2d365f2" alt="Pt Appt Past Web" width="331" height="195" data-path="images/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_info/patient_info_1.webp" />
</Accordion>

### <Icon icon="image-user" iconType="duotone" color="#F9345F" size={23} />  Review Patient Details

**Ask Athelas AI**

<Card title=" ">
  <Danger>
    ✨**Smart Tip:** Use Athelas AI to ask targeted questions about the patient for quick insights. You can also use Voice Mode.
  </Danger>

  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/GiW28T6RvbTPtLoc/images/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_info/patient_info_3.gif?s=275cc0cfde56ef1dac05a88ea43942e7" alt="3 Ptinfo Gi" width="1920" height="1016" data-path="images/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_info/patient_info_3.gif" />
</Card>

**Open Patient Information Tabs**

<Card title=" ">
  <Danger>
    ✨**Smart Tip:** Ask Athelas AI to navigate you to the relevant Patient Profile or Chart Note. You can also use Voice Mode.
  </Danger>

  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/GiW28T6RvbTPtLoc/images/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_info/patient_info_3.gif?s=275cc0cfde56ef1dac05a88ea43942e7" alt="4 Nav Ptpage Gi" width="1920" height="1016" data-path="images/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_info/patient_info_3.gif" />

  Use the tabs at the top of the Chart Note to navigate patient information, including:

  * [Patient Demographics](/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_demog)
  * [Patient Appointment Details](/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_appts)
  * [Patient Documents](/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_attachments) (including faxes and images)
  * Tasks, Medications, Allergies, Visits, Immunizations and Labs

      <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/GiW28T6RvbTPtLoc/images/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_info/patient_info_1.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=GiW28T6RvbTPtLoc&q=85&s=2b014e7bf2cb0cdf15cc5ad3b2d365f2" alt="Patient Info Chart Notes Web" width="331" height="195" data-path="images/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_info/patient_info_1.webp" />

  <Accordion title="Alternate method: Open Patient Profile">
    **Note**: Use Athelas AI to navigate to the Patient Profile

    Click on the **Patient** tab in the left menu → Search and select your patient by entering their details.

    <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/GiW28T6RvbTPtLoc/images/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_info/patient_info_1.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=GiW28T6RvbTPtLoc&q=85&s=2b014e7bf2cb0cdf15cc5ad3b2d365f2" alt="Pt Tab Web" width="331" height="195" data-path="images/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_info/patient_info_1.webp" />

    This opens the patient’s full profile for review.

    <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/GiW28T6RvbTPtLoc/images/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_info/patient_info_1.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=GiW28T6RvbTPtLoc&q=85&s=2b014e7bf2cb0cdf15cc5ad3b2d365f2" alt="Pt Appt Past Web" width="331" height="195" data-path="images/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_info/patient_info_1.webp" />
  </Accordion>
</Card>

### Add Patient Notes

<Card title>
  There are 3 types of notes:

  **1. Appointment Notes**

  View Calendar > Click on an appointment > Edit appointment to enter any notes.

  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/GiW28T6RvbTPtLoc/images/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_info/patient_info_1.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=GiW28T6RvbTPtLoc&q=85&s=2b014e7bf2cb0cdf15cc5ad3b2d365f2" alt="New Appt Web" title="New Appt Web" style={{ width:"51%" }} width="331" height="195" data-path="images/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_info/patient_info_1.webp" />

  These notes can be seen in i) appointment details, ii) the calendar tooltip.

  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/GiW28T6RvbTPtLoc/images/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_info/patient_info_1.jpeg?fit=max&auto=format&n=GiW28T6RvbTPtLoc&q=85&s=4e56ac556a2b28a792bb93db52bdfa12" alt="Appt Notes2 Jpe" title="Appt Notes2 Jpe" style={{ width:"69%" }} width="862" height="638" data-path="images/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_info/patient_info_1.jpeg" />

  **2. Case Notes**

  View Patient Profile > Patient Demographics > Edit Active Cases to enter any case specific notes.

  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/GiW28T6RvbTPtLoc/images/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_info/patient_info_1.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=GiW28T6RvbTPtLoc&q=85&s=2b014e7bf2cb0cdf15cc5ad3b2d365f2" alt="Update Case Owner Prov Web" width="331" height="195" data-path="images/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_info/patient_info_1.webp" />

  **3. Patient Notes**

  Patient notes are of 2 types:

  a) General Notes: View Patient Profile > Patient Demographics > Add Patient Notes. These notes can be seen in the appointment details or within patient demographics.

  b) Pinned Notes: When enabled within the Preferences Tab, pinned notes will open automatically when the patient's profile or appointments or chart notes are opened.

  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/GiW28T6RvbTPtLoc/images/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_info/patient_info_1.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=GiW28T6RvbTPtLoc&q=85&s=2b014e7bf2cb0cdf15cc5ad3b2d365f2" alt="Pinned Notes Web" title="Pinned Notes Web" style={{ width:"44%" }} width="331" height="195" data-path="images/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_info/patient_info_1.webp" />
</Card>

## Patient Demographics

> Source: https://docs.athelas.com/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_demog.md

# Patient Demographics

Access and manage key patient demographic, contact, insurance, and case information in one place.

### <Icon icon="square-user" iconType="duotone" color="#F9345F" size={23} />  **Patient Information**

<Card title=" ">
  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/GiW28T6RvbTPtLoc/images/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_demog/patient_demog_1.gif?s=5baa61222e62952a0766ff1f9970942e" alt="13 Pt Demographics Gi" width="1920" height="1080" data-path="images/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_demog/patient_demog_1.gif" />

  Under **Patient Demographics**, you can view:

  * **General Information:** Patient Name, Date of Birth, Age, Gender, Primary Language, Height, Weight, Primary Care Provider, SSN, Ethnicity, Sexual Orientation, Tribal Affiliations, Gender Identity, and Race
  * **Contact Information**
  * **Emergency Contact**
  * **Financially Responsible Parties**
  * **Insurance Providers:** You can delete an insurance record here. An alert will appear asking you to confirm your decision. Even after deletion, the insurance record will remain visible in this section and can be restored at any time.
  * **Prior Authorization and Referral Details:** Prior authorization numbers can be created and deleted here. Deleting a prior authorization does not permanently remove it. You can restore it at any time, similar to the insurance deletion function.
</Card>

### <Icon icon="files-medical" iconType="duotone" color="#F9345F" size={23} />  **Active and Discharged Cases**

**Discharge Cases**

<Card title=" ">
  * Navigate to ****Patient Demographics →Cases****
  * Click the **Discharge Case** icon (black folder)
  * Enter a reason for discharge
  * Choose the type of discharge (with the option to cancel or archive all future appointments)

  \*\*Note: \*\*A chart note can also be changed to a discharge note, which adjusts the template of sections.

  <Danger>
    ✨**Smart Tip**: Type “/” in the Reason box to insert a pre-created text snippet.
  </Danger>

  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/GiW28T6RvbTPtLoc/images/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_demog/patient_demog_1.gif?s=5baa61222e62952a0766ff1f9970942e" alt="15 Case Discharge Gi" width="1920" height="1080" data-path="images/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_demog/patient_demog_1.gif" />

  **Note:** Options to cancel or archive future appointments can be turned on or off from the Preferences tab.

  **Restore a Discharged case**: Restore an incorrectly discharged case by clicking on the time icon.

  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/GiW28T6RvbTPtLoc/images/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_demog/patient_demog_1.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=GiW28T6RvbTPtLoc&q=85&s=d41edff56f9438d19a89b1360a476462" alt="Restore Discharge Web" title="Restore Discharge Web" style={{ width:"42%" }} width="322" height="228" data-path="images/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_demog/patient_demog_1.webp" />
</Card>

**Active Cases**

<Card title=" ">
  Within **Active Cases**, you can:

  * Add or edit a Case
  * Review the patient’s intervention progress
  * Create an Admin Progress Note

      <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/GiW28T6RvbTPtLoc/images/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_demog/patient_demog_1.gif?s=5baa61222e62952a0766ff1f9970942e" alt="14 Active Cases Gi" width="1920" height="1080" data-path="images/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_demog/patient_demog_1.gif" />

  **Click on the edit case icon to update the following:**

  * Supervising Provider on the case
  * Case Owning Provider on the case (also used to calculate the [Active Patient Breakdown](/air_admin/analyze_your_reports/kpi_dashboard#review-the-status-of-active-patients) report)
  * Add or view case notes for the patient

      <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/GiW28T6RvbTPtLoc/images/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_demog/patient_demog_1.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=GiW28T6RvbTPtLoc&q=85&s=d41edff56f9438d19a89b1360a476462" alt="Update Case Owner Prov Web" width="322" height="228" data-path="images/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_demog/patient_demog_1.webp" />
</Card>

> Source: https://docs.athelas.com/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_appts.md

# Patient Appointment Details

Review and manage patient appointments, chart notes, billing documents, and imported medical records.

To open a Patient's Profile: i) Click on the Top Tab of the Chart Note, ii) Open Patients Tab on the left navigation bar and select the desired patient.

### <Icon icon="note-medical" iconType="duotone" color="#F9345F" size={23} />  View chart notes for an appointment

<Card title=" ">
  Click on the **Appointments** tab at the top of the Patient Profile

  Click on the **square icon** (to the right of the calendar icon) to open the Chart Note for the desired appointment.

  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/GiW28T6RvbTPtLoc/images/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_appts/patient_appts_7.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=GiW28T6RvbTPtLoc&q=85&s=42459605fc453dd55ce2f8afa2072258" alt="Pt Appt Past Web" width="1086" height="1406" data-path="images/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_appts/patient_appts_7.webp" />
</Card>

### <Icon icon="filter" iconType="duotone" color="#F9345F" size={23} />  Filter appointments

<Card title=" ">
  Filter appointments by: Date of Appointment - Provider - Case - Facility - Status - Custom Tags

  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/GiW28T6RvbTPtLoc/images/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_appts/patient_appts_1.gif?s=ae3184926dc92823d95556f24fddfbef" alt="16 Filter Pt Appointments Gi" width="1920" height="1080" data-path="images/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_appts/patient_appts_1.gif" />
</Card>

### <Icon icon="download" iconType="duotone" color="#F9345F" size={23} />  Download patient schedule

<Card title=" ">
  Select appointments by checking the box to the left of each appointment → Choose to **Download** or **Fax** the patient’s schedule.

  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/GiW28T6RvbTPtLoc/images/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_appts/patient_appts_7.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=GiW28T6RvbTPtLoc&q=85&s=42459605fc453dd55ce2f8afa2072258" alt="Appt Download Schedule Web" width="1086" height="1406" data-path="images/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_appts/patient_appts_7.webp" />

<Card title=" ">

  * **Download** files by selecting the checkbox and clicking the **Download** button to the right of the search box.
  * **View** a file by clicking the **Black Eye** icon to the right of the selected file.

      <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/GiW28T6RvbTPtLoc/images/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_attachments/patient_attachments_1.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=GiW28T6RvbTPtLoc&q=85&s=be25ca96125b12bcee2294a6a569b5f1" alt="View Fax Pt Docs Web" width="2048" height="567" data-path="images/air_provider/review_patient_details/patient_attachments/patient_attachments_1.webp" />
</Card>

## Patient Portal

> Source: https://docs.athelas.com/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/patient_portal.md

# Patient Portal

The Athelas Patient Portal lets patients sign in securely to view appointments, exchange messages with the practice, manage payments and saved cards, complete forms, and access home exercise content.

Patients can register for the portal either through patient-specific invitation links (email and/or SMS) or through a self-service registration link hosted on the practice's site.

## Sending portal invitations

You can invite patients to the portal from two places: **Outreach Flows** and the **Patient Demographics** page. Patients can also register themselves through a [self-service link](#self-service-registration-invitation).

### <Icon icon="envelope" iconType="duotone" color="#F9345F" size={23} />  From Outreach Flows

In **Outreach Flows**, insert the message variant `patient_portal_link` (labeled **Patient Portal Link** in the variant picker) into an email or SMS. Use it any time you want to send patients to the practice's portal entry — for example, reminders to book, pay, or message the clinic.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/CMxc2caAxucpIo-V/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/patient_portal/patient_portal_1.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=CMxc2caAxucpIo-V&q=85&s=259da5fa97de88d78d6a77b42966736a" alt="Patient Portal Link variant in Outreach Flows" width="990" height="579" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/patient_portal/patient_portal_1.webp" />

### <Icon icon="address-card" iconType="duotone" color="#F9345F" size={23} />  From the Patient Demographics page

**To send a registration link to a specific patient manually:**

1. Navigate to the patient's **Demographics** page from the EHR Patient Profile.
2. Next to the patient's email address, click the **phone icon** to send a new portal registration link.
3. Confirm in the dialog.

The patient receives:

* An **email** at their address on file with a link to the portal (when an email is present).

<Warning>
  An email is required to send a portal invitation manually from the Patient Demographics page. Add an email to the patient first if you need to send one manually.
</Warning>

**Note:** There is a short cooldown between sends. If you try again too soon, the button explains how long to wait.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/vwFklSqhLnQdOwy0/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/patient_portal/patient_portal_2.gif?s=55a7a9897a5ce23cfd8ff582659c3250" alt="Sending a portal registration link from the Patient Demographics page" width="800" height="548" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/patient_portal/patient_portal_2.gif" />

You can also check a patient's portal registration status from this page:

**Registration completed:**

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/vwFklSqhLnQdOwy0/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/patient_portal/patient_portal_3.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=vwFklSqhLnQdOwy0&q=85&s=73c15f42398860a90bcd18eb664aacb8" alt="Portal status: registration completed" width="1004" height="284" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/patient_portal/patient_portal_3.webp" />

**Unsent / not yet invited:**

### <Icon icon="user-plus" iconType="duotone" color="#F9345F" size={23} />  Setting up authorized user access

To set up an individual as an authorized user of a patient's portal — such as a guarantor or power of attorney — create a new **Related Person**:

1. Navigate to the **Patient Demographics** page, then to **Responsible Parties**.
2. Click the **Related Persons** tab, then **+ Related Person**.
3. Fill out the required fields for the authorized user, including their relation to the patient and a valid email.
4. Toggle **Authorized Representative** to **ON**, then confirm that you are providing patient portal access to that individual.
5. Click **Create** to save the Related Person.

The authorized representative then receives a link inviting them to create their own portal account to access the patient's information as an authorized representative.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/vwFklSqhLnQdOwy0/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/patient_portal/patient_portal_8.gif?s=8e03bfa3f1e1bb69286ff23e40748c99" alt="Creating a Related Person as an authorized representative" width="1200" height="909" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/patient_portal/patient_portal_8.gif" />

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/vwFklSqhLnQdOwy0/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/patient_portal/patient_portal_9.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=vwFklSqhLnQdOwy0&q=85&s=e86f62889fc2154f1bd0917669b41ca0" alt="Authorized representative on the patient's record" width="2084" height="1502" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/patient_portal/patient_portal_9.webp" />

## Self-service registration invitation

Patients can also generate their own registration link through a self-service link. This is a site-specific link that practices can embed on their website, attach to a QR code at the front desk, or share in other places.

To create a self-service registration link, first create a **site slug** in the **Online Scheduling** section of the **Portal Configs** page.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/vwFklSqhLnQdOwy0/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/patient_portal/patient_portal_10.gif?s=b0020d49eea57d3bdc24f145d749c504" alt="Creating a site slug in Portal Configs" width="1200" height="909" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/patient_portal/patient_portal_10.gif" />

After creating a slug, direct patients to the link below:

<Info>
  `portal.athelas.com/site/yourpractice/register-account`
</Info>

From here, patients enter their name and date of birth. If the information matches an existing patient at the practice, a new registration link is sent to the email on file.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/vwFklSqhLnQdOwy0/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/patient_portal/patient_portal_11.gif?s=6be2c866172680d237d6477ec1fc67ed" alt="Self-service register-account flow" width="1200" height="909" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/patient_portal/patient_portal_11.gif" />

## Patient registration and sign-in

### Registration process

Once patients have received an invite link, they complete the portal registration steps:

1. **Verify name and date of birth**
2. **Set and confirm a new password**
3. **Complete registration**

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/vwFklSqhLnQdOwy0/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/patient_portal/patient_portal_12.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=vwFklSqhLnQdOwy0&q=85&s=058816050bcd9353672503f64a4acfe8" alt="Registration: verify name and date of birth" width="1724" height="1684" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/patient_portal/patient_portal_12.webp" />

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/vwFklSqhLnQdOwy0/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/patient_portal/patient_portal_13.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=vwFklSqhLnQdOwy0&q=85&s=b569b782955181817c69a2f92302825d" alt="Registration: set and confirm a password" width="2524" height="2558" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/patient_portal/patient_portal_13.webp" />

### Linked patient accounts

If multiple patient records share the same email address on file — for instance, spouses on a shared family account, or a single patient who visits multiple Athelas practices — the Patient Portal can link multiple portal accounts to a single login. New registrants are informed that they share an email with an existing portal user, and are asked to acknowledge that their account and information can be accessed by anyone who logs in with that email.

If preferred, the new patient can choose a different email, which then writes back to their patient profile in Athelas.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/vwFklSqhLnQdOwy0/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/patient_portal/patient_portal_14.gif?s=f96dd1abd0931609e6b2b1d2a89766e7" alt="Linking accounts that share an email" width="1200" height="909" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/patient_portal/patient_portal_14.gif" />

### Signing in

Once registered, patients can access the portal from [portal.athelas.com](http://portal.athelas.com) directly, or from portal links sent by the practice through **Patient Workflows** or **Outreach Flows**.

From the landing page, patients enter their email and password.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/vwFklSqhLnQdOwy0/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/patient_portal/patient_portal_15.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=vwFklSqhLnQdOwy0&q=85&s=e8607d6848d272fe61e7e91fb34d6299" alt="Patient portal sign-in landing page" width="2970" height="1586" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/patient_portal/patient_portal_15.webp" />

### Sign in with Google

Patients can also sign in with **Google**. From the sign-in page, selecting **Continue with Google** lets them authenticate with a Google account whose email matches the one on file — no separate portal password required.

<video controls>
  <source src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/bDnORZ4asTxIQhVo/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/patient_portal/patient_portal_google_login.mp4?fit=max&auto=format&n=bDnORZ4asTxIQhVo&q=85&s=6978aabe727b5bf891c54cca394265b9" type="video/mp4" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/patient_portal/patient_portal_google_login.mp4" />
</video>

### Accessing multiple patient accounts

When multiple patient accounts or authorized-representative accounts are associated with a single login (for example, a patient who visits multiple Athelas practices), the patient is greeted at sign-in with a selection screen to choose which site portal or patient to access. From there, they are taken into the portal.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/vwFklSqhLnQdOwy0/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/patient_portal/patient_portal_16.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=vwFklSqhLnQdOwy0&q=85&s=ce16cdbb3e1c1f063d0209cca98e20af" alt="Selection screen for multiple linked accounts" width="2852" height="1636" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/patient_portal/patient_portal_16.webp" />

### Reset password

Patients can click **Reset password** to reset their password. They are directed to check their email, follow the link, and set a new password.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/vwFklSqhLnQdOwy0/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/patient_portal/patient_portal_17.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=vwFklSqhLnQdOwy0&q=85&s=51d2136d176cadd4db0854e8f098f1c1" alt="Reset password flow" width="2966" height="1580" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/patient_portal/patient_portal_17.webp" />

## Portal functionality

Once in the portal, patients can access several areas:

### <Icon icon="house" iconType="duotone" color="#F9345F" size={23} />  Home

The landing page. Patients see what the portal offers and can navigate to sub-pages from here.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/vwFklSqhLnQdOwy0/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/patient_portal/patient_portal_18.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=vwFklSqhLnQdOwy0&q=85&s=d7d782704addc5719afa8ddd1405346f" alt="Patient portal home page" width="2996" height="1608" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/patient_portal/patient_portal_18.webp" />

### <Icon icon="comments" iconType="duotone" color="#F9345F" size={23} />  Messages

Secure messaging between the patient and users from the practice. Users can attach files or send messages.

Practices can configure whether patients can initiate messaging directly from their portal, or whether conversations must be started by a staff member. When patient-initiated messaging is enabled, practices can also restrict who patients are allowed to message:

1. Previously seen providers or staff
2. A preset group of staff or User Groups

See [Messaging Permissions](#messaging-permissions) to configure this behavior.

### <Icon icon="credit-card" iconType="duotone" color="#F9345F" size={23} />  Payments

Patients can view their balance, pay any charges, and see past transaction history.

### <Icon icon="calendar-check" iconType="duotone" color="#F9345F" size={23} />  Appointments

Patients can see upcoming and past visits, schedule, reschedule, or cancel appointments, and see waitlist status if enabled.

### <Icon icon="clipboard" iconType="duotone" color="#F9345F" size={23} />  Forms

Patients can view completed or pending forms, complete pending forms, and update insurance information in their patient profile.

### <Icon icon="dumbbell" iconType="duotone" color="#F9345F" size={23} />  Home Exercises

Patients can view their prescribed home exercise program by case.

### <Icon icon="user" iconType="duotone" color="#F9345F" size={23} />  Profile

Patients can edit their payment methods by clicking their name in the bottom left.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/vwFklSqhLnQdOwy0/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/patient_portal/patient_portal_19.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=vwFklSqhLnQdOwy0&q=85&s=43eccc4ee558056dc48db4808bffce4f" alt="Patient portal profile / payment methods" width="570" height="748" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/patient_portal/patient_portal_19.webp" />

## Configurations and settings

Patient Portal settings live under **EHR Preferences**. Available-slot display is configured on the **Calendar** tab; the remaining portal settings live on the **Portal Configs** tab.

### Configuring available slots

There are two modes for showing available times in the portal: **Calendar Interval** and **Appointment Type**. Configure this under **EHR Preferences → Calendar** tab.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/vwFklSqhLnQdOwy0/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/patient_portal/patient_portal_20.gif?s=cdcb7d1aa31f9fe9373e765c8dde922e" alt="Configuring interval mode on the Calendar tab" width="1200" height="909" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/patient_portal/patient_portal_20.gif" />

The two modes display available timeslots differently:

* **Calendar Interval** offers times on every interval based on the calendar interval for the site or facility.
  * For example, if the calendar interval is set to 15 minutes, patients see 9:00am, 9:15am, 9:30am, 9:45am, and so on as available times to book.
* **Appointment Type** offers times by iterating on the selected appointment type's duration, starting from the provider's working-hour start time.
  * For example, if a provider starts at 9:00am and the patient has selected a 45-minute Initial Evaluation, they see 9:00am, 9:45am, 10:30am, 11:15am, and so on as available times to book.

### Schedule Notice

Controls how far in advance patients can book through scheduling tied to the portal:

* **Minimum Notice (in hours)** — required. How close to the current time a patient is allowed to book or request an appointment.
* **Maximum Notice (in hours)** — optional; `0` means unlimited. How far out from the current time a patient is allowed to book or request an appointment.

### Appointment Requests

* **Require approval on appointment requests** — When on, requests from the portal appear as **Requested** on the calendar and can be approved from the **Requests** tab. When off, requests from the portal book directly to the calendar.

### Online Patient Scheduling

See [Online Scheduling](/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/online_scheduling) for full configuration details.

### Messaging Permissions

Practices can configure whether patients can initiate messages from the portal. When turned off, patients can only respond to messages started by a staff member. When enabled, practices can choose who patients are allowed to message:

* **Previous Providers**
* **Specific User Groups or Users**
* **Anyone**

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/vwFklSqhLnQdOwy0/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/patient_portal/patient_portal_21.gif?s=00a0032378d128c1008814537bd13fc7" alt="Messaging permission settings" width="1200" height="909" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/patient_portal/patient_portal_21.gif" />

### General Permissions

Configure what patients can change in the portal:

* Add payment methods
* Delete payment methods
* Book appointments
* Cancel appointments
* Reschedule appointments
* Add insurance
* Update insurance

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/vwFklSqhLnQdOwy0/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/patient_portal/patient_portal_22.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=vwFklSqhLnQdOwy0&q=85&s=36bfc6e190dd35f8606bc6806837c460" alt="Portal Configs settings panel" width="1040" height="1358" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/patient_portal/patient_portal_22.webp" />

## Create Patient Workflows

> Source: https://docs.athelas.com/air_admin/manage_your_practice/patient_workflows.md

# Create Patient Workflows

> Create patient intake forms, automate patient communications, and track workflow delivery in Air.

### Create a Patient Intake Form

<Card title>
  Navigate to the **Templates** tab under **Utilities** in the left navigation pane.

  View your forms, duplicate and edit them.

  You can also duplicate a global Patient Intake form template. The copy can be edited, while the original global template remains read-only.

  Select from the drop down on the top left to move between EHR (chart note templates) and Patient Intake form templates.

  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/6IXxoYIsA6qcOJ13/images/air_admin/manage_your_practice/patient_workflows/patient_workflows_1.jpeg?fit=max&auto=format&n=6IXxoYIsA6qcOJ13&q=85&s=2a8896a9aa206ff5788b0d3f0050f8ed" alt="Select Form Type Jpe" width="2048" height="645" data-path="images/air_admin/manage_your_practice/patient_workflows/patient_workflows_1.jpeg" />

  To create a new intake form:

  1. Click **+ Create New Template** in the top-right corner.
  2. Drag and drop **components** from the left panel to the right to add fields.
  3. Each component can be marked as required, duplicated, or deleted. The type of component is displayed in the top-right corner of the field.
  4. Once your form is built, give it a name on the top left and click **Save** on the top right. Be sure to select **Save as Patient Intake Template** so it’s stored as a patient intake form.
  5. You can also choose to show the intake form within the chart note by clicking on the checkbox on the top right.

  **Tip:** You can add text blocks to add headings or legal clauses to the form. Add Signature Blocks to require a signature / consent from the patient.

  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/6IXxoYIsA6qcOJ13/images/air_admin/manage_your_practice/patient_workflows/patient_workflows_1.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=6IXxoYIsA6qcOJ13&q=85&s=002a6d12b7007a5bdefb5b995532ffcb" alt="Create Intake Form Web" width="1924" height="1172" data-path="images/air_admin/manage_your_practice/patient_workflows/patient_workflows_1.webp" />

  **Note**: Set options within the Preferences tab to allow providers to edit patient intake forms directly within the chart note. This will not replace the original form (in the patient attachments) but will allow modifications to be made in the chart note.

  We have a **three pre-built forms with capabilities for patients to upload content** that will write back into Air.

  * Patient Update: This will auto-fill information within the Patient's Profile page in the Demographics section
  * Insurance Update: This will auto-fill information within the Patient's Profile page in the Demographics section. Patients can share a photo of their insurance card which will auto-create an attachment available in the patient profile.
  * Paperwork upload: Patients can share any documents they would like (e.g. diagnostic tests, etc.) which will auto-create an attachment available in the patient profile.
  * **Note:** These forms cannot be edited, even if an edit option appears.

  **Components available include:**

  <AccordionGroup>
    <Accordion title="Single Choice">
      Ask a question with one selectable answer.
    </Accordion>

    <Accordion title="Short Answer">
      Accepts short, typed responses.
    </Accordion>

    <Accordion title="Multiple Choice">
      Ask a question with multiple selectable answers.
    </Accordion>

    <Accordion title="Paragraph Answer">
      Accepts longer, free-text responses.
    </Accordion>

    <Accordion title="Yes/No Question">
      Provides a binary choice.
    </Accordion>

    <Accordion title="Number Answer">
      Accepts numeric input.
    </Accordion>

    <Accordion title="Rating Question">
      Collects a rating (e.g., 1–5 scale).
    </Accordion>

    <Accordion title="Table Answer">
      Displays responses in a table format, with columns added using the **+** button.
    </Accordion>

    <Accordion title="Date Question">
      Accepts a date input.
    </Accordion>

    <Accordion title="Text Box">
      Only available for patient intake forms (not EHR templates).
    </Accordion>
  </AccordionGroup>
</Card>

### Create a Patient Flow

<Card title>
  You can automate the patient intake process through **Patient Flow**.

  **Create new patient flows:**

  * Click **+ Add New Workflow.**

  * On the Workflows page, name your workflow and configure the rules for when intake forms and reminders should be sent.

      <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/6IXxoYIsA6qcOJ13/images/air_admin/manage_your_practice/patient_workflows/patient_workflows_1.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=6IXxoYIsA6qcOJ13&q=85&s=002a6d12b7007a5bdefb5b995532ffcb" alt="Patient Flow Nav Web" width="1924" height="1172" data-path="images/air_admin/manage_your_practice/patient_workflows/patient_workflows_1.webp" />

  * At the top of the page: Name your workflow and configure specifications for when intake forms and reminders should be sent. **Specifications include:**
    * Appointment Types – Define which appointment types trigger the workflow.
    * Appointment Reasons – Specify applicable reasons.
    * Patients – Choose which patients receive the workflow (useful for testing with a single test patient).
    * Facilities – Choose which facilities are included.
    * Providers – Restrict the workflow to certain providers.
    * Appointment Insurances – Require specific insurance types.
    * Minimum/Maximum Age – Set age limits for eligibility.

  * To send intake forms immediately when an appointment is created, check **Send Immediately on Appointment Creation.**

  * Select delivery methods: **Email** and/or **Text.** Both use the same customizable message.

  * Use the **Message Preview** at the bottom to confirm formatting. Always test with a test patient to avoid errors.

      <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/6IXxoYIsA6qcOJ13/images/air_admin/manage_your_practice/patient_workflows/patient_workflows_1.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=6IXxoYIsA6qcOJ13&q=85&s=002a6d12b7007a5bdefb5b995532ffcb" alt="Message Format Web" width="1924" height="1172" data-path="images/air_admin/manage_your_practice/patient_workflows/patient_workflows_1.webp" />

  <Danger>
    **✨Smart Tip:** Hover over the “i” icon in the **Message Templates** section to see dynamic fields (e.g., `patient_name`) that auto-fill with patient-specific data.
  </Danger>

  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/6IXxoYIsA6qcOJ13/images/air_admin/manage_your_practice/patient_workflows/patient_workflows_1.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=6IXxoYIsA6qcOJ13&q=85&s=002a6d12b7007a5bdefb5b995532ffcb" alt="Patient Message Options Web" title="Patient Message Options Web" style={{ width:"44%" }} width="1924" height="1172" data-path="images/air_admin/manage_your_practice/patient_workflows/patient_workflows_1.webp" />
</Card>

### Create an Appointment Reminder

<Card title>
  Appointment reminders can be configured to send up to **three times** (in addition to any immediate sends). You can set how many **days/hours before the appointment** reminders should be delivered.

  **Note:** Reminders are queued at midnight each day.

  * If you create an appointment for the next day, a reminder set for “1 day before” will not send.
  * However, a reminder set for “1 hour before” will send successfully.

  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/6IXxoYIsA6qcOJ13/images/air_admin/manage_your_practice/patient_workflows/patient_workflows_1.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=6IXxoYIsA6qcOJ13&q=85&s=002a6d12b7007a5bdefb5b995532ffcb" alt="Message Frequency Web" title="Message Frequency Web" style={{ width:"75%" }} width="1924" height="1172" data-path="images/air_admin/manage_your_practice/patient_workflows/patient_workflows_1.webp" />
</Card>

### Review Status of Appointment Reminders / Intake Forms

<Card title=" ">
  Once you create the workflows, you can track the status of messages sent to patients for reminders or patient intake forms

  **1. Review from Patient Workflows Tab**

  Navigate to Patient Workflows within the Automation section on the left navigation pane. Click on \*\*Upcoming Messages Today \*\*or \*\*Sent Messages Today \*\*to review the status.

  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/6IXxoYIsA6qcOJ13/images/air_admin/manage_your_practice/patient_workflows/patient_workflows_1.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=6IXxoYIsA6qcOJ13&q=85&s=002a6d12b7007a5bdefb5b995532ffcb" alt="Pt Workflow Page Web" width="1924" height="1172" data-path="images/air_admin/manage_your_practice/patient_workflows/patient_workflows_1.webp" />

  You can view the patients, delivery status of the message, date & time message was scheduled, date & time of appointment and appointment type. You can also filter the table as required.

  If a message is not delivered or failed to delivered the status and reason will be shown when you hover over the phone or email icon.

  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/6IXxoYIsA6qcOJ13/images/air_admin/manage_your_practice/patient_workflows/patient_workflows_1.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=6IXxoYIsA6qcOJ13&q=85&s=002a6d12b7007a5bdefb5b995532ffcb" alt="Text Status Web" width="1924" height="1172" data-path="images/air_admin/manage_your_practice/patient_workflows/patient_workflows_1.webp" />

  **2. Review from Calendar Appointments**

  Review the status of Reminders / Forms from the specific appointment details on the Calendar.

  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/6IXxoYIsA6qcOJ13/images/air_admin/manage_your_practice/patient_workflows/patient_workflows_1.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=6IXxoYIsA6qcOJ13&q=85&s=002a6d12b7007a5bdefb5b995532ffcb" alt="Appt Status Web" width="1924" height="1172" data-path="images/air_admin/manage_your_practice/patient_workflows/patient_workflows_1.webp" />
</Card>

### Send Text Blasts to All Patients

<Card title>
  The **Text Blast** page allows you to create reusable templates and send one-off mass texts with dynamic information tags, so each patient sees details personalized specifically for them.

  **Note**: Text blasts are one-way only, patients will not be able to reply back these messages.

  * Navigate to the Text Blast page within Automation on the left navigation pane. Click **Create New Text Blast.**
  * Enter a descriptive name for your blast.
  * Choose recipients. Leaving a field blank means “all.”
  * Compose your message. To add dynamic fields, enclose each variable in `{brackets}` and replace spaces with underscores. Example: `Hi {patient_name}!`

  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/6IXxoYIsA6qcOJ13/images/air_admin/manage_your_practice/patient_workflows/patient_workflows_1.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=6IXxoYIsA6qcOJ13&q=85&s=e7fefb0e7e4a44d27a9296cdd70d61c1" alt="Text Templates Pn" title="Text Templates Pn" style={{ width:"68%" }} width="928" height="888" data-path="images/air_admin/manage_your_practice/patient_workflows/patient_workflows_1.png" />

  * Click **Preview Text Blast** to review: Message text, Number of recipients, Estimated cost
  * Language translations: Patients receive texts in their preferred language; Default is English if none is listed.
  * Once confirmed, click **Send.** Depending on the number of recipients, sending may take a few minutes. The blast will then appear in the main page log.

  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/6IXxoYIsA6qcOJ13/images/air_admin/manage_your_practice/patient_workflows/patient_workflows_1.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=6IXxoYIsA6qcOJ13&q=85&s=e7fefb0e7e4a44d27a9296cdd70d61c1" alt="Preview Blast Pn" title="Preview Blast Pn" style={{ width:"60%" }} width="928" height="888" data-path="images/air_admin/manage_your_practice/patient_workflows/patient_workflows_1.png" />

  **Each logged blast displays: Delivered** (successful), **Sent** (in progress), **Failed** (undelivered). Hover over *Failure Reason* to see details (e.g., landline numbers cannot receive texts). You can also download a report for spreadsheet review.

  Patients receive a personalized text with their details (e.g., name, facility). They may reply **Stop** to opt out of future texts, reply **Unstop** to opt back in.

  \*\*Note: \*\*Blast messages are limited to 2000 patients only.
</Card>

## Messages

> Source: https://docs.athelas.com/air_front_desk/communicate_with_patients/messages.md

# Messages

Air maintains an internal and external messaging functionality that lets sites communicate with other site staff, and directly with patients through the Patient Portal.

## Messaging from Insights

Messages in Insights can be accessed by clicking the **Messages** tab under **Utilities**. From there, the **DM** tab lists all existing chats for the user. To create a new chat, click **+ New Chat** at the bottom of the pane.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/CMxc2caAxucpIo-V/images/air_front_desk/communicate_with_patients/messages/messages_1.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=CMxc2caAxucpIo-V&q=85&s=9134e0cc95eb7987f8b532a2028c2cf3" alt="Messages tab with DM list and New Chat button" style={{ width:"33%" }} width="636" height="1604" data-path="images/air_front_desk/communicate_with_patients/messages/messages_1.webp" />

To add recipients, type their names in the box containing **Start a new message**:

1. **External patients** are designated with `Patient: XXX`.
2. **Internal staff** show just their name.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/CMxc2caAxucpIo-V/images/air_front_desk/communicate_with_patients/messages/messages_2.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=CMxc2caAxucpIo-V&q=85&s=c5417620cd41a71f7006483bd18ad925" alt="Patient recipient with Patient label" style={{ width:"36%" }} width="680" height="880" data-path="images/air_front_desk/communicate_with_patients/messages/messages_2.webp" />

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/CMxc2caAxucpIo-V/images/air_front_desk/communicate_with_patients/messages/messages_3.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=CMxc2caAxucpIo-V&q=85&s=d8d358e5b6b4216cc066b7d1b518ff7f" alt="Internal staff recipient" style={{ width:"36%" }} width="854" height="846" data-path="images/air_front_desk/communicate_with_patients/messages/messages_3.webp" />

<Warning>
  Multiple recipients can be added to a message to create a group text. **Any recipients of a group text can see all other recipients — including external patients.** This is <u>not</u> a private text blast feature.
</Warning>

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/CMxc2caAxucpIo-V/images/air_front_desk/communicate_with_patients/messages/messages_4.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=CMxc2caAxucpIo-V&q=85&s=9be8c7f05782ec7fd28306c5d47633a6" alt="Group text with multiple recipients" width="1714" height="378" data-path="images/air_front_desk/communicate_with_patients/messages/messages_4.webp" />

From here, pressing **Enter** or clicking out of the recipient menu generates a new message window where you can type and send your message. Messages also support attaching files — click **+ Add An Attachment** at the bottom of the pane.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/CMxc2caAxucpIo-V/images/air_front_desk/communicate_with_patients/messages/messages_5.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=CMxc2caAxucpIo-V&q=85&s=66e665b7505aa4f4f1b480172d7f93d0" alt="New message window with attachment button" style={{ width:"42%" }} width="476" height="252" data-path="images/air_front_desk/communicate_with_patients/messages/messages_5.webp" />

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/CMxc2caAxucpIo-V/images/air_front_desk/communicate_with_patients/messages/messages_6.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=CMxc2caAxucpIo-V&q=85&s=456dffc8451c20470d527f936f63833c" alt="File attached in message" width="1708" height="444" data-path="images/air_front_desk/communicate_with_patients/messages/messages_6.webp" />

## New messages

New messages appear at the top of the messages list with an unread indicator. Clicking the message shows the full thread, where you can respond.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/CMxc2caAxucpIo-V/images/air_front_desk/communicate_with_patients/messages/messages_7.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=CMxc2caAxucpIo-V&q=85&s=ff946fb83927d4ac174f973c3a526639" alt="Unread message at top of list" style={{ width:"49%" }} width="658" height="656" data-path="images/air_front_desk/communicate_with_patients/messages/messages_7.webp" />

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/CMxc2caAxucpIo-V/images/air_front_desk/communicate_with_patients/messages/messages_8.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=CMxc2caAxucpIo-V&q=85&s=98bcfe2daf4a018de8c18d8e4ad1ae6d" alt="Opened message with response field" style={{ width:"78%" }} width="1730" height="1494" data-path="images/air_front_desk/communicate_with_patients/messages/messages_8.webp" />

## Messaging from the Athelas Patient Portal

For patients, messages sent from Insights can be accessed in the Patient Portal. Patients are notified of new messages via text or email alerts.

<Columns cols={2}>
  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/CMxc2caAxucpIo-V/images/air_front_desk/communicate_with_patients/messages/messages_9.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=CMxc2caAxucpIo-V&q=85&s=9c3b29763530d17a4b653c47efcb241d" alt="Text message notification to patient" width="558" height="384" data-path="images/air_front_desk/communicate_with_patients/messages/messages_9.webp" />

  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/CMxc2caAxucpIo-V/images/air_front_desk/communicate_with_patients/messages/messages_10.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=CMxc2caAxucpIo-V&q=85&s=5e3cc414e9ec549e196a17a1625ac51f" alt="Email notification to patient" width="1822" height="950" data-path="images/air_front_desk/communicate_with_patients/messages/messages_10.webp" />
</Columns>

After logging into the portal, patients access messages via the **Messages** tab in the sidebar.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/CMxc2caAxucpIo-V/images/air_front_desk/communicate_with_patients/messages/messages_11.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=CMxc2caAxucpIo-V&q=85&s=871a230711db4eaa5676768e3dfa51cf" alt="Patient portal Messages tab" style={{ width:"47%" }} width="564" height="782" data-path="images/air_front_desk/communicate_with_patients/messages/messages_11.webp" />

From here, patients can see existing conversations and send replies. At this time, patients **cannot create new conversations** from the portal — all conversations must be initiated by the provider or site staff.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/CMxc2caAxucpIo-V/images/air_front_desk/communicate_with_patients/messages/messages_12.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=CMxc2caAxucpIo-V&q=85&s=c982bc396414b22a368eeab5fade21aa" alt="Patient portal conversation view" width="2876" height="1494" data-path="images/air_front_desk/communicate_with_patients/messages/messages_12.webp" />

### FAQ

<Accordion title="Can patients start a new conversation from the portal?">
  No. All conversations must be initiated from Insights by provider or site staff. Once a thread exists, the patient can reply freely from the portal.
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="How are patients notified of a new message?">
  Patients receive either an SMS or email alert (or both, depending on contact info on file). The notification links directly into the portal, where they can log in and respond.
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="Can I send a message to multiple patients at once?">
  Yes — add multiple recipients in the **Start a new message** box. **However**, all recipients (including patients) see each other's names in the thread. For private bulk outreach, use **Outreach Flows** or **Text Blast** instead.
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="Can I attach files in a message?">
  Yes. Click **+ Add An Attachment** at the bottom of the message pane. Attachments are supported for both internal staff threads and external patient threads.
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="Where do I find the Messages page in Insights?">
  Click **Messages** under **Utilities** in the sidebar. The **DM** tab shows all existing chats. The Notifications Center at the bottom of the sidebar also shows a count of unread messages and links directly to the thread.
</Accordion>

## Faxing

> Source: https://docs.athelas.com/air_provider/review_patient_details/faxing.md

# Faxing

Air's faxing module gives your front desk a single place to receive, process, send, and track every fax — no external fax portal needed. This guide covers everything from managing your inbound queue to sending documents straight from a patient's chart.

## Navigating to faxes

There are two ways to open the Faxing page:

* Click **Utilities → Faxing** in the left sidebar.
* Press **⌘K** (Mac) or **Ctrl+K** (Windows), type *Faxes*, and press **Enter**.

<Frame>
  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/2AIsJDBNeXLH-Qvs/images/air_provider/review_patient_details/faxing/faxing_4.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=2AIsJDBNeXLH-Qvs&q=85&s=0ddb95bfbe79c58fbd2ab383436ee420" alt="Opening the Faxing page from Utilities in the left sidebar" width="480" height="846" data-path="images/air_provider/review_patient_details/faxing/faxing_4.webp" />
</Frame>

The Faxing page has three main sections:

* **Outbound** – view and manage faxes you’ve sent.
* **Inbound** – view received faxes (with filters for **All**, **Unprocessed**, and **Processed**).
* **Tasks** – attach follow-ups and track progress directly from any fax.

## Outbound faxes

The **Outbound** tab shows every fax your organization has sent, along with its current delivery status. Faxes sent from chart notes and from the Attachments tab both appear here, correctly attributed to the sending facility and provider.

| **Status**      | **What it means**                  |
| :-------------- | :--------------------------------- |
| ✅ **Delivered** | Fax was received successfully.     |
| ⏳ **Pending**   | Fax is in transit.                 |
| ❌ **Failed**    | Delivery failed — action required. |

### Sending an Outbound Fax

* Click **Send Document** in the top-right corner.
* Fill out the **Send Fax** side panel:
  * **Recipient Fax Number** – enter the number you’re faxing to.
  * **Subject** – title of the fax.
  * **Send From** – choose a fax line from your organization’s dropdown.
  * **Facility / Provider \[Optional]** – assign context.
  * **Choose Files** – upload one or more PDFs.
* Click **Send Document**.
* The fax will now appear in your **Outbound** list. You can track the status of the fax.

Use the filter panel to narrow by **Patient**, **Facility**, **Created By**, or **Document Type**.

### Resend a failed fax

If a fax fails, you don't need to start over:

1. Find the failed fax in the **Outbound** tab.
2. Click **Resend**.
3. Confirm or modify the recipient, fax number, or attachments in the Send Fax Drawer, then send.

The original and resent fax records are linked, giving you a complete audit trail.

### Automatic failure tasks

When a fax fails to deliver, Air automatically creates a task in your **Tasks** queue so nothing gets missed. The task includes a reference to the original fax.

### Track documents sent via email and text

Documents sent from Patient Attachments via email or text message also appear in the **Outbound** tab. You can see the delivery status, timestamp, and recipient for each — no manual follow-up needed to confirm receipt.

## Inbound faxes

### Your inbox

The **Inbound** tab is split into two sub-tabs:

* **Unprocessed** — faxes that haven't been acted on yet.
* **Processed** — faxes you've reviewed and handled. A fax moves here automatically once you manually assign a patient and document type.

Use the filter panel to narrow the list by **Patient**, **Document Type**, **Facility**, or **Created By**. Filters work across both sub-tabs.

Air automatically routes each inbound fax to the correct facility by scanning the PDF for a facility name. If no facility is found, it falls back to the patient's most recently associated facility. For new patients with no prior visits (e.g., inbound referrals), no facility is assumed — preventing incorrect routing.

### Process an inbound fax

When you open a fax from the **Unprocessed** queue, the PDF loads **side-by-side with the edit panel** so you can read and categorize at the same time — no more switching views.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/QXxuBMS71Y-Dqr0o/images/air_provider/review_patient_details/faxing/faxing_1.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=QXxuBMS71Y-Dqr0o&q=85&s=445aea3a68b064a68da1f5a53715b370" alt="Processing an inbound fax with the PDF and edit panel side by side" width="2276" height="1618" data-path="images/air_provider/review_patient_details/faxing/faxing_1.webp" />

From the detail view you can:

* **Link to a patient** — Search by name (including preferred name) to associate the fax with a patient's chart. Once linked, the fax appears in that patient's record.
* **Assign a document type** — Select a content category (e.g., "Prior Authorization", "Insurance Card", "Referral"). Admins can create and manage available types — see [Fax settings](#fax-settings).
* **Add tags** — Apply tags to organize the fax. Tags sync with Patient Attachments, so anything you apply here carries over automatically when the fax is linked to a patient record.
* **Split the fax** — Break a compound document into multiple fax entries that can be separately assigned patients, document types, and tags.

### Create a lead from an inbound fax

When an inbound fax is a referral, you can create a patient lead directly from the fax detail view — no need to leave the faxing workflow.

1. Open the fax from the **Inbound** tab.
2. Click **Create Lead** in the action panel.
3. The Lead Creation drawer opens alongside the fax — fill in referral type, patient details, and any notes.
4. **Save** — the lead appears in Lead Tracker, and a reference is stored on the fax record.

Faxes that have already generated a lead are marked with a **Leads** indicator in the Inbound list, so your team can see at a glance which faxes have been converted.

### Split a combined fax

Providers sometimes send one fax containing records for multiple patients. You can split it into separate documents:

1. Open the fax and select **Split Fax**.
2. Define the page ranges for each individual fax (e.g., pages 1–4 for Patient A, pages 5–9 for Patient B).
3. Set a subject, patient, and document type for each segment before saving.
4. Each segment is saved as its own independent fax and can be linked to the appropriate patient separately.

## Sending a fax

### From the Send Fax Drawer

The Send Fax Drawer is available any time you initiate a fax — from the queue, from a patient's chart, or from an order. Key features:

* **Multiple documents** — Add as many files as needed. Air validates file type and size before sending to prevent delivery failures.
* **Reorder by dragging** — Drag documents into the order you want them to appear. The final fax PDF reflects the order you set.
* **Address book** — Start typing a name or fax number in the recipient field to search saved contacts. Some organizations maintain a read-only contact list for standardized workflows.
* **Cover sheet** — Choose from your saved templates, use the system default, or skip the cover sheet (see [Cover sheets](#cover-sheets)). When enabled on the cover sheet, you can also add free-text notes with context or instructions (e.g., "Medical records request — received 06/15"), which appear on the cover sheet.

### Cover sheets

Every fax can include a cover sheet. Air provides a system default, and admins can build fully custom templates from **Utilities → Faxing → Settings → Fax coversheet templates**.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/QXxuBMS71Y-Dqr0o/images/air_provider/review_patient_details/faxing/faxing_2.gif?s=3335fc4964b1e1dcaeb714f70cfc1856" alt="Building a custom cover sheet template" width="600" height="343" data-path="images/air_provider/review_patient_details/faxing/faxing_2.gif" />

**Select a cover sheet at send time.** Use the **Cover Sheet** dropdown in the Send Fax Drawer to choose a custom template (any saved template your admin created, with your organization's branding, logo, and layout) or **No cover sheet** to skip it. After you select a template, a preview renders inline so you can confirm it looks right before sending.

**Editable text boxes.** Practices can add **editable text box fields** to a template, which staff fill in right before hitting **Send**. This is useful for context that can't be auto-populated — things like *reason for referral*, *notes to the receiving provider*, or *urgency and follow-up instructions*. When you select a template with text boxes, the fields appear in the Send Fax Drawer directly below the cover sheet preview. Type into them and the cover sheet updates live.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/QXxuBMS71Y-Dqr0o/images/air_provider/review_patient_details/faxing/faxing_3.gif?s=d805167671a10d796d3142db062cea9f" alt="Filling in editable text box fields on a cover sheet" width="600" height="415" data-path="images/air_provider/review_patient_details/faxing/faxing_3.gif" />

**Dynamic variables.** Beyond text boxes, templates automatically populate context from the fax — `{{patient.name}}`, `{{provider.npi}}`, `{{facility.fax}}`, and more. Staff don't have to fill these in; Air resolves them at send time.

**Set a default cover sheet.** Admins can designate one template as the **site default**. Air attaches the default automatically whenever a fax is sent without a manual selection — most importantly when **auto-faxing fires** (e.g., a provider signs a chart note and Air automatically sends it to the referring provider).

<Warning>
  Because auto-faxing runs without a human reviewing the Send Fax Drawer, the default cover sheet **cannot contain editable text box fields** — only dynamic variables and fixed content are supported. If you try to set a template with text boxes as the default, Air prompts you to remove those fields first. Templates with text boxes can still be selected manually at send time.
</Warning>

### From within a patient workflow

Faxing is integrated throughout Air so you can send without leaving what you're doing:

* **Chart note** — When a provider signs a note, Air can automatically queue it for the referring provider (see [Fax settings](#fax-settings) to configure this).
* **Patient Attachments** — Open a patient → **Attachments** → click **Send as Fax** on any document.
* **Imaging or Referral Orders** — The order modal includes a fax send step with the referring provider's number pre-filled.

## Fax settings

Open **Faxing → Settings** to configure fax behavior for your organization:

* **Fax numbers** — Your organization's fax numbers are tied to specific facilities. Contact your Athelas account team to add, change, or deactivate a number.
* **Cover sheets** — Build and manage custom cover sheet templates. Use rich text formatting, insert dynamic variables (patient, provider, facility, recipient), add your organization's logo, and set a site-wide default template. Staff can choose or override the template at send time.
* **Fax contacts** — View and search the address book. Admins can manage the contact list from this tab.

Additional settings live under **EHR Preferences**:

* **General → Auto-faxing on chart note sign** — Enable or disable automatic queueing when providers sign chart notes, configurable by note type (initial eval, progress note, discharge) and by facility. When on, Air defaults to the patient's referring provider as the recipient.
* **Faxing → Content types** — Create, rename, and delete the document type categories used when tagging faxes (e.g., "Prior Authorization", "Insurance Card", "Referral"). Add or remove categories any time.
* **Tags** — Manage the shared tag taxonomy used across both the Faxing page and Patient Attachments. Tags are unified — a tag applied while processing an inbound fax carries over to the patient's attachment record automatically.

## Troubleshooting

| **Issue**                                               | **What to try**                                                                                                                                                               |
| :------------------------------------------------------ | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Fax shows **Delivered** but recipient didn't receive it | Confirm the fax number is correct. Ask the recipient to check that their machine was online and had paper. Contact Athelas support with the fax ID.                           |
| Fax stuck in **Pending**                                | If still pending after 30 minutes, use **Resend**. Check that the recipient's line is active.                                                                                 |
| Failed fax — **Resend** option not visible              | You may not have the required permission. Ask your admin.                                                                                                                     |
| Not receiving inbound faxes                             | Verify your fax number is active under **Settings**. Contact Athelas support if the number looks correct.                                                                     |
| Inbound fax routed to the wrong facility                | Air uses OCR to assign the facility automatically. If routing is consistently incorrect, contact Athelas support to review the facility assignment logic for your fax number. |
| Cover sheet template missing at send time               | Templates are managed in **Settings → EHR Preferences → Faxing → Cover Sheets**. Ask your admin to verify the template is saved and active.                                   |

### FAQ

<Accordion title="Where do faxes I send from a chart note or patient attachment show up?">
  All outbound faxes — including those sent from chart notes and from Patient Attachments — appear in the **Outbound** tab with their delivery status, timestamp, and recipient, attributed to the sending facility and provider.
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="What happens if a fax fails to deliver?">
  Air automatically creates a task in your **Tasks** queue referencing the original fax, so the failure isn't missed. You can click **Resend** on the failed fax to try again — the original and resent records stay linked for a full audit trail.
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="How does Air decide which facility an inbound fax belongs to?">
  Air scans the incoming PDF for a facility name. If none is found, it falls back to the patient's most recently associated facility. For new patients with no prior visits, no facility is assumed, which prevents incorrect routing.
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="Can one inbound fax cover multiple patients?">
  Yes. Use **Split Fax** to divide a combined document into separate faxes by page range, then assign each segment its own subject, patient, and document type. Each segment becomes an independent fax.
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="Why can't I set my cover sheet template as the default?">
  A default cover sheet is used during auto-faxing, which runs without a person reviewing the send. Because of that, defaults can't contain editable text box fields — only dynamic variables and fixed content. Remove the text box fields, or select that template manually at send time instead.
</Accordion>
