</video>

## Automatic lead creation from faxes

Air can classify inbound faxes and, when one is a referral, create a lead automatically and link it back to the originating fax. You enable this per site.

<Info>
  For setup, the extraction logic, and the manual fallback, see [Automatic Lead Creation from Faxes](/air_admin/manage_your_practice/automatic_lead_creation_from_faxes).
</Info>

### FAQ

<Accordion title="What does a Reporting Category actually change?">
  It decides which KPI bucket a stage's leads land in on **Performance Analysis → Lead Tracker**. Leads in stages tagged `Converted` count toward the conversion percentage; leads in stages tagged `In Progress` or left at `No Category` both count as in progress.
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="Why did the Status clear when I changed a lead's Stage?">
  Each stage defines its own sub-stages, so a status from the previous stage would not be a valid option on the new one. Reselect a status before you save.
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="Can a lead marked Treatment Declined be brought back?">
  Yes. Marking a lead Treatment Declined moves it into the **Declined Treatment** bucket, and the action can be undone.
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="Do leads from the public landing page need a manual step before they appear?">
  No. A submitted form creates a lead directly, using the default stage and lead type you set on the **Landing Page** tab.
</Accordion>

## Automatic Lead Creation from Faxes

> Source: https://docs.athelas.com/air_admin/manage_your_practice/automatic_lead_creation_from_faxes.md

# Automatic Lead Creation from Faxes

## Overview

Automatic lead creation turns inbound referral faxes into Lead Tracker leads without any manual data entry. When a referral fax arrives, Air scans it, pulls out the patient's details (name, date of birth, and contact information), and creates a lead linked back to the original fax.

## Getting started

Automatic lead creation is controlled per site from your faxing preferences.

1. Go to **Preferences → Administrative → Faxing**.
2. Under **Patient Lead Fax Configuration**, turn on **Enable auto lead generation from faxes**.
3. Set **Default Lead Type** to the lead type you want applied to leads created this way (for example `Fax`).

Save your changes.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/zmk2-AM25NWIJxNt/images/air_admin/manage_your_practice/automatic_lead_creation_from_faxes/automatic_lead_creation_from_faxes_1.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=zmk2-AM25NWIJxNt&q=85&s=f0aedcca17e94118e1419b147d815bcf" alt="The Patient Lead Fax Configuration panel under Preferences, showing the auto lead generation toggle and the Default Lead Type selector" width="3402" height="1430" data-path="images/air_admin/manage_your_practice/automatic_lead_creation_from_faxes/automatic_lead_creation_from_faxes_1.webp" />

Once it is enabled, no further action is needed — new referral faxes start generating leads automatically.

## Lead generation logic

To generate a lead, the automated system works through these steps:

1. **Initial scan** — every inbound fax is scanned to determine what kind of document it is.
2. **Referral identification** — if the fax contains a referral section, Air extracts the patient's **first name**, **last name**, and **date of birth**, plus **phone number** where one is available.
3. **Lead creation** — if the required fields (first name, last name, and date of birth) are all found, Air creates a lead in the Lead Tracker with:
   * The Lead Type set to your **Default Lead Type**
   * The lead placed in your first referral stage, ready for review
   * A note recording that it was imported automatically from an inbound fax
   * A link back to the original fax, so you can always trace a lead to its source document
4. **Duplicate protection** — if a referral matches the name and date of birth of a patient who already has an open case, or if a lead was recently created from another fax for the same person, Air skips creating a second lead.

Because these details come from an AI reading a scanned document, review a new lead before reaching out to the patient.

## Creating a lead manually from a fax

If the system misses a referral, or you would rather not turn the automation on, you can still create and link leads yourself:

1. Open the fax from your **Faxing** tab.
2. Use the **Create Lead** action.
3. Choose to create a new lead, or link the fax to a lead that is already in the Lead Tracker.

Leads that came from a fax show a **View Fax** action on their row in the tracker, which opens the source document.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/zmk2-AM25NWIJxNt/images/air_admin/manage_your_practice/automatic_lead_creation_from_faxes/automatic_lead_creation_from_faxes_2.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=zmk2-AM25NWIJxNt&q=85&s=69e23234db32d63c6ebfec2727ecbc34" alt="A Lead Tracker row for a fax-generated lead, with the View Fax action that opens the source document" width="2390" height="650" data-path="images/air_admin/manage_your_practice/automatic_lead_creation_from_faxes/automatic_lead_creation_from_faxes_2.webp" />

### FAQ

<Accordion title="Will this create leads from every fax we receive?">
  No. Only faxes that Air identifies as referrals, and that carry at least a first name, last name, and date of birth, generate a lead.
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="What if the AI gets a detail wrong?">
  Open the lead in the Lead Tracker and edit it, the same as any lead you created by hand. Check new fax-generated leads before contacting the patient.
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="Can we turn this off?">
  Yes. Go to **Preferences → Administrative → Faxing** and turn off **Enable auto lead generation from faxes** at any time.
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="What happens to the original fax?">
  Nothing about how faxes are stored or displayed changes. This feature only adds a lead, and a link between that lead and the fax it came from.
</Accordion>

# Navigating Your Calendar

  * Save and access your most-used filters instantly.

  * See an at-a-glance view of your schedule with visual highlights.
  * Expanded date/month/year selection for easier navigation.
  * Works across desktop and responsive devices (tablet and mobile-friendly).

### <Icon icon="timer" iconType="duotone" color="#F9345F" size={23} />  Calendar Preferences

<Card title="Time Preferences: ">
  * Switch between Day, Week, and Month views to adjust your Calendar display. Use the **Today** icon in the top left to instantly return to today's date.

  **Compact Preferences:** Select how compact you'd like your calendar to be.

  * **Standard View (default):** Best if most appointments are under 30 minutes.
  * **Compact View:** Fits more appointments on the screen. Works well on large displays, but details may be cut off on smaller screens.
  * **Fit to Screen View:** Adjusts automatically to fit the screen size for large and small screens. Shows the full schedule, but with fewer details.

  <Danger>
    ✨**Smart Tip:** Drag and drop appointments between providers to reassign the rendering Provider
  </Danger>

  <Accordion title="Filter Appointments" iconType="regular">

      * **Provider:** When multiple Providers are selected, each appears as a separate column in the Calendar view.
      * **Facility:** When multiple Facilities are selected, each appears as a tab across the top of the Calendar.
      * **Insurance:** Show only appointments for patients whose insurance matches your selection.
      * **Patient:** Show only appointments for specific patients you select.
      * **Cancellations:** Hide all appointments marked as *Cancelled*.
      * **No Shows:** Hide all appointments marked as *No Show*.
      * **Weekends:** Hide Saturdays and Sundays from the Calendar view (applies to Day, Week, and Month views).

      At any time, you can reset by clicking **Clear All** at the top of the Calendar.

      **Note**: Hover over a Provider's name to see the number of appointments for the day, organized by status.

  When adding a referring provider, you can search our Provider Directory (icon to the right of the search bar). It is sourced from the NPI Registry.

  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/DrWmF2QHSQhYusvP/images/air_front_desk/take_in_a_patient/new_appt/new_appt_4.gif?s=147680f59a6ecc1277279d0dbd97f4b2" alt="13 Refprovider Gi" width="1920" height="1016" data-path="images/air_front_desk/take_in_a_patient/new_appt/new_appt_4.gif" />

  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/DrWmF2QHSQhYusvP/images/air_front_desk/take_in_a_patient/new_appt/new_appt_1.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=DrWmF2QHSQhYusvP&q=85&s=6ae537ace4afbfe72da553a8fb37af0e" alt="Referral Directory Web" title="Referral Directory Web" style={{ width:"53%" }} width="1038" height="1912" data-path="images/air_front_desk/take_in_a_patient/new_appt/new_appt_1.webp" />

  From the Provider Directory you can:

  * Add a provider by NPI or name
  * Edit provider details (fax, phone, address) via the pencil icon
  * Have referrals auto-populate if “Direct Access” is chosen
</Card>

### Add Prior Authorization

<Card title>
  To add a new prior authorization, click the **+** icon next to the Prior Authorization field.

  1. In the pop-up window, click **+ Create.**
  2. Fill in the authorization type (Pre-Certification or Referral), number, effective/expiration dates, insurance, notes, and tags.
  3. Click **Create.**

  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/DrWmF2QHSQhYusvP/images/air_front_desk/take_in_a_patient/new_appt/new_appt_1.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=DrWmF2QHSQhYusvP&q=85&s=6ae537ace4afbfe72da553a8fb37af0e" alt="New Auth2 Web" title="New Auth2 Web" style={{ width:"41%" }} width="1038" height="1912" data-path="images/air_front_desk/take_in_a_patient/new_appt/new_appt_1.webp" />

  The new authorization will appear in the list and can be selected for the appointment. If you can’t find the prior auth you just created, please check both the Pre-Certified and Referral sections within the Prior Auth table

  **Note:** Prior authorizations can also be managed under the patient’s [Demographics tab.](https://air_athelas.mintlify.app/patient_details/patient_demog#patient-information)
</Card>

### Change Insurance Priority

<Card title>
  Insurance priority will be auto-populated based off what was indicated in the case.

  To change insurance priority, ensure the **Secondary** and **Tertiary** checkboxes are selected. Then, use the dropdown to assign insurances to each priority level.

  **Note:** You cannot create a new insurance from here—you must select one already on the patient’s record.
</Card>

## <Icon icon="envelopes-bulk" iconType="duotone" color="#F9345F" size={23} />  Create new appointment (bulk)

<Card title>
  * Use **Create New → Bulk Create Appointments** or click directly on the calendar.
  * Choose the provider, title, time/date, and recurrence.
  * If your practice policy allows you can also note credentialing exceptions during scheduling.

  **Note:** You can bulk-schedule with a primary and a backup (alternate) provider. The calendar shows availability for both, you can pick who covers each date, and the system creates the right appointments under the right provider.
</Card>

<Accordion title="FAQ: Updating a case after the appointment is completed">
  **We do not support updating a case for a completed appointment**. Sites must make sure the case is linked correctly **before finalizing the chart note in Air**.

  If a site encounters this issue:

  1. A completed appointment cannot be archived. Every completed appointment (which is typically intended to bill) will always have an encounter/claim.
  2. The site should schedule a **new appointment** on the same day with the same provider, linked to the **correct case**.
  3. Import the PDF of the incorrect case into this new appointment.
  4. Mark this new appointment as **“for documentation only”** so no duplicate encounters/claims are generated.
  5. Once the document is imported, they can apply Scribe to the chart note.
  6. Going forward, they will be able to carry forward information from the correct case into future appointments for that case.
</Accordion>

## Online Scheduling

> Source: https://docs.athelas.com/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/online_scheduling.md

# Online Scheduling

Online Scheduling with Athelas lets practices provide a custom, practice-specific scheduling link to new or existing patients for booking appointments. Patients access available appointment times by providing their name, date of birth, and confirming their phone number through a 2FA code — giving a low-friction place for new or existing patients to book appointments.

## Accessing and configuring Online Scheduling

Settings for Online Scheduling can be accessed in the **Preferences** tab, under the **Portal Configs** sub-tab.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/CMxc2caAxucpIo-V/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/online_scheduling/online_scheduling_1.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=CMxc2caAxucpIo-V&q=85&s=488ffb11dd2fece68fa60852aa07f1c1" alt="Preferences tab showing Portal Configs sub-tab" width="856" height="383" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/online_scheduling/online_scheduling_1.webp" />

### Turning on Online Scheduling

From the **Portal Configs** tab, practices can enable Online Scheduling by clicking the toggle in the **Online Patient Scheduling** section.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/CMxc2caAxucpIo-V/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/online_scheduling/online_scheduling_2.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=CMxc2caAxucpIo-V&q=85&s=e90c9586ce9dea7bd13f24e4a233f3fd" alt="Online Patient Scheduling toggle" width="897" height="98" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/online_scheduling/online_scheduling_2.webp" />

### Configuring Online Scheduling

Once turned on, several settings are available to adjust the behavior:

* **Site Slug** — changes the URL patients use to access online scheduling for the practice. For example, with the slug `yourpractice`, patients go to:

  <Info>
    [portal.athelas.com/site/yourpractice](http://portal.athelas.com/site/yourpractice)
  </Info>

* **New Patient Signup Destination** — determines the behavior when a patient indicates they are a new patient. Practices can either allow access to the scheduling functionality directly, or redirect new patients to the Landing Page to generate a lead.

* **New Patient Appointment Scheduling** — when toggled on, appointments from new patients are sent as **Appointment Requests** rather than booking directly to the calendar. This is similar to the general **Require approval on appointment requests** setting, but applies only to patients who select New Patient.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/CMxc2caAxucpIo-V/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/online_scheduling/online_scheduling_3.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=CMxc2caAxucpIo-V&q=85&s=7e4ac5606c6202abf7015782aee06856" alt="Online Scheduling configuration options" width="2326" height="718" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/online_scheduling/online_scheduling_3.webp" />

## Using Online Scheduling as a patient

When patients click on the site-specific link, they are taken to a sign-in page where they indicate whether they are a new or existing patient.

### New patients

If **New Patient** is selected and the New Patient Signup Destination is set to **Lead Tracker**, the patient is redirected to the Lead Tracker Landing Page where they can input their information to generate a new lead.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/CMxc2caAxucpIo-V/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/online_scheduling/online_scheduling_4.gif?s=fcd8549dd5c8f0732c4e4d7167fc7f4e" alt="New patient redirected to Lead Tracker" width="1200" height="682" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/online_scheduling/online_scheduling_4.gif" />

If the New Patient Signup Destination is set to **Online Scheduling**, the patient can input their information into the sign-in page and access scheduling.

<Note>
  **Note:** After a user selects New Patient, inputs name, DOB, and phone, and completes 2FA, a new patient record is created automatically with this information. Users who do not complete scheduling or provide information such as insurance will still have a patient record created.
</Note>

### Existing patients

If **Existing Patient** is selected, the patient inputs their information into the sign-in page and accesses scheduling.

### Scheduling

Once patients have accessed the scheduling page, they select the following information to view available times:

* **Provider**
* **Location**
* **Appointment Type** — only External Appointment Types are shown (see [Reserve Blocks](/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks) for mapping details)
* **Insurance Type**
  * For **existing** patients, this list populates with their insurance options on file.
  * For **new** patients, this list populates with Self Pay automatically. They can search for their payer name based on the available payers for the practice.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/CMxc2caAxucpIo-V/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/online_scheduling/online_scheduling_5.gif?s=3b1a6f9ef199d318c4ee085c3dab8ec6" alt="Existing patient scheduling with insurance lookup" width="1200" height="682" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/online_scheduling/online_scheduling_5.gif" />

Once a time is selected, the patient either confirms the appointment or fills out additional information:

**New patients** progress through 2 information update screens:

1. A **Patient Update** screen, where they add information like email address, home address, and confirm their personal details.

   <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/CMxc2caAxucpIo-V/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/online_scheduling/online_scheduling_6.gif?s=61b57539bf973df56e5075777b3fe95f" alt="Patient update screen" width="1200" height="682" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/online_scheduling/online_scheduling_6.gif" />

2. An **Insurance Update** screen, where they provide the specific details about their insurance and can upload pictures of their insurance card.

   <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/CMxc2caAxucpIo-V/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/online_scheduling/online_scheduling_7.gif?s=5a38292f199337bbf2f85bb390516aa2" alt="Insurance update screen with card upload" width="1200" height="1024" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/online_scheduling/online_scheduling_7.gif" />

This information automatically populates in their new patient profile. The patient then progresses to the confirmation screen.

**Existing patients** progress directly to the confirmation screen.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/CMxc2caAxucpIo-V/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/online_scheduling/online_scheduling_8.gif?s=7b4a594e244507679df81b4f9338f3db" alt="Existing patient confirming appointment" width="1200" height="682" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/online_scheduling/online_scheduling_8.gif" />

## Security and privacy

Because the online scheduling link can be accessed online by any party, specific controls and security settings have been built in with privacy in mind. The following exceptions and blocks are handled:

### Existing patient mistyping information

If an existing patient mistypes a name or date of birth, a neutral message asks them to try again or register as a new patient.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/CMxc2caAxucpIo-V/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/online_scheduling/online_scheduling_9.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=CMxc2caAxucpIo-V&q=85&s=9792f8300ba682cf90c8d5e83a9b4c04" alt="Neutral &#x22;does not match any records&#x22; error" width="740" height="200" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/online_scheduling/online_scheduling_9.webp" />

**Note:** If an existing patient mistypes their phone number, they will not receive a 2FA code to their phone. The 2FA is sent to the number entered on the login screen, **not** any phone stored in patient records.

### Existing patient trying to use the New Patient flow

If a user attempts to log in as a New Patient with information matching an existing patient (name, DOB, **and** phone), a message tells them to proceed as an existing patient.

<Note>
  **Note:** This happens **after** they have completed their 2FA, to prevent a non-patient with someone else's information from determining whether that person is a patient of the practice.
</Note>

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/CMxc2caAxucpIo-V/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/online_scheduling/online_scheduling_10.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=CMxc2caAxucpIo-V&q=85&s=367744819cbc228896f4fcf7ecbd325f" alt="Prompt to proceed as existing patient" width="734" height="206" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/online_scheduling/online_scheduling_10.webp" />

### New patient trying to use the Existing Patient flow

If a new patient attempts to log in as an Existing Patient with information that does not match any patient at the practice, the same neutral "does not match any records" message is shown. They can retry with correct information or switch to the New Patient flow.

### Non-patient attempting to access existing patient information

If a non-patient attempts to log in with existing patient information, one of the following happens:

* **As an Existing Patient, entering the actual patient's phone number** — a 2FA is sent to the actual patient before any error or success messages are revealed. This prevents the non-patient from determining whether the individual is a patient at the practice.
* **As an Existing Patient, entering a different phone number** — a 2FA is sent to that number. After confirming, the user is shown a neutral "does not match any patient" message. This obscures whether the information was incorrect because of the mismatched phone number, or because the individual is not a patient at all.
* **As a New Patient, entering the actual patient's phone number** — same protection as above: a 2FA is sent to the actual patient first.
* **As a New Patient, entering a different phone number** — after confirming 2FA, the user is allowed to create a new patient profile. This does not expose whether that person is already an existing patient or not.

The full flow of potential login outcomes is shown in the chart below:

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/CMxc2caAxucpIo-V/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/online_scheduling/online_scheduling_11.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=CMxc2caAxucpIo-V&q=85&s=afddef320df1aed639a285875aabfca2" alt="Full login outcome flowchart" width="1410" height="1370" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/online_scheduling/online_scheduling_11.webp" />

### FAQ

<Accordion title="What URL do patients use to reach Online Scheduling?">
  Patients go to `portal.athelas.com/site/{site_slug}`, where `{site_slug}` is the **Site Slug** you set in **Portal Configs → Online Patient Scheduling**. Share this link on your website, in SMS/email campaigns, or via QR code.
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="How do I prevent patients from booking directly without staff review?">
  Turn on **New Patient Appointment Scheduling** to route new-patient bookings to the **Requests** tab for approval. For existing patients, use the broader **Require approval on appointment requests** setting under Portal Configs.
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="Can new patients choose any payer?">
  Yes. New patients see **Self Pay** by default, but can search for their payer from the list of payers configured for your practice. The insurance details they provide populate their newly created patient profile.
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="What stops someone from probing the system to learn who's a patient?">
  Multiple safeguards: 2FA is always sent to the phone number the user enters (not a stored number); neutral error messages are used across all mismatch scenarios; the "you should proceed as existing patient" prompt only appears after 2FA completes. See the flowchart above for the complete set of branches.
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="Why would I route New Patients to Lead Tracker instead of Online Scheduling?">
  Routing to **Lead Tracker** is useful when you want to triage new patients before confirming an appointment — for example, to verify insurance eligibility, apply intake rules, or assign a specific provider. Routing to **Online Scheduling** is faster for practices that accept any new patient who meets their appointment criteria.
</Accordion>

## Waitlist

> Source: https://docs.athelas.com/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/waitlist.md

# Waitlist

> Configure and manage appointment waitlists, offers, and patient responses in Air.

The Waitlist feature helps practices fill open schedules faster and more efficiently. Patients can join the waitlist through the Athelas Patient Portal when they cannot find an available time, and provide appointment preferences and time preferences for offered slots.

Practices can also manually add patients to the waitlist in Insights directly. When cancellations occur, the waitlist automatically processes the list and offers the open slot to matching patients. Sites can configure several settings — such as the number of patients to send offers to, the amount of time to accept, and whether offers expire. Once the waitlist begins, it continues running until either a patient accepts the slot, or there are no more patients matching the available timeslot.

## Joining the Waitlist from the Athelas Patient Portal

When a patient uses the Athelas Patient Portal to schedule an appointment, they must specify a **provider**, **facility**, and **appointment type** before seeing available times.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP/images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/waitlist/waitlist_1.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP&q=85&s=3ce72b1f4bde4563911159428af8327f" alt="Patient selects provider, facility, appointment type" width="988" height="1394" data-path="images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/waitlist/waitlist_1.webp" />

If no times are available (because of a full schedule, reserve blocks that do not match the patient's preferences, or the provider is out of the office), the patient is presented with the option to **Join Waitlist**.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP/images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/waitlist/waitlist_2.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP&q=85&s=70b3a2f3e43cf285f59835b746d03b23" alt="Join Waitlist prompt" width="658" height="1418" data-path="images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/waitlist/waitlist_2.webp" />

After clicking **Join Waitlist**, the patient can specify a facility, one or multiple providers, and an appointment type, along with any preferred times. If any time will work, they can select **Anytime**.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP/images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/waitlist/waitlist_3.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP&q=85&s=fc0c199ccd774a90092840c01496828f" alt="Waitlist preferences form" width="1112" height="1614" data-path="images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/waitlist/waitlist_3.webp" />

Once submitted, a window appears above the patient's appointments showing they have a waitlist entry in place. They can **Edit** the waitlist entry here, or exit the waitlist if desired.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP/images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/waitlist/waitlist_4.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP&q=85&s=8056fe559bf478ac0c850fe78c0cb3a1" alt="Waitlist entry window in patient portal" width="1288" height="676" data-path="images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/waitlist/waitlist_4.webp" />

## External & Internal Appointment Types

As part of using the Waitlist, practices can map multiple **internal appointment types** (visible to internal personnel) to a single **external appointment type** (visible to patients). When patients are added to the Waitlist, they're offered only the external appointment types — reducing confusion about which option to select.

To edit the mappings:

1. **Navigate to Calendar Preferences.**

   <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/ViVUq-_zQhUkNOUA/images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/waitlist/waitlist_5.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=ViVUq-_zQhUkNOUA&q=85&s=79ee14743c427d2cde6ab2aaf43ac472" alt="EHR navigation with Preferences highlighted" width="460" height="674" data-path="images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/waitlist/waitlist_5.webp" />

2. **Open the Appointment Types tab.**

   <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/ViVUq-_zQhUkNOUA/images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/waitlist/waitlist_6.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=ViVUq-_zQhUkNOUA&q=85&s=83e496835306f61f7fe06a8fca684230" alt="Appointment Types tab showing internal and external appointment type tables" width="1188" height="1380" data-path="images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/waitlist/waitlist_6.webp" />

3. **Create or edit external appointment types** — pick which internal appointment types map to each external one. You can also choose a **Default Internal Appointment Type**, which determines the internal type used when automatic scheduling is on. An internal appointment type can only be mapped to a single external appointment type, ensuring there's no confusion about what the patient sees.

   <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/ViVUq-_zQhUkNOUA/images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/waitlist/waitlist_7.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=ViVUq-_zQhUkNOUA&q=85&s=a73b58419d7b82fe086b63256fc36732" alt="Create External Appointment Type modal with mapped internal types" width="1446" height="1642" data-path="images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/waitlist/waitlist_7.webp" />

## Adding a patient to the waitlist from Insights

If a patient does not have access to the Patient Portal, or the site wishes to add the patient themselves, a patient can be manually added to the waitlist from the Insights Calendar.

1. **Navigate to the Requests tab** in the header bar of the Calendar view.

   <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/vwFklSqhLnQdOwy0/images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/waitlist/waitlist_8.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=vwFklSqhLnQdOwy0&q=85&s=f3d3c3c511dcc66a632ee6b87c93ff06" alt="Requests tab in the Calendar header bar" width="818" height="244" data-path="images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/waitlist/waitlist_8.webp" />

2. **Click Add to Waitlist** at the bottom of the drawer. All current waitlist entries and approval requests appear here. Expired requests are excluded from the current list.

   <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/vwFklSqhLnQdOwy0/images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/waitlist/waitlist_9.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=vwFklSqhLnQdOwy0&q=85&s=e2f7cb3414cf135cbba1c6cf36766c55" alt="Add to Waitlist button" width="880" height="1632" data-path="images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/waitlist/waitlist_9.webp" />

3. **Edit the patient and their appointment preferences** — including provider, facility, appointment type, effective and expiration dates, notes, and preferred availability.

   <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/vwFklSqhLnQdOwy0/images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/waitlist/waitlist_10.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=vwFklSqhLnQdOwy0&q=85&s=160c188a981f5b30174069869ca50b56" alt="Edit patient waitlist preferences" width="1238" height="1528" data-path="images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/waitlist/waitlist_10.webp" />

4. **Confirm.** The patient appears at the bottom of the existing waitlist entries.

   <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/vwFklSqhLnQdOwy0/images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/waitlist/waitlist_11.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=vwFklSqhLnQdOwy0&q=85&s=06d5643a3a285223964dd5b1e56bfe29" alt="Patient added at bottom of waitlist" width="840" height="220" data-path="images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/waitlist/waitlist_11.webp" />

5. **Manage entries** — click **Edit** to update an existing waitlist entry, or click the **X** on the right to remove an entry.

6. **Hover over the (i) icon** to see the details of the waitlist entry. Click the **notes icon** to edit the entry's notes directly.

   <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/vwFklSqhLnQdOwy0/images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/waitlist/waitlist_12.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=vwFklSqhLnQdOwy0&q=85&s=2208d57d0bf0436a214a54c35ae32f9a" alt="Hover icon reveals waitlist entry details" width="1050" height="658" data-path="images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/waitlist/waitlist_12.webp" />

## Processing cancellations from the waitlist

When an appointment is cancelled, you are prompted with a popup informing you that there are waitlist entries matching that timeslot. You can either:

1. **Send the waitlist offers** and start the waitlist processing, or
2. **Skip Waitlist Offers** if you intend to fill that slot manually.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/ViVUq-_zQhUkNOUA/images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/waitlist/waitlist_13.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=ViVUq-_zQhUkNOUA&q=85&s=83b6728afa0506d8e14ad2bbe27355d7" alt="Cancellation popup with waitlist entries" width="1014" height="568" data-path="images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/waitlist/waitlist_13.webp" />

If you choose to start the waitlist, one or multiple patients matching the timeslot, provider, and location are sent a text and email informing them they have been offered a waitlist slot. The message states how much time they have to accept the offer.

<Columns cols={2}>
  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/ViVUq-_zQhUkNOUA/images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/waitlist/waitlist_14.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=ViVUq-_zQhUkNOUA&q=85&s=0d2f2df2af5f025ab8bfb910031cc50a" alt="Waitlist offer SMS" title="Waitlist offer — SMS" width="512" height="820" data-path="images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/waitlist/waitlist_14.webp" />

  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/ViVUq-_zQhUkNOUA/images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/waitlist/waitlist_15.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=ViVUq-_zQhUkNOUA&q=85&s=679fdfcbedf127047593cad058579d67" alt="Waitlist offer email" title="Waitlist offer — email" width="1818" height="1076" data-path="images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/waitlist/waitlist_15.webp" />
</Columns>

When a patient clicks the link in their offer message, they are brought to a screen to confirm the appointment information and officially accept the offer. They can also reject the offer if that time no longer works.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/ViVUq-_zQhUkNOUA/images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/waitlist/waitlist_16.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=ViVUq-_zQhUkNOUA&q=85&s=e5ead17ba05d8225e907cf4eccfd736f" alt="Patient accept/reject offer screen" width="2854" height="1614" data-path="images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/waitlist/waitlist_16.webp" />

The patient has a set amount of time to respond before the offer expires and the next entry is offered the slot. The service continues moving down the list in configurable size batches until a patient accepts, or no further entries match the available slot.

If the original patient attempts to access the offer link after it expires (or after another patient has accepted it), they are shown a message explaining the offer has expired.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/ViVUq-_zQhUkNOUA/images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/waitlist/waitlist_17.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=ViVUq-_zQhUkNOUA&q=85&s=eb499b83c9500ad8ee5aeeec4097c856" alt="Expired offer message" width="2846" height="1610" data-path="images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/waitlist/waitlist_17.webp" />

If the site requires approval for appointment requests, an accepted waitlist offer converts to an appointment request in the **Requests** tab. Otherwise, the waitlist offer automatically converts into a scheduled appointment.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/ViVUq-_zQhUkNOUA/images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/waitlist/waitlist_18.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=ViVUq-_zQhUkNOUA&q=85&s=348b77fe606d295bfc491edf75391ce1" alt="Accepted offer converted to appointment" width="852" height="906" data-path="images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/waitlist/waitlist_18.webp" />

## Manually triggering waitlist from the calendar

You can also manually trigger the waitlist on an open slot directly from the calendar. Highlight a section of time and choose **Trigger Waitlist Offers**. From there, you can select a range of time to include when finding offers, and see how many patients will be included in the waitlist offer list.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/CAtgd1jZrb26dp7J/images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/waitlist/waitlist_21.gif?s=c05d1f5c7baf199a622e13034a8a627e" alt="Manually triggering waitlist offers from the calendar" width="900" height="621" data-path="images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/waitlist/waitlist_21.gif" />

## Waitlist settings and configurations

Several settings allow sites to adjust waitlist behavior. These are accessible in the **EHR Preferences** page, in the **Calendar** tab.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/ViVUq-_zQhUkNOUA/images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/waitlist/waitlist_19.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=ViVUq-_zQhUkNOUA&q=85&s=f6007e591152bb7e449043791745c8b3" alt="Waitlist settings in Calendar preferences" width="2318" height="284" data-path="images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/waitlist/waitlist_19.webp" />

The available preferences include:

* **Waitlist on/off** — whether the site will allow waitlist entries to be created by patients or site staff.
* **Require approval on waitlist requests** — when on, all promotions from the waitlist to an appointment must be approved before being scheduled. This overrides the normal appointment-approval configuration.
* **Cancel future appointment if waitlist slot has been scheduled** — when on, the system detects if a patient has a future appointment matching the waitlist offer. When they schedule a new appointment through their waitlist offer, the very next appointment is cancelled.
* **Minimum time to fill a newly opened slot with a waitlist patient** — how far out a cancelled appointment must be to offer the slot to a waitlist entry. For example, if the minimum is 30 minutes, cancelling at 8:50 AM for a 9:00 AM appointment will not send any waitlist offer.
* **Same-patient waitlist offer exclusion period** — how much time must pass between waitlist offers for a single patient, to avoid sending too many offers to the same patient when cancelling multiple appointments. For example, if set to 1 hour and a patient receives a waitlist offer at 9:15 AM, they cannot receive another offer until 10:15 AM — even if they decline the first offer.
* **Time to accept by patient** — how much time a batch of patients has to respond to their offer. If they do not accept in this time, the next batch of patients is sent the offer as well.
* **Waitlist bucket size** — the number of patients sent an offer in each batch. If set to `1`, behavior is one-at-a-time (Patient A, then B, then C). If set to `>1`, behavior is a "blast" send (Patients 1–10, then 11–20, then 21–30).
* **Retain waitlist requests for future** — when on, accepting a waitlist offer does **not** delete the waitlist entry. Instead, the patient moves to the back of the list. When off, accepting a waitlist offer deletes the entry, and the patient must add a new one to be considered for future offers.
* **Expire previous waitlist offers** — when on, moving from one batch of patients to the next causes the previous batch's offers to expire. When off, offers don't expire until a patient accepts. For example, if time-to-accept is 5 minutes, bucket size is 10, and expiration is off: minutes 0–10 there are 10 active offers; 11–20 there are 20 active offers; 21–30 there are 30 active offers, and so on.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/ViVUq-_zQhUkNOUA/images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/waitlist/waitlist_20.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=ViVUq-_zQhUkNOUA&q=85&s=b103d615d49d28049dbab5db6933f5fb" alt="Waitlist bucket / expiration timeline example" width="1202" height="1120" data-path="images/air_front_desk/view_your_calendar/waitlist/waitlist_20.webp" />

### FAQ

<Accordion title="What happens if no one accepts a waitlist offer?">
  The system continues moving through the list in configurable batch sizes until a patient accepts or no more entries match the slot. If everyone passes, the slot remains open on the calendar — you can fill it manually or leave it for direct scheduling.
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="Can the same patient get multiple offers for different slots?">
  Yes — but only after the **Same-patient waitlist offer exclusion period** elapses. This prevents flooding a single patient with offers when multiple cancellations happen close together.
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="Should I use bucket size 1 or a larger batch?">
  Bucket size `1` is fairest — the first patient in line gets first pick. Larger buckets fill cancellations faster because the "blast" reaches many patients at once, but the earliest-queued patient may lose out to someone faster to respond. Pick based on whether speed-to-fill or queue fairness matters more for your practice.
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="What's the difference between waitlist offers and appointment requests?">
  A **waitlist offer** is initiated by the system after a cancellation — the patient chose to be waitlisted. An **appointment request** is initiated by the patient directly through the portal or online scheduling. When **Require approval on waitlist requests** is on, accepted waitlist offers still need staff approval before booking.
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="Can patients remove themselves from the waitlist?">
  Yes. From their portal, patients can edit their preferences or exit the waitlist entirely. Staff can also remove entries from the **Requests** tab by clicking the **X** on the right side of the entry.
</Accordion>

## Reserve Blocks

> Source: https://docs.athelas.com/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks.md

# Reserve Blocks

Reserve Blocks allow your practice to restrict the types of appointments that can be scheduled based on a set of criteria. Supported criteria include **appointment type**, **insurance type**, and **affected providers**.

When a reserve block is created on a provider's calendar, online scheduling through the Patient Portal only allows that time to be booked if the appointment criteria matches the reserve block. If an internal scheduler attempts to book on a reserve block with criteria that does not match, they are prompted with a warning. Reserve blocks also support non-blocking comments that can alert schedulers to important information about that provider or block.

## Creating a Reserve Block

Access the reserve-block creation drawer through either of the following:

**Option 1 — The Add button in the top right of the calendar view:**

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_1.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP&q=85&s=063743bc8fdc15180515770c9b4eff22" alt="Add button on calendar" width="714" height="686" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_1.webp" />

**Option 2 — Directly in a calendar slot:**

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_2.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP&q=85&s=d3fa6cd782b72427945f08a80cb66a69" alt="Create reserve block directly in slot" width="686" height="1090" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_2.webp" />

<Warning>
  Reserve blocks added from the **Add** button, or while in the **All Selected** facility view, will add the reserve block to <u>all</u> facilities in the active filter. To add a reserve block to just a single facility, add it directly in the calendar slot while viewing that single facility.
</Warning>

From the reserve-block drawer, define the desired criteria:

### Timing properties

1. **Date** of the block (pre-populated if accessing directly from a calendar slot).
2. **Start** and **end** times (pre-populated if accessing directly from a calendar slot).
3. Whether to **repeat** the block, with frequency: Once, Daily, Weekly (SMTWTFS), Monthly, on Weekdays, or on Weekends.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_3.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP&q=85&s=e95a3d18766504e0d33dde8cfb05198f" alt="Timing and repeat options" width="1186" height="646" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_3.webp" />

### Scheduling criteria

* **Appointment Types** (optional, multi-select)
* **Insurance Companies** (optional, multi-select)
* **Providers** (required, multi-select)

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_4.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP&q=85&s=f004d10eeb8cd1cda1aff947164d204b" alt="Scheduling criteria with multi-select" width="1170" height="913" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_4.webp" />

### Overlapping logic

You can configure whether reserve blocks allow overlapping appointments in their timeslot. This can be **general** (across all appointment types and insurance types) or **specific** to a single insurance type or appointment type.

For example, a reserve block could allow double-booking at maximum on the timeslot. However, if a patient tries to book Iowa Medicare or Utah Medicare, they cannot double-book over another patient. Similarly, if an Iowa Medicare or Utah Medicare patient is already booked in that timeslot, no other appointments can book at that time.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_5.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP&q=85&s=49dc9b3253915dfa37a30ad76d690bf5" alt="Overlapping logic configuration" width="568" height="369" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_5.webp" />

**To save and add the reserve block to the calendar, click Create Reserve Block.**

## Viewing reserve block details

Once a reserve block has been created, it can be viewed on the calendar with the scheduling criteria and any **Notes** that have been added. Overlapping logic for any specific appointment type or insurance type is shown in parentheses next to the type (e.g., `(1)`). The max overlapping for the entire block is shown at the bottom.

<Columns cols={2}>
  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_6.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP&q=85&s=cebbd3767c11865b1b2c82f660ec413a" alt="Reserve block view — standard" title="Reserve block — standard view" width="410" height="908" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_6.webp" />

  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_7.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP&q=85&s=5ef81ddb5eef4aafc46afcb54a69e83f" alt="Reserve block view — compressed" title="Reserve block — compressed view" width="292" height="238" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_7.webp" />
</Columns>

Hovering over or clicking the reserve block displays more detailed information about the block, and provides options to edit the block or schedule on top of it.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_8.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP&q=85&s=718fea01c05faf0f19778416b6006799" alt="Reserve block hover detail" width="678" height="1114" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_8.webp" />

## Reserve block color system

If a single Appointment Type is included in the scheduling criteria, the block has the same color boundary as the appointment type.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_9.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP&q=85&s=e716b5a40a084ea949091ac79ca23dca" alt="Reserve block color matching appointment type" width="1002" height="428" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_9.webp" />

If no Appointment Types are selected, or multiple Appointment Types are selected, the boundary defaults to black.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_10.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP&q=85&s=f219f4bd3a8c95412af4e3b04cdae9d8" alt="Reserve block with black boundary" width="796" height="968" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_10.webp" />

You can also select a specific color boundary when creating or editing the block to override the default color combinations. If an overriding color is chosen, it continues to apply to the reserve block regardless of appointment type changes.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_11.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP&q=85&s=a4d9cd79c19ce167476d3f02911ee377" alt="Reserve block custom color override" width="950" height="690" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_11.webp" />

## External and internal appointment types

As part of Reserve Blocks, you can map multiple **internal** appointment types (visible to internal personnel) to a single **external** appointment type (visible to patients). When patients schedule in the Athelas Patient Portal, they are offered only the external appointment types, which reduces confusion on which option to select.

**To edit the mappings:**

1. Navigate to **Calendar Preferences**.

   <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_12.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP&q=85&s=54c02b3ab83d800dba3641e9fb5e5ed9" alt="Calendar Preferences" width="460" height="674" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_12.webp" />

2. Navigate to the **Appointment Types** tab.

   <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_13.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP&q=85&s=98c32454076a83b6da993e604931552d" alt="Appointment Types tab" width="1188" height="1380" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_13.webp" />

From here, you can create new External Appointment Types and choose which Internal Appointment Types map to them. You can also choose a **default internal mapping**, which determines which internal appointment type is selected when automatic scheduling is on.

<Note>
  **Note:** Internal appointment types can only be mapped to a single external appointment type, to ensure there is no confusion about what the patient sees.
</Note>

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_14.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP&q=85&s=100c2a37adbb1cb20a38b7d4e93625e9" alt="External-to-internal appointment type mapping" width="1446" height="1642" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_14.webp" />

From the Patient Portal, only created External Appointment Types are visible for scheduling. This allows practices to both restrict the possible booking types and simplify the scheduling process for patients. For instance, a practice may want to maintain multiple internal types of initial evaluations (`IE Knee`, `IE Lumbar`, `IE Lower Extremity`), while providing patients with only one external type (`Initial Evaluation`).

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_15.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP&q=85&s=65a830318b72ac7f849fd797e0cf45c7" alt="Patient portal view of external appointment types" width="954" height="322" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_15.webp" />

## Scheduling from the Insights Calendar

When scheduling from the Athelas Patient Portal during a reserve block, appointments that meet the scheduling criteria are accepted as normal. The appointment displays inside the frame of the reserve block.

When scheduling an appointment that does **not** meet the scheduling criteria, the user is presented with an alert informing them of the conflict. They can either confirm an override of the reserve block or cancel the scheduling.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_16.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP&q=85&s=01cdf7ce54339bd4237ff1fa509fcf95" alt="Reserve block override alert" width="1218" height="816" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_16.webp" />

If the user overrides the reserve block, the appointment visually splits the reserve block into two separate sections on either side. Canceling the conflicting appointment re-merges the reserve block into a single frame.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_17.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP&q=85&s=2689a66cf9a9a5bb0d535ce7e3d7ec2b" alt="Reserve block split after override" width="758" height="996" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_17.webp" />

## Scheduling from the Athelas Patient Portal

When scheduling from the Athelas Patient Portal, the available times shown to patients are filtered to only show times that:

1. Do not have any reserve blocks on them, **or**
2. Have reserve blocks that match the patient's desired appointment:
   * For any criteria **not** specified in the reserve block, all values are accepted (e.g., if no insurance is a criterion, any insurance is accepted).
   * For any criteria that **are** specified, one of the selected options must match the patient's preference in the portal (e.g., if `Aetna` and `BCBS` are criteria, only patients with Aetna or BCBS see those times).

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_18.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP&q=85&s=6a2a40fb906cd3ed8d69fd89cad1bef3" alt="Matching examples" width="1062" height="1520" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_18.webp" />

If **Approval for appointment requests** is turned **off**, the appointment is automatically scheduled and placed in the calendar.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_19.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP&q=85&s=cdbbdbe26dad110a80a1b975adc687fe" alt="Auto-scheduled appointment inside reserve block" width="1396" height="300" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_19.webp" />

If **Approval for appointment requests** is turned **on**, the request appears in the **Requests** tab in the bottom-right corner of the Calendar view.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_20.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP&q=85&s=f4103e55c911f1a5f58c123d2c215122" alt="Request in Requests tab" width="300" height="160" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_20.webp" />

The **Pending Approval** also shows within the reserve block to indicate that a patient has requested that slot:

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_21.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP&q=85&s=abd20e73d2ea639eb0cdcc86f8ced765" alt="Pending approval indicator within reserve block" width="362" height="694" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_21.webp" />

From either the **Requests** tab or by directly clicking the Pending Approval modal, the user is presented with a screen to approve the request. The patient's details are shown, as well as the external appointment type they requested.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_22.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP&q=85&s=f432d6f7efade3e79f1a25a34c0dde98" alt="Approval screen with patient + external type" width="1810" height="1100" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_22.webp" />

When choosing an internal appointment type to schedule against, the internal appointment types that map to the requested external appointment type appear first in the list.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP/images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_23.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=m4xIdyZvtDVetvuP&q=85&s=15037583d7bdbd413c6a34d787676843" alt="Internal appointment type list — mapped types first" width="902" height="720" data-path="images/air_front_desk/portal_and_online_scheduling/reserve_blocks/reserve_blocks_23.webp" />

Once an internal appointment type is selected and a case is applied, the appointment can be approved and scheduled.

### FAQ

<Accordion title="What's the difference between a reserve block and a schedule block?">
  A **schedule block** prevents all bookings in a time window. A **reserve block** is selective — it only allows bookings that match the configured criteria (appointment type, insurance, provider). Think of schedule blocks as "closed" and reserve blocks as "reserved for specific types of visits."
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="Can I still book over a reserve block if I need to?">
  Yes. When you schedule an appointment that doesn't match the criteria, you'll see an override alert. Confirming the override splits the reserve block around the new appointment. Canceling the new appointment re-merges the reserve block.
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="Why would I need external vs. internal appointment types?">
  Internal types capture operational detail ("IE Knee," "IE Lumbar") that matters for your staff's workflow. External types hide that complexity from patients, who only need to pick "Initial Evaluation." The external-to-internal mapping drives which internal type the system picks when a patient books online.
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="What happens if I add a reserve block in the All Selected facility view?">
  The block applies to **all** facilities in the active filter. To restrict a reserve block to just one facility, switch to that facility's view first, then click directly into a calendar slot to create it.
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="Does the reserve block color follow the appointment type if I change the criteria later?">
  Only if you haven't set a custom color. If you pick a specific color override, that color sticks regardless of future appointment-type changes. Remove the override to return to the auto-matching behavior.
</Accordion>

## Prepare for the Appointment

> Source: https://docs.athelas.com/air_front_desk/take_in_a_patient/prep_appt.md

# Prepare for the Appointment

### <Icon icon="calendar-circle-user" iconType="duotone" color="#F9345F" size={23} />  Edit an Appointment

<Card title>
  Click on an appointment to open the Appointment details pop-up.

  Click on the edit (pencil) icon on the top right to edit appointment details entered (such as data, time, provider, facility, patient details).

  You can also review patient demographics by clicking on the patient's name, see change logs of the appointment.

  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/DrWmF2QHSQhYusvP/images/air_front_desk/take_in_a_patient/prep_appt/prep_appt_1.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=DrWmF2QHSQhYusvP&q=85&s=a3062cde4020709cc99c8b1e225015d6" alt="Appt Status Web" width="1890" height="1068" data-path="images/air_front_desk/take_in_a_patient/prep_appt/prep_appt_1.webp" />
</Card>

### <Icon icon="timer" iconType="duotone" color="#F9345F" size={23} />  Change Appointment Status

<Card title>
  Click on the three vertical dots on the top right of the page. From here you can:

  * Add a Follow-up Appointment → This will open up a new appointment pop-up to fill
  * Check-in the patient
  * Cancel the appointment → You will be prompted to add a cancellation reason which will be available to view on the Patient’s Profile under the Appointments Tab.
  * Mark the appointment as a No Show
  * Delete the appointment
  * See Schedule → You can see all upcoming appointments for the patient

      <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/DrWmF2QHSQhYusvP/images/air_front_desk/take_in_a_patient/prep_appt/prep_appt_4.gif?s=205db9e609ecd8bae7d701352bb22227" alt="11 Editappt Gi" width="1920" height="1016" data-path="images/air_front_desk/take_in_a_patient/prep_appt/prep_appt_4.gif" />

  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/DrWmF2QHSQhYusvP/images/air_front_desk/take_in_a_patient/prep_appt/prep_appt_1.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=DrWmF2QHSQhYusvP&q=85&s=a3062cde4020709cc99c8b1e225015d6" alt="Update Status Web" title="Update Status Web" style={{ width:"58%" }} width="1890" height="1068" data-path="images/air_front_desk/take_in_a_patient/prep_appt/prep_appt_1.webp" />

  **Note**: The **Encounter Details** tab (under Daily Operations) in the left navigation bar shows all encounters and their statuses (Open, Closed, In Progress, Blocked, Archived). From here you can bulk update statuses or edit encounter details.
</Card>

### <Icon icon="file-waveform" iconType="duotone" color="#F9345F" size={23} />  Send Reminders & Intake Forms

<Card title>
  If an appointment is scheduled more than 24 hours in advance, patient intake forms are sent automatically 24 hours before the appointment. If it’s scheduled within 24 hours, you’ll need to manually send the forms.

  From the appointment details, click **Send** next to Reminders/Forms.

  * Select individual forms or workflows (groups of forms).
  * Send via text, email, or both (auto-populated based on what is set within Patient Demographics)
  * However, you are able to change the email or phone number directly in this window.

  **Note**: You can send **Functional Outcome Measurement Forms** as well through this flow

  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/DrWmF2QHSQhYusvP/images/air_front_desk/take_in_a_patient/prep_appt/prep_appt_4.gif?s=205db9e609ecd8bae7d701352bb22227" alt="14 Sendforms Gi" width="1920" height="1016" data-path="images/air_front_desk/take_in_a_patient/prep_appt/prep_appt_4.gif" />

  **Note:** You can select multiple forms but only one workflow. **Workflows** automate which forms/reminders are sent, to whom, and when.

  \*\*Patient Portal: \*\*Patients can review the forms and reminders from the Patient Portal. Through this they can complete actions directly from replying to messages, paying charges, confirming/canceling appointments, accessing home exercise programs and filling out forms.

  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/DrWmF2QHSQhYusvP/images/air_front_desk/take_in_a_patient/prep_appt/prep_appt_1.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=DrWmF2QHSQhYusvP&q=85&s=a3062cde4020709cc99c8b1e225015d6" alt="Patient Portal Web" title="Patient Portal Web" style={{ width:"52%" }} width="1890" height="1068" data-path="images/air_front_desk/take_in_a_patient/prep_appt/prep_appt_1.webp" />
</Card>

### <Icon icon="bell-exclamation" iconType="duotone" color="#F9345F" size={23} />  Track Prior Authorizations

<Card title>
  You can check the status of Prior Authorizations, number of visits left and link an existing authorization or add a new authorization if required.

  Click on **+New Prior Auth**  to add a Pre-Certification or Referral along with the Authorization number, # visits, effective to and from date.

  You can also edit an existing authorization or delete it. If you delete an authorization you will still be able to restore it.

  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/DrWmF2QHSQhYusvP/images/air_front_desk/take_in_a_patient/prep_appt/prep_appt_4.gif?s=205db9e609ecd8bae7d701352bb22227" alt="15 Priorauth Gi" width="1920" height="1016" data-path="images/air_front_desk/take_in_a_patient/prep_appt/prep_appt_4.gif" />

  **Tracking Prior Auth Status:**

  * To review all prior authorizations open the **Encounter Details** tab (under Daily Operations) in the left navigation bar. You can filter all encounters by **Has Prior Auth** as True or False to find all encounters in a given data range that are missing prior authorization or where the visit count is nearing zero.

  * Further, you can click the checkmark list icon on the top right of the page to view all prior authorizations (referrals and pre-certifications). Results can be filtered, downloaded, edited, or deleted.

      <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/DrWmF2QHSQhYusvP/images/air_front_desk/take_in_a_patient/prep_appt/prep_appt_2.jpeg?fit=max&auto=format&n=DrWmF2QHSQhYusvP&q=85&s=26db8fad88c85e5042572042b090435c" alt="Prior Auth Track Jpe" width="1940" height="1290" data-path="images/air_front_desk/take_in_a_patient/prep_appt/prep_appt_2.jpeg" />

  * From here you can filter based on the expiration date to see if prior auths need to be updated based on the remaining visit count.

      <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/DrWmF2QHSQhYusvP/images/air_front_desk/take_in_a_patient/prep_appt/prep_appt_2.jpeg?fit=max&auto=format&n=DrWmF2QHSQhYusvP&q=85&s=26db8fad88c85e5042572042b090435c" alt="Auth Expiry Jpe" width="1940" height="1290" data-path="images/air_front_desk/take_in_a_patient/prep_appt/prep_appt_2.jpeg" />
</Card>

### <Icon icon="bell-exclamation" iconType="duotone" color="#F9345F" size={23} />  Track Visit Alerts

<Card title>
  Air will automatically alert you when prior authorizations or visit counts are nearing expiration/limits.

  * **Orange alert** = nearing expiration
  * **Red alert** = expired or no visits left

  **Updating visit limits:** You can manually update the visit counts for the given options and create **custom** visit counts if needed.

  * Click on the edit icon next to a visit count to update it
  * For a custom visit count: Edit the Annual visit limit > Add a service type and # visits
  * Click on custom start date to start the visit count from a date that is not the date of appointment

      <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/DrWmF2QHSQhYusvP/images/air_front_desk/take_in_a_patient/prep_appt/prep_appt_2.jpeg?fit=max&auto=format&n=DrWmF2QHSQhYusvP&q=85&s=26db8fad88c85e5042572042b090435c" alt="Visit Count1 Jpe" title="Visit Count1 Jpe" style={{ width:"41%" }} width="1940" height="1290" data-path="images/air_front_desk/take_in_a_patient/prep_appt/prep_appt_2.jpeg" />

  **Expanding this section provides a detailed view, including:**

  * Annual Appointment limits
  * Prior authorization visits
  * Plan of Care visits
  * Medicare thresholds
  * Progress note upcoming (e.g., every 10 visits, every 45 days)
  * Future appointments scheduled

      <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/DrWmF2QHSQhYusvP/images/air_front_desk/take_in_a_patient/prep_appt/prep_appt_4.gif?s=205db9e609ecd8bae7d701352bb22227" alt="16 Visitalerts Gi" width="1920" height="1016" data-path="images/air_front_desk/take_in_a_patient/prep_appt/prep_appt_4.gif" />

  You can customize these limits to be hard alerts or soft alerts from **Preferences**.

  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/DrWmF2QHSQhYusvP/images/air_front_desk/take_in_a_patient/prep_appt/prep_appt_1.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=DrWmF2QHSQhYusvP&q=85&s=a3062cde4020709cc99c8b1e225015d6" alt="Chart Note Limits Web" width="1890" height="1068" data-path="images/air_front_desk/take_in_a_patient/prep_appt/prep_appt_1.webp" />

  <Info>
    **FAQ: The visit counter is not accurate for a patient:**

    * Check if the same prior authorization is attached to all past visits
    * Ensure all previous chart notes are completed, else they may not be accounted within the visits counter
  </Info>
</Card>

### <Icon icon="money-check-dollar" iconType="duotone" color="#F9345F" size={23} />  Conduct Eligibility Checks

<Card title>
  Air runs eligibility checks one week and one day before each appointment. Results are updated to **Active** or **Inconclusive.** You can re-run checks anytime from the appointment details.
</Card>

### <Icon icon="money-bills" iconType="duotone" color="#F9345F" size={23} />  Review Patient Balances

<Card title>
  View and charge outstanding balances from the appointment details. Clicking **Charge** routes you to the Daily Operations > Appointments page to finalize payment.

  You can choose the mode of communication, payment method, payment amount and also send a welcome message.

  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/DrWmF2QHSQhYusvP/images/air_front_desk/take_in_a_patient/prep_appt/prep_appt_1.webp?fit=max&auto=format&n=DrWmF2QHSQhYusvP&q=85&s=a3062cde4020709cc99c8b1e225015d6" alt="Charge Appt Web" title="Charge Appt Web" style={{ width:"81%" }} width="1890" height="1068" data-path="images/air_front_desk/take_in_a_patient/prep_appt/prep_appt_1.webp" />
</Card>

### <Icon icon="calendar-arrow-down" iconType="duotone" color="#F9345F" size={23} /> Print Appointment Schedules

<Card title=" ">
  There are 2 ways to download the appointment schedule for a patient:

  **From the calendar**

  * Go to the Calendar > Open an appointment > click on the caret icon in the tooltip to open the appointment details
  * Click on the 3 dots on the top right > Select "See Schedule"

      <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/DrWmF2QHSQhYusvP/images/air_front_desk/take_in_a_patient/prep_appt/prep_appt_2.jpeg?fit=max&auto=format&n=DrWmF2QHSQhYusvP&q=85&s=26db8fad88c85e5042572042b090435c" alt="Appt Schedule1 Jpe" title="Appt Schedule1 Jpe" style={{ width:"62%" }} width="1940" height="1290" data-path="images/air_front_desk/take_in_a_patient/prep_appt/prep_appt_2.jpeg" />
  * Click print to download the schedule. It will include the list of upcoming appointments for the patient, facility address and phone number

      <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/DrWmF2QHSQhYusvP/images/air_front_desk/take_in_a_patient/prep_appt/prep_appt_2.jpeg?fit=max&auto=format&n=DrWmF2QHSQhYusvP&q=85&s=26db8fad88c85e5042572042b090435c" alt="Appt Schedule2 Jpe" width="1940" height="1290" data-path="images/air_front_desk/take_in_a_patient/prep_appt/prep_appt_2.jpeg" />

  **From the patient profile**

  * Go to the patient's profile > Appointments
  * Click on the print icon on the top right
  * This will print the list of appointments (upcoming and completed) for the patient, status of appointment, provider, date and facility address.

      <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/DrWmF2QHSQhYusvP/images/air_front_desk/take_in_a_patient/prep_appt/prep_appt_2.jpeg?fit=max&auto=format&n=DrWmF2QHSQhYusvP&q=85&s=26db8fad88c85e5042572042b090435c" alt="Appt Schedule3 Jpe" width="1940" height="1290" data-path="images/air_front_desk/take_in_a_patient/prep_appt/prep_appt_2.jpeg" />

## Check-in the Patient

> Source: https://docs.athelas.com/air_provider/check_in_a_patient/check_in.md

# Check-in the Patient

At the time of consultation, you can check in your patient and prepare for the visit.

### <Icon icon="comment-check" iconType="duotone" color="#F9345F" size={23} />  Automatic check-in with Athelas AI

<Card title=" ">
  <Danger>
    ✨**Smart Tip:** Go to **Athelas AI** → Enter your prompt → Athelas AI will check in the patient and open their chart note and/or patient details automatically. You can also use Voice Mode.
  </Danger>

  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/6hQzJrk7rDj1b_aq/images/air_provider/check_in_a_patient/check_in/check_in_1.gif?s=039a0c3d3ebe2a0903521652b699c10e" alt="9 Ai Checkin Gi" width="1920" height="1080" data-path="images/air_provider/check_in_a_patient/check_in/check_in_1.gif" />

  **Note**: To check in an Appointment a [Case Type](/air_provider/check_in_a_patient/edit_appt#change-the-case-type) must be present. If no case is associated, you will receive an error when attempting to check in.

  **Note:** When you open the Chart Note, you may have Visit alerts that are required to be addressed before you progress.
</Card>

### <Icon icon="clipboard-check" iconType="duotone" color="#F9345F" size={23} />  Manual check-in

<Card title=" ">
  Open the **Calendar** → Click on the desired **Appointment** → Select **Check-in** for the patient on the Tooltip.

  You can also update the appointment status to **Completed, No Show, Canceled,** or **Archived**.

  **Note**: You can also "uncheck-in" the patient if checked-in by mistake.

  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/6hQzJrk7rDj1b_aq/images/air_provider/check_in_a_patient/check_in/check_in_1.gif?s=039a0c3d3ebe2a0903521652b699c10e" alt="8 Checkin Options Gi" width="1920" height="1080" data-path="images/air_provider/check_in_a_patient/check_in/check_in_1.gif" />

  **Alternate method**: Navigate to **Patients** tab in the left navigation bar → Open the **Appointments** Tab → Select **Check in** (black square icon)
</Card>

### <Icon icon="tablet-screen-button" iconType="duotone" color="#F9345F" size={23} />  Self-service check-in on the kiosk

<Card title=" ">
  Patients can also check themselves in on a lobby tablet, confirming their details and insurance, completing outstanding intake forms, and paying what they owe before they sit down. See [Check-in Patient with Kiosk](/air_provider/check_in_a_patient/kiosk_user_guide) for setup and the full patient workflow.
