## Getting Started as a Biller

> Source: https://docs.athelas.com/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_biller.md

# Getting Started as a Biller

> Everything you need to start processing claims efficiently—from filtering your queue to submitting with confidence.

# Getting Started with the Claims Page

The Claims Page is where you'll spend most of your time managing your claim workflow. It's designed to help you work faster with fewer errors by giving you powerful tools for filtering, reviewing, and submitting claims.

Here's what you'll learn:

* How to find the claims you need to work on
* How to review and fix claims quickly
* How to submit claims with confidence
* How to work with your team

## Find What You Need to Work On

The Claims Page shows you all encounters in your system. With thousands of claims, the key is filtering down to exactly what you need right now.

### <Icon icon="filter" iconType="duotone" color="#F9345F" size={23} />  Use filters to focus your work

Click **Filter** at the top of the page to narrow down your list. You can filter by:

* **Encounter Status** - Draft, Ready for Review, Approved, Submitted, Paid, Denied
* **Assignment** - Claims assigned to you, others, or unassigned
* **Insurance Provider** - Specific payers
* **Claim Amount** - Dollar value ranges
* **Age** - How long the claim has been in the system
* **Date Ranges** - Creation, submission, or payment dates

Combine multiple filters to get exactly what you need. For example: "Show me all Blue Cross claims over \$500 that are ready for review."

### <Icon icon="bookmark" iconType="duotone" color="#F9345F" size={23} />  Save views for quick access

Once you've set up filters you use regularly, save them as views.

1. Apply your filters and column settings
2. Click **Save View** in the top right
3. Give it a descriptive name like "My High Value BCBS Claims"

Your saved views appear in the **Views** dropdown and persist across sessions. Each team member creates their own views based on how they work.

**Common views to start with:**

* Filter for claims assigned to you + status "Ready for Review" or "Approved"
* Filter for unassigned claims to pick up new work
* Filter for recent denials to work through corrections

### <Icon icon="user-check" iconType="duotone" color="#F9345F" size={23} />  Assign claims to track ownership

Every claim should have an owner. This prevents duplicate work and ensures nothing falls through the cracks.

**To assign a claim to yourself:**

1. Find the claim in your list
2. Click the **Assigned To** dropdown
3. Select your name

The claim now appears in any "assigned to you" filtered views you've created.

**To assign multiple claims at once:**

1. Select the checkboxes next to multiple claims (or click the header checkbox to select all visible)
2. Click **Bulk Actions**
3. Choose **Assign** and select the team member

This is useful for distributing work across your team or picking up batches of unassigned claims.

***

## Review and Fix Claims

When you're ready to work on a claim, click it to open the encounter details. Most of your work happens on the **Content** tab.

### <Icon icon="clipboard-check" iconType="duotone" color="#F9345F" size={23} />  What to check on every claim

Before submitting, verify:

* **Patient demographics** - Name, DOB, address, insurance details
* **Date of service** - Correct and matches documentation
* **Provider information** - Correct provider and facility NPI
* **Diagnosis codes** - Support the procedures billed
* **Procedure codes** - Match services provided
* **Units and charges** - Accurate for the services

### <Icon icon="sparkles" iconType="duotone" color="#F9345F" size={23} />  Let AI help you catch errors

The system automatically validates every claim and helps you fix issues before submission.

**Sparkles (✨) show where AI improved your claim**

When you see sparkles next to a field, AI made a change to maximize reimbursement or ensure compliance. Common improvements:

* Corrected zip codes or addresses
* Added required modifiers to procedure codes
* Updated place of service codes
* Suggested better-matching diagnosis codes

Click the sparkle to see what changed and why. Accept if it makes sense, reject if it doesn't apply to this case.

**Error flags show what needs fixing**

Red or yellow flags indicate problems that will cause rejections:

* Missing required fields (DOB, insurance ID, provider NPI)
* Invalid diagnosis or procedure codes
* Conflicting information

Fix these immediately. The claim can't be submitted until all flags are resolved.

**Blocking rules prevent bad submissions**

If a critical issue will definitely cause denial, the system blocks submission entirely:

* Missing required information in critical fields
* CHC compliance violations (for federally qualified health centers)
* Known payer rejection patterns based on historical data
* Internal rules your organization has configured

You'll see a clear error message explaining what needs fixing. If you can't fix it immediately, assign it to someone who can.

### <Icon icon="magnifying-glass" iconType="duotone" color="#F9345F" size={23} />  Preview before submitting

Click **Preview** to see exactly what will be sent to the payer. You can view it in standard format or PDF. This is your last chance to catch any issues before the claim goes out.

On the **Submissions** tab, you'll see "X rules applied" showing which billing rules were automatically applied to optimize your claim. Click to review the logic behind each rule.

### <Icon icon="comment-dots" iconType="duotone" color="#F9345F" size={23} />  Get help when you need it

**Ask Athelas Assistant**

Click the **Athelas Assistant** button to ask questions about the claim. Examples:

* "Why would this diagnosis code be rejected?"
* "What's the correct way to code this for Blue Cross?"
* "Does this procedure require a modifier?"

Athelas Assistant understands the claim context and provides guidance on coding guidelines and payer rules.

**Collaborate with your team**

Some claims need input from others. Use the **Activity** section to:

* See all recent changes and who made them
* Add comments and @mention specific team members
* Reply to questions and document decisions

All communication stays with the claim, so context doesn't get lost.

***

## Submit with Confidence

Once you've fixed all errors, reviewed AI changes, and previewed the claim, you're ready to submit.

### <Icon icon="paper-plane" iconType="duotone" color="#F9345F" size={23} />  Submit the claim

1. Click **Submit** at the top of the encounter details page
2. Review the confirmation dialog (payer, amount, procedures)
3. Click **Confirm Submission**

You'll see "Claim successfully submitted" and the status updates to **Submitted**.

**What happens next:**

* **1-3 days** - Payer acknowledges receipt
* **14-30 days** - Payer processes the claim
* **30-45 days** - You receive payment or denial

Return to your Claims Page and move to the next claim in your queue.

***

## Handle Denials

Denials happen. When they do, your goal is to understand why, fix the issue, and resubmit quickly.

### <Icon icon="triangle-exclamation" iconType="duotone" color="#F9345F" size={23} />  Find your denials

Filter by **Status: Denied** to see all rejected claims. Sort by:

* **Claim amount (highest first)** - Tackle high-dollar denials first
* **Denial date (oldest first)** - Avoid timely filing limits
* **Payer** - Spot patterns in rejection reasons

If you see the same denial reason across multiple claims from one payer, flag this pattern to your team lead.

### <Icon icon="wrench" iconType="duotone" color="#F9345F" size={23} />  Fix and resubmit

1. Open the denied claim
2. Go to **Payment Overview** to see the denial code and reason
3. Check **Remittances** for the full ERA with additional details
4. Make corrections based on the denial reason
5. Document your changes in the Activity Feed
6. Resubmit following the same process

Common denial reasons and fixes:

* **Missing/invalid information** - Add missing demographics, insurance details, or authorization numbers
* **Coding errors** - Correct diagnosis or procedure codes, add required modifiers
* **Duplicate claim** - Verify if already paid or add note explaining it's not a duplicate
* **Medical necessity** - Add documentation or escalate to provider
* **Timely filing** - Document original submission date if submitted on time

**Note:** Timely filing deadlines are strict (typically 60-90 days from date of service). If you're approaching the deadline, prioritize that claim immediately.

***

## Understanding Claim Statuses

As claims move through your workflow, they'll have different statuses:

| Status               | What It Means                          | What To Do                       |
| -------------------- | -------------------------------------- | -------------------------------- |
| **Draft**            | Incomplete information                 | Complete missing fields          |
| **Ready for Review** | Complete and waiting for biller review | Review for accuracy, fix errors  |
| **Approved**         | Reviewed and ready to submit           | Final verification, then submit  |
| **Submitted**        | Sent to payer                          | Monitor for response             |
| **Paid**             | Payment received                       | Reconcile and close              |
| **Denied**           | Rejected by payer                      | Review reason, correct, resubmit |

***

### FAQ

<Accordion title="Which claims should I work on first?" iconType="regular">
  Prioritize in this order:

  1. **High-value claims nearing timely filing deadlines** - Sort by claim amount and age
  2. **Claims from your top payers** - Where most of your revenue comes from
  3. **Recent denials** - Still have time to correct and resubmit
  4. **Older claims (10+ days)** - Prevent aging out

  Create saved views for each priority level and switch between them as you work.
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="What if AI suggests something I know is wrong?" iconType="regular">
  This happens. AI uses general rules but you have payer-specific knowledge.

  1. Click the sparkle and select **Reject**
  2. Make the correct change manually
  3. Add a comment explaining why: "Rejected AI suggestion. This payer requires modifier XU per their 2024 policy."

  If you see AI consistently wrong for a specific payer, report it to your team lead. Good billers reject 5-10% of AI suggestions based on their expertise.
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="Should I submit claims with error flags?" iconType="regular">
  No. Error flags indicate problems that will likely cause denials.

  Fix all flags before submission. The extra 2-3 minutes now saves 20-30 minutes of denial rework later. If you can't fix a flag, assign the claim to someone who can.
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="How do I collaborate with my team on a claim?" iconType="regular">
  Use the **Activity** section within the encounter details:

  * Add comments to ask questions or flag issues
  * @mention specific team members to notify them
  * Review the change history to see what others have done

  All communication stays with the claim so context doesn't get lost.
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="Can I customize what columns I see?" iconType="regular">
  Yes. Click the **Columns** button at the top of the Claims Page to choose which fields to display. Your column preferences save with your custom views.

  Common column setups:

  * For submission work: Patient, DOS, Provider, Amount, Status, Assigned To
  * For denials: Patient, Payer, Denial Reason, Denial Date, Amount
</Accordion>

***

That's it. You now know how to find claims, review them efficiently, submit with confidence, and handle denials. Start by creating your first saved view and working through a few claims to get comfortable with the workflow.

---

## Getting started as a Healthcare Provider

> Source: https://docs.athelas.com/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider.md

# Getting started as a Healthcare Provider

> Learn how to document patient encounters, record clinical notes, and complete chart notes efficiently using Insights

Welcome to Insights! This guide helps you master the essential workflows for documenting patient encounters and completing chart notes efficiently.

## What you'll accomplish

By the end of this guide, you'll know how to:

* Open chart notes from appointments or patient profiles
* Record patient conversations using Air Scribe
* Document clinical measurements, goals, and treatment plans
* Create and manage chart note templates
* Complete and submit chart notes for billing

## Understanding Chart Notes

Chart Notes are the core workflow for documenting patient encounters in Insights. Each chart note captures everything needed for clinical documentation and billing, including:

* **Plan of Care** - Treatment frequency, duration, and visit count
* **Measurements** - Clinical measurements and assessments
* **Goals** - Patient treatment objectives and outcomes
* **Treatments** - CPT codes and interventions

<Info>
  Chart Notes streamline your documentation workflow by organizing all encounter information in one place, reducing time spent on administrative tasks and ensuring complete documentation for billing.
</Info>

## Prerequisites

Before you begin documenting encounters, ensure you have:

* Access to Insights
* An appointment scheduled or checked in for the patient
* A patient case assigned to the appointment (required for check-in)
* Patient insurance information available

## Open a Chart Note

You can access chart notes from two locations: appointments or patient profiles. Choose the method that fits your workflow.

### Open from an Appointment

Use this method when you're working directly with appointments in your calendar or schedule.

<Steps>
  <Step title="Check in the appointment">
    Check in the appointment to enable chart note access. You must complete this step before you can open the chart note.

    <Frame>
      <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/915xroKn7USNTAO-/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_1.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=915xroKn7USNTAO-&q=85&s=b3a85df74b10d73ae86badb0b8cf0229" alt="Appointment check-in interface showing required fields" width="792" height="1612" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_1.png" />
    </Frame>

    <Warning>
      A Case must be present before you can check in an appointment. If no case is assigned, you'll receive an error when attempting to check in. Add the relevant case via the dropdown menu or create a new case for the appointment.
    </Warning>
  </Step>

  <Step title="Complete required fields">
    Fill the following required fields before checking in:

    * **Case** - Patient case associated with the appointment
    * **Appointment Type** - Type of visit
    * **Facility** - Location where the appointment takes place
    * **Insurance** - Patient's insurance information
  </Step>

  <Step title="Open the chart note">
    Click the box icon with an arrow in the top right corner to open the chart note.

    <Frame>
      <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/99P00O4pCQBLKhRs/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_5.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=99P00O4pCQBLKhRs&q=85&s=8e79ae50ad4727f456a62d168598acff" alt="Checked-in appointment with chart note icon visible" width="1576" height="586" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_5.png" />
    </Frame>

    <Check>
      The chart note opens and displays setup buttons for configuring your encounter structure.
    </Check>
  </Step>
</Steps>

### Open from Patient Profile

Use this method when you need to access a patient's chart note from their profile, useful for reviewing previous encounters or accessing notes for walk-in patients.

<Steps>
  <Step title="Navigate to the patient">
    Click **Patients** in the left-hand menu and search for the patient by name.

    <Frame>
      <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/99P00O4pCQBLKhRs/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_3.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=99P00O4pCQBLKhRs&q=85&s=95d8b44c61693261aa0232eacc3a00eb" alt="Patients page with search functionality" width="3014" height="814" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_3.png" />
    </Frame>
  </Step>

  <Step title="Access the Appointments tab">
    The system automatically routes you to the Appointments page of the patient's profile.

    <Frame>
      <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/99P00O4pCQBLKhRs/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_4.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=99P00O4pCQBLKhRs&q=85&s=73952dec5009079ee45a9ca3b3846d28" alt="Patient profile showing appointments list" width="3678" height="834" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_4.png" />
    </Frame>
  </Step>

  <Step title="Check in or open the chart note">
    * If the appointment is scheduled, click the checkmark to check in the patient
    * If the appointment is already checked in, click the box icon with an arrow to open the chart note

    <Check>
      The chart note opens and you can begin documenting the encounter.
    </Check>
  </Step>
</Steps>

<Info>
  When you first open a chart note, you'll see setup buttons that allow you to configure the base structure for your encounter.
</Info>

<Frame>
  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/99P00O4pCQBLKhRs/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_6.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=99P00O4pCQBLKhRs&q=85&s=40938e0bee4aa1b4ebe11cac3f4c6d50" alt="Chart note interface with setup buttons" width="3018" height="776" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_6.png" />
</Frame>

## Record patient conversations with Air Scribe

Air Scribe automatically transcribes your patient conversations and populates the encounter note, saving you time on documentation while ensuring accuracy. Think of Air Scribe as a digital transcription assistant that listens to your conversations and converts them into structured clinical notes.

<Steps>
  <Step title="Start recording">
    Click the **Athelas AI** button in the bottom right corner. A window opens with the option to **Start Recording**. Click it to activate Air Scribe.

    <Frame>
      <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/99P00O4pCQBLKhRs/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_7.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=99P00O4pCQBLKhRs&q=85&s=20e8e07bf06a793a6cbac00e1148b357" alt="Athelas AI button and recording interface" width="902" height="1196" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_7.png" />
    </Frame>

    <Check>
      The recording interface appears and Air Scribe is ready to capture your conversation.
    </Check>
  </Step>

  <Step title="Record your conversation">
    Begin recording your conversation with the patient. While the Air Scribe widget is open, you can:

    * Navigate to other EHR pages in Insights and continue recording in the background
    * Click **Minimize** to minimize the widget while it continues recording

    <Warning>
      You cannot navigate to non-EHR pages while recording. End or cancel the recording first if you need to leave the EHR.
    </Warning>

    <Frame>
      <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/99P00O4pCQBLKhRs/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_8.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=99P00O4pCQBLKhRs&q=85&s=020b833ea2294f9bb2e8b8b2f87486f8" alt="Recording interface with minimize option" width="932" height="1050" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_8.png" />
    </Frame>
  </Step>

  <Step title="End recording">
    When you're ready to upload the recording, click **End Recording**.

    <Frame>
      <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/99P00O4pCQBLKhRs/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_9.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=99P00O4pCQBLKhRs&q=85&s=10cbde805341d806e5c715ff9c25795e" alt="End recording button and upload process" width="1044" height="422" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_9.png" />
    </Frame>

    <Check>
      The recording uploads successfully and processing begins.
    </Check>
  </Step>

  <Step title="Wait for processing">
    After the recording uploads successfully, the system generates a scribe from your recording. This process takes some time. You can:

    * Wait for processing to complete
    * Close the window and continue with other tasks

    <Frame>
      <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/915xroKn7USNTAO-/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_10.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=915xroKn7USNTAO-&q=85&s=24df5a53ce824ec871fb29245a3ab1fc" alt="Processing status screen" width="902" height="996" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_10.png" />
    </Frame>
  </Step>

  <Step title="Review and add the scribe">
    Once processing completes, click **View Scribe** to review the generated outputs and add them to your chart note.

    <Check>
      The scribe appears in your chart note with transcribed conversation content ready for review and editing.
    </Check>
  </Step>
</Steps>

## Add measurements to chart notes

Measurements capture clinical assessments and are organized by category for easy access. Adding measurements ensures your documentation includes all required clinical data and helps track patient progress over time.

<Frame>
  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/915xroKn7USNTAO-/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_11.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=915xroKn7USNTAO-&q=85&s=68062c4c873061330b5233df4587b056" alt="Measurements section in chart note" width="3690" height="1174" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_11.png" />
</Frame>

<Frame>
  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/915xroKn7USNTAO-/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_12.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=915xroKn7USNTAO-&q=85&s=53c595733e59f0139f5672b3f35e6698" alt="Categorized measurements display" width="568" height="732" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_12.png" />
</Frame>

### How measurements are organized

Clicking on measurements displays them in categorized order:

* **Grouped measurements** (e.g., LE Neuro Exam) appear together
* **Ungrouped measurements** (marked as "No Associated Group") appear at the bottom
* Click an individual measurement to add it to the chart note
* Click the **+** icon next to a group name to add all measurements within that group

<Tip>
  You can view the history of measurements and pull data from previous chart notes if measurements exist for the patient. This saves time when documenting follow-up visits and helps you track changes over time.
</Tip>

<Frame>
  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/915xroKn7USNTAO-/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_13.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=915xroKn7USNTAO-&q=85&s=0bbc57ecc73a755cb40ea0d57c27879c" alt="Measurement history and previous note data options" width="1089" height="180" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_13.png" />
</Frame>

## Set patient treatment goals

Goals track patient treatment objectives and outcomes, helping you monitor progress and document treatment plans effectively. Unlike measurements which capture current clinical status, goals define what you and the patient aim to achieve.

<Steps>
  <Step title="Add a goal">
    Click **+ Add Goal** in the Goals section. Alternatively, click the curled arrow icon to pull goals from the previous chart note.

    <Frame>
      <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/915xroKn7USNTAO-/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_14.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=915xroKn7USNTAO-&q=85&s=e6c45f10f6be9e02aa0c627f3d169df8" alt="Goals section with add goal button" width="3058" height="1044" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_14.png" />
    </Frame>
  </Step>

  <Step title="Enter goal details">
    A window opens where you can input goal information. Enter the details and click **Add Goal** at the bottom of the window.

    <Frame>
      <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/915xroKn7USNTAO-/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_15.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=915xroKn7USNTAO-&q=85&s=fb4d1a609bad519ff257c3af3bfd2ddb" alt="Goal entry form with fields for goal details" width="955" height="880" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_15.png" />
    </Frame>

    <Check>
      The goal appears in the Goals section of your chart note.
    </Check>
  </Step>
</Steps>

<Note>
  Air Scribe can automatically detect goals from your transcription and extract values and specifications, reducing manual data entry.
</Note>

## Create a Plan of Care

The Plan of Care defines treatment frequency, duration, and visit count for the patient, ensuring accurate documentation of the treatment plan. This differs from goals (which define objectives) and measurements (which capture current status) by specifying the treatment schedule and timeline.

<Frame>
  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/915xroKn7USNTAO-/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_16.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=915xroKn7USNTAO-&q=85&s=0944bd840c50083618c3c42704e5d729" alt="Plan of Care form with input fields" width="2934" height="694" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_16.png" />
</Frame>

### Plan of Care fields

When selecting Plan of Care, you'll be prompted to input:

* **Start Date** - When treatment begins
* **End Date** - When treatment concludes
* **Frequency + Units** - How often treatment occurs
* **Duration + Units** - Length of treatment period
* **Visit Count** - Total number of visits

<Tip>
  You don't need to fill all fields manually. If you enter duration + units, frequency + units, and start date, the system auto-populates the end date and visit count. You can override these values if needed.
</Tip>

<Note>
  Click the curled arrow icon to pull Plan of Care data from the previous chart note, saving time on follow-up visits.
</Note>

<Frame>
  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/915xroKn7USNTAO-/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_17.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=915xroKn7USNTAO-&q=85&s=b3e4d5efb9e2265cd0bf1e39b578419e" alt="Plan of Care with previous note data option" width="540" height="246" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_17.png" />
</Frame>

## Create Home Exercise Programs (HEP)

Create home exercise programs by selecting interventions marked as `HEP`. This feature helps you provide patients with clear exercise instructions they can reference at home, improving patient compliance and outcomes.

<Steps>
  <Step title="Select HEP interventions">
    Click the checkbox for any intervention marked as `HEP`. This adds it to a staging area where you can prepare the Home Exercise Program.

    <Frame>
      <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/915xroKn7USNTAO-/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_18.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=915xroKn7USNTAO-&q=85&s=04c99e65eaa48e53440e25e89a79949e" alt="HEP checkbox selection interface" width="1796" height="784" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_18.png" />
    </Frame>
  </Step>

  <Step title="Add intervention notes">
    Click the caret for HEP to open a dropdown where you can assign additional notes to the HEP section on a per-intervention basis.

    <Frame>
      <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/915xroKn7USNTAO-/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_19.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=915xroKn7USNTAO-&q=85&s=59ec59771591b061201eae8fd3e09e9a" alt="HEP dropdown with notes assignment" width="1970" height="710" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_19.png" />
    </Frame>
  </Step>

  <Step title="Preview and send">
    Click **Preview and Send** to email, text, or print the PDF of the Home Exercise Program.

    <Frame>
      <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/915xroKn7USNTAO-/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_20.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=915xroKn7USNTAO-&q=85&s=89cb0b91d119954f3ed8244c5c75aab6" alt="HEP preview and send options" width="2348" height="1450" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_20.png" />
    </Frame>

    <Check>
      The patient receives the Home Exercise Program via their preferred method (email, text, or print).
    </Check>
  </Step>
</Steps>

## Document with templates

Templates are your primary tool for documenting information during patient encounters. They include SOAP notes, initial evaluations, and other specialized fields categorized under **Selected Sections**, helping you maintain consistent documentation standards. Unlike free-form notes, templates provide structure that ensures all required information is captured.

<Frame>
  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/915xroKn7USNTAO-/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_21.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=915xroKn7USNTAO-&q=85&s=571d9a2ea2ed769bae48be396fd255f0" alt="Templates section showing SOAP notes and other templates" width="2000" height="981" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_21.png" />
</Frame>

### Template features

Templates support Air Scribe input, allowing you to dictate directly into template fields, which speeds up documentation while maintaining structure.

  </Step>

  <Step title="Confirm deletion">

### Delete templates

  </Step>

  <Step title="Confirm deletion">

## Track compliance with checkmarks

Compliance checkmarks track specific details that must be captured within the chart note, helping you ensure complete documentation. They can be configured for any template in Insights. Unlike templates which provide structure, compliance checkmarks verify that required information is actually filled in.

<Frame>
  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/99P00O4pCQBLKhRs/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_26.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=99P00O4pCQBLKhRs&q=85&s=e0519bac71fc734ac603a44a876fc60f" alt="Compliance checkmarks showing grey and green status indicators" width="2128" height="1110" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_26.png" />
</Frame>

### How compliance checkmarks work

* **Grey checkmark** - The required detail has not been captured
* **Green checkmark** - The required detail has been captured

You can complete compliance checkmarks by either typing information directly or using Air Scribe.

<iframe className="w-full aspect-video rounded-xl" src="https://www.loom.com/embed/032d1ead44ad4444b9a00374d2de5163?sid=6a6039ae-0cff-430e-9289-18b135137e54" title="Compliance checkmarks tutorial" frameBorder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture" allowFullScreen />

<iframe className="w-full aspect-video rounded-xl" src="https://www.loom.com/embed/50bbe7ac7e6d421ab5f7d7386a84c044?sid=8bdddc49-dc0f-4841-a162-9f88dc7c88a6" title="Compliance checkmarks advanced features" frameBorder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture" allowFullScreen />

## Add treatments and CPT codes

Select treatments according to their corresponding CPT codes to ensure accurate billing and documentation of services provided. Treatments differ from interventions (which are exercises or procedures) by being tied to specific billing codes.

<Frame>
  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/99P00O4pCQBLKhRs/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_27.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=99P00O4pCQBLKhRs&q=85&s=4efe0829ddd49de05daed08e6dc3d722" alt="Treatments section with CPT code selection" width="2578" height="864" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_27.png" />

### Treatment features

* **Add Interventions** - Specify exercises associated with the given treatment
* **Edit Billing** - Click **Edit** under the billing section to modify insurance priority and billing information

<Frame>
  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/99P00O4pCQBLKhRs/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_28.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=99P00O4pCQBLKhRs&q=85&s=2e565b019a3ed6a3c13aa963335d3f7e" alt="Billing section with edit option" width="3002" height="750" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_28.png" />
</Frame>

### Add co-signers

<Steps>
  <Step title="Add additional providers">
    Navigate to the **Additional Providers** section and select providers from the dropdown menu to co-sign the note.

    <Frame>
      <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/99P00O4pCQBLKhRs/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_29.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=99P00O4pCQBLKhRs&q=85&s=7b5e7b9f47c8725398e182a27046972a" alt="Additional Providers section with dropdown" width="2996" height="428" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_29.png" />

    <Check>
      The provider is added to the co-signer list.
    </Check>
  </Step>

  <Step title="Request fax signature">
    To fax the encounter to a referring provider for co-signature:

    1. Select their name in the dropdown menu
    2. Enter their fax number
    3. Ensure the **Request Signature** checkbox is selected

    <Check>
      The fax request is configured and ready to send.
    </Check>
  </Step>
</Steps>

### Send to individual fax number

Use this method when you need to send a chart note to a specific fax number that isn't associated with a provider in the system.

<Steps>
  <Step title="Select fax option">
    Select **Send to individual fax number** and enter the fax number.

    <Frame>
      <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/99P00O4pCQBLKhRs/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_30.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=99P00O4pCQBLKhRs&q=85&s=7a406a309024a22f97129fc0dd67aa0c" alt="Send to individual fax number option" width="3018" height="404" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_30.png" />
    </Frame>
  </Step>

  <Step title="Send fax">
    Click **Send Fax** after entering the fax number.

    <Check>
      The fax is sent successfully to the specified number.
    </Check>
  </Step>
</Steps>

## Sign and submit the chart note

Complete the encounter by signing the note and submitting it as a claim. This finalizes your documentation and initiates the billing process.

<Steps>
  <Step title="Sign the note">
    Sign the note under the **Notarize** section.

    <Frame>
      <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/99P00O4pCQBLKhRs/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_31.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=99P00O4pCQBLKhRs&q=85&s=5a3702ce3359c5ffcf2117986eb3493c" alt="Notarize section with signature and submit button" width="3020" height="708" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider/getting_started_as_a_healthcare_provider_31.png" />
    </Frame>

    <Check>
      The note is signed and ready for submission.
    </Check>
  </Step>

  <Step title="Submit the claim">
    Click **Submit** to close the encounter and submit it as a claim.

    <Check>
      Your chart note is now complete and submitted. The encounter will be processed for billing.
    </Check>
  </Step>
</Steps>

## Troubleshooting

### Cannot check in appointment

**Problem:** You receive an error when trying to check in an appointment.

**Solution:** Ensure a Case is assigned to the appointment. If no case exists, add one via the dropdown menu or create a new case before checking in.

### Air Scribe not processing

**Problem:** The Air Scribe processing takes longer than expected or fails.

**Solution:**

* Ensure your internet connection is stable
* Check that the recording uploaded successfully
* If processing fails, try recording again
* Contact support if the issue persists

### Cannot submit chart note

**Problem:** The Submit button is disabled or you cannot submit the chart note.

**Solution:**

* Verify all required fields are completed
* Check that compliance checkmarks are green (if applicable)
* Ensure the note is signed
* Review any error messages displayed

### Measurements not appearing

**Problem:** Expected measurements don't appear in the measurements list.

**Solution:**

* Verify the measurements are configured for your practice
* Check that you're looking in the correct category
* Contact your administrator if measurements should be available but aren't showing

### FAQ

<AccordionGroup>
  <Accordion title="What's the difference between opening a chart note from an appointment versus a patient profile?">
    Opening from an appointment is faster when you're working directly with your schedule. Opening from a patient profile is better when you need to review previous encounters or access notes for walk-in patients who may not have scheduled appointments.
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="Can I edit a chart note after submitting it?">
    Once a chart note is submitted, it becomes a claim and cannot be edited directly. You may need to work with your billing team to make adjustments if changes are required.
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="How long does Air Scribe processing take?">
    Air Scribe processing typically takes 2-5 minutes, depending on the length of your recording. You can close the window and continue with other tasks while it processes in the background.
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="What's the difference between goals and measurements?">
    Goals define what you and the patient aim to achieve (future objectives), while measurements capture the patient's current clinical status (present assessments). Both are important for tracking progress.
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="Can I use Air Scribe with templates?">
    Yes, templates support Air Scribe input, allowing you to dictate directly into template fields. This speeds up documentation while maintaining the structured format templates provide.
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="What happens if I forget to complete a compliance checkmark?">
    Compliance checkmarks help ensure complete documentation. If a checkmark remains grey, your chart note may be incomplete. Review the requirements and fill in the missing information before submitting.
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="How do I know if my chart note is ready to submit?">
    Your chart note is ready to submit when:

    * All required fields are completed
    * Compliance checkmarks are green (if applicable)
    * The note is signed
    * You've reviewed all sections for accuracy
  </Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

## Getting Started as a Staff Member

> Source: https://docs.athelas.com/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member.md

# Getting Started as a Staff Member

> Learn how to add patients, manage appointments, and use the calendar as a staff member in Insights

Welcome to Insights! This guide covers everything you need to know to get started as a staff member, including adding patients, managing appointments, and navigating the calendar.

## Adding a new patient

<Steps>
  <Step title="Open the patient creation panel">
    Click the button to add a new patient. A side panel opens where you enter general patient demographics information.

    <Frame>
      <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/99P00O4pCQBLKhRs/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_1.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=99P00O4pCQBLKhRs&q=85&s=ce1497ec8d07d269df715bf6b6587422" alt="Patient creation side panel with demographics form" width="2880" height="1220" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_1.png" />
    </Frame>
  </Step>

  <Step title="Enter required patient information">
    Fill in the following required fields:

    * **Full Patient Name**
      * First and Last Name
      * Middle Name (if applicable)
    * **Gender**
    * **Date of Birth**
    * **Contact Information**
      * Home Address (Address Line(s), City, State, Post Code, and Country Code)
      * Mailing Address (if different from Home Address)
      * Phone Number
      * Email Address
  </Step>

  <Step title="Add insurance information">
    You can add insurance information, set up self-pay, or mark insurance as missing.

    <Frame>
      <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/99P00O4pCQBLKhRs/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_2.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=99P00O4pCQBLKhRs&q=85&s=d5cc82263107ed55054ae849e093653d" alt="Insurance information form with policy details" width="2880" height="874" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_2.png" />
    </Frame>

    **To add insurance:**

    1. Select an insurance company from the dropdown menu
    2. Enter the following information:
       * Policy Number
       * Group Number
       * Effective and expiration dates
       * Guarantor (relationship to policy holder)

    **If the relationship to policy holder is SELF:** Leave the guarantor field as is.

    **If the relationship to policy holder is not SELF:** Click the guarantor box and enter the policy holder's information:

    * First Name
    * Last Name
    * Email Address
    * Phone Number
    * Date of Birth
    * Gender
    * Home Address (Address Line(s), City, State, Postal Code, and Country Code)

    <Frame>
      <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/99P00O4pCQBLKhRs/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_3.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=99P00O4pCQBLKhRs&q=85&s=b6f2363f78bc852a44bf7df3a7036516" alt="Guarantor information form for non-self relationships" width="1028" height="932" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_3.png" />
    </Frame>

    <Tip>
      Click the "+" button to add additional insurance policies.
    </Tip>
  </Step>

  <Step title="Add worker's compensation information (if applicable)">
    When you add a worker's compensation insurance company, the payer type automatically changes to Worker's Compensation. You can also manually override the payer type to Worker's Compensation.

    The following additional fields populate when you select a worker's compensation insurance company:

    * Accident Date
    * Claim Number

    Fill out these fields with your patient's information.

    <Frame>
      <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/99P00O4pCQBLKhRs/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_4.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=99P00O4pCQBLKhRs&q=85&s=9e5950b0836c28f56a4a1e73832d011c" alt="Worker's compensation insurance form with accident date and claim number fields" width="2880" height="778" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_4.png" />
    </Frame>
  </Step>

  <Step title="Add self-pay or missing insurance">
    **To add Self-Pay:** Type "Self Pay" in the Insurance Company field. Upon selection, the insurance details disappear and only "Self-Pay (No Insurance)" remains.

    <Frame>
      <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/99P00O4pCQBLKhRs/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_5.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=99P00O4pCQBLKhRs&q=85&s=3bd20f322a86da2389c2a1f8a2ed682f" alt="Self-pay insurance option selected" width="1114" height="410" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_5.png" />
    </Frame>

    **To mark insurance as missing:** Type "Missing Insurance" in the Insurance Company field. Upon selection, the insurance details disappear and only "Missing Insurance" remains.

    <Frame>
      <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/99P00O4pCQBLKhRs/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_6.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=99P00O4pCQBLKhRs&q=85&s=ab6a1b9b6bfe5b29e7b346774fbffb87" alt="Missing insurance option selected" width="1102" height="372" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_6.png" />
    </Frame>
  </Step>

  <Step title="Create the patient">
    After entering all required and desired fields, click "Create" at the bottom of the panel.

    <Frame>
      <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/99P00O4pCQBLKhRs/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_7.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=99P00O4pCQBLKhRs&q=85&s=8ca1dc9cb9efae0fa1097e419036f598" alt="Create button at bottom of patient creation form" width="2880" height="1630" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_7.png" />
    </Frame>
  </Step>
</Steps>

## Adding cases, prior authorizations, and referring providers

After creating a patient, you can add prior authorizations, set insurance priority, create cases, and add referring providers.

<Steps>
  <Step title="Access patient demographics">
    Search for your patient and open their patient demographics page.

    <Frame>
      <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/99P00O4pCQBLKhRs/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_8.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=99P00O4pCQBLKhRs&q=85&s=8bf48400ffab2061520d730c13f9b0c0" alt="Patient demographics page with cases section" width="2880" height="958" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_8.png" />
    </Frame>
  </Step>

  <Step title="Create a case">
    Click "Create" under the Cases section. You can select insurance priority and enter the following fields:

    * Case Name
    * Referring Provider
    * Case Notes

    <Frame>
      <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/99P00O4pCQBLKhRs/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_9.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=99P00O4pCQBLKhRs&q=85&s=185a0adea814bfdacd6d352431b79674" alt="Case creation form with case name, referring provider, and case notes fields" width="2356" height="938" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_9.png" />
    </Frame>
  </Step>

  <Step title="Add prior authorization">
    Scroll down to the Prior Authorization section and click "+ New Prior Auth". A window opens in the middle of your screen where you can enter:

    * Auth Number
    * Total Number of Visits
    * Effective Date
    * Expiration Date
    * Insurance this Prior Auth is tied to

    Click "Create" after entering all desired information.

    <Frame>
      <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/99P00O4pCQBLKhRs/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_10.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=99P00O4pCQBLKhRs&q=85&s=69f12c5367032dbf1bd9257b08671df2" alt="Prior authorization section with new prior auth button" width="2434" height="1282" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_10.png" />
    </Frame>

    <Frame>
      <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/99P00O4pCQBLKhRs/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_11.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=99P00O4pCQBLKhRs&q=85&s=351419d8bc782eed6e70a3d426b9b914" alt="Prior authorization creation form with auth number, visits, dates, and insurance fields" width="2140" height="1446" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_11.png" />
    </Frame>
  </Step>

  <Step title="View patient attachments">
    The Attachments tab contains all attachments related to the patient. Intake forms automatically appear here, along with any uploaded scripts from chart notes.

    <Frame>
      <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/99P00O4pCQBLKhRs/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_12.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=99P00O4pCQBLKhRs&q=85&s=44e943bfedb88e3f8146ae0cc911c387" alt="Patient attachments tab showing intake forms and uploaded documents" width="2412" height="1200" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_12.png" />
    </Frame>
  </Step>
</Steps>

## Calendar walkthrough

The calendar provides a quick overview of your day at a glance, helping you spend less time deciphering schedules and more time assisting patients.

<Frame>
  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/99P00O4pCQBLKhRs/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_13.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=99P00O4pCQBLKhRs&q=85&s=b878c0dd94eabed17d63e457d6cda553" alt="Calendar view showing daily appointments and schedule" width="1288" height="972" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_13.png" />
</Frame>

### Accessing and filtering the calendar

<Steps>
  <Step title="Open the calendar">
    Click "Calendar" in the left-hand menu. To populate the calendar with information, click the filters icon in the top right corner.

    <Frame>
      <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/99P00O4pCQBLKhRs/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_14.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=99P00O4pCQBLKhRs&q=85&s=fe77e75fae17be2a6fb458455bf25bec" alt="Calendar page with filters icon in top right corner" width="2530" height="1180" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_14.png" />
    </Frame>
  </Step>

  <Step title="Apply filters">
    A side panel opens on the right with filter options. You can filter by:

    * Provider
    * Facility
    * Appointment Type
    * Insurance
    * Patient

    <Frame>
      <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/99P00O4pCQBLKhRs/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_15.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=99P00O4pCQBLKhRs&q=85&s=64980e3bc4da3ff108305c17c6369f34" alt="Filter side panel with provider, facility, appointment type, insurance, and patient options" width="492" height="1330" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_15.png" />
    </Frame>

    <Tip>
      You can select multiple providers and facilities to display on the calendar view.
    </Tip>
  </Step>
</Steps>

### Understanding schedule blocks

Each schedule block displays the following information:

* Case
* Eligibility status
* Payment Status
* Appointment status

<Frame>
  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/99P00O4pCQBLKhRs/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_16.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=99P00O4pCQBLKhRs&q=85&s=536ff0dd0912c40e425cfb6905bc2429" alt="Schedule block showing case, eligibility, payment, and appointment status" width="786" height="1340" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_16.png" />
</Frame>

**Hover actions:** When you hover over a calendar block, a popup appears with actions you can take:

* Edit the appointment
* Re-run eligibility
* Update appointment status (if not checked in)
* Add Prior Auth information
* Schedule future appointments
* Open the chart note

<Frame>
  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/99P00O4pCQBLKhRs/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_17.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=99P00O4pCQBLKhRs&q=85&s=e9e57a2eecdb1a69b3d7c9cd27946585" alt="Hover popup on calendar block showing available actions" width="1306" height="882" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_17.png" />
</Frame>

<Frame>
  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/99P00O4pCQBLKhRs/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_18.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=99P00O4pCQBLKhRs&q=85&s=ecdc4935a5ecfc2827494062611271ae" alt="Additional hover actions menu" width="978" height="816" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_18.png" />
</Frame>

**Click actions:** Click a schedule block to open a side menu with appointment details, including:

* General patient demographics
* Appointment Status
* Eligibility
* Patient Balances
* Referring Provider
* Reminders/Forms
* Check-In Status
* Prior Authorization for the patient's Primary Insurance
* Chart Note Status
* Appointment Type
* Provider
* Appointment Date and Time
* Facility
* Summary of the previous appointment

<Frame>
  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/99P00O4pCQBLKhRs/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_19.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=99P00O4pCQBLKhRs&q=85&s=d7340c1c10cdff740b7e0bcd6e0e738e" alt="Appointment detail side menu showing comprehensive appointment information" width="2016" height="1382" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_19.png" />
</Frame>

**Edit appointment:** Click the pencil icon at the top of the Appointment Detail side menu to edit appointment details.

<Frame>
  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/99P00O4pCQBLKhRs/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_20.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=99P00O4pCQBLKhRs&q=85&s=60e794a29ccc5a9e9a9904870b38efbb" alt="Pencil icon for editing appointment details" width="878" height="1184" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_20.png" />
</Frame>

**Additional actions:** Click the three vertical dots next to the appointment edit icon to:

* Add a follow-up appointment
* Check-In and Undo Check-In
* Cancel the appointment (you'll be prompted to enter a cancellation reason)
* Mark the appointment as No Show
* View the patient's entire schedule

<Frame>
  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/99P00O4pCQBLKhRs/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_21.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=99P00O4pCQBLKhRs&q=85&s=34d0f778de36a926e6e7ab38b768f826" alt="Three-dot menu with additional appointment actions" width="1528" height="746" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_21.png" />
</Frame>

## Creating appointments

You can create appointments using multiple methods. All methods open the same appointment creation side panel.

### Method 1: From the calendar header

Navigate to the calendar and click the "+ Create New" button in the top right corner of the screen.

<Frame>
  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/99P00O4pCQBLKhRs/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_22.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=99P00O4pCQBLKhRs&q=85&s=d76e020f7aceba80327e9e38bd57013a" alt="Create New button in calendar header" width="2402" height="570" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_22.png" />
</Frame>

### Method 2: From an empty calendar slot

Click any empty space in the calendar to create an appointment at that time.

<Frame>
  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/99P00O4pCQBLKhRs/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_23.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=99P00O4pCQBLKhRs&q=85&s=17e668d38f2b5d69de749a396d0663ee" alt="Empty calendar slot for creating appointment" width="710" height="1028" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_23.png" />
</Frame>

### Method 3: From patient appointments

Navigate to **Patients** and search for your patient's name. Click on "Appointments" after entering the patient's demographics. Click "+ New Appointment" or "Book Appointment" in the top right corner.

<Frame>
  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/99P00O4pCQBLKhRs/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_24.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=99P00O4pCQBLKhRs&q=85&s=e7fa231fb7541f86415d7b50a2747a8f" alt="Patient appointments page with new appointment button" width="3830" height="956" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_24.png" />
</Frame>

<Frame>
  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/99P00O4pCQBLKhRs/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_25.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=99P00O4pCQBLKhRs&q=85&s=4b75a7d901050ab236543c9f4ae05806" alt="New Appointment and Book Appointment buttons" width="2510" height="984" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_25.png" />
</Frame>

### Filling out appointment details

Regardless of which method you use, clicking "+ New Appointment" opens a side panel where you enter appointment information.

<Frame>
  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/99P00O4pCQBLKhRs/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_26.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=99P00O4pCQBLKhRs&q=85&s=1f9c48afab3a502cd460514aebab6420" alt="Appointment creation side panel with form fields" width="2494" height="1144" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_26.png" />
</Frame>

**Required fields:**

* Appointment Date
* Appointment Time
* Provider (Rendering)
* Patient
* Case
* Appointment Type
* Facility
* Format

**Optional fields:**

* Referring Provider
* Insurance priority for the appointment (you can sync this permanently to the case)
* Prior authorizations per insurance

<Frame>
  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/99P00O4pCQBLKhRs/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_27.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=99P00O4pCQBLKhRs&q=85&s=89e0efd444155300297529e7fff30546" alt="Appointment form showing optional fields for referring provider and prior authorizations" width="1918" height="1984" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_27.png" />
</Frame>

**Adding a referring provider:** The system uses the NPI registry to find and add referring providers. Type their NPI number into the search field and their information populates automatically.

<Frame>
  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/99P00O4pCQBLKhRs/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_28.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=99P00O4pCQBLKhRs&q=85&s=aeaee086a39b0e265f2489390b9f7af3" alt="Referring provider search field with NPI number lookup" width="1138" height="1800" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_28.png" />
</Frame>

Click "Create" at the bottom of the side panel to create the appointment.

## Faxing

You can bulk fax and download PDFs from the appointments table. All completed appointments have a checkbox next to them. You can:

* Check the box at the top of the appointments table to select all
* Uncheck any appointments you don't want to download or fax
* Check individual boxes next to specific appointments you want to download or fax

<Frame>
  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/99P00O4pCQBLKhRs/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_29.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=99P00O4pCQBLKhRs&q=85&s=8211094364a9a08eaff98a499e7cd4d6" alt="Appointments table with checkboxes for bulk fax and download" width="1010" height="890" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_29.png" />
</Frame>

<Frame>
  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/99P00O4pCQBLKhRs/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_30.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=99P00O4pCQBLKhRs&q=85&s=849ce401c5ffa5167cac7d0312bc5d9a" alt="Selected appointments ready for bulk fax or download" width="966" height="914" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_30.png" />
</Frame>

### Using the dedicated faxing page

While you can fax through the patient profile, there's also a dedicated faxing page for sending and receiving faxes. To access it:

1. Click **Utilities** in the left-hand menu
2. Select the **Faxing** section

<Frame>
  <img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/99P00O4pCQBLKhRs/images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_31.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=99P00O4pCQBLKhRs&q=85&s=4b0c53ed2d04b74aee2aa2b7469b5ac3" alt="Utilities menu with Faxing section highlighted" width="2074" height="1012" data-path="images/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_a_staff_member/getting_started_as_a_staff_member_31.png" />
</Frame>

### FAQ

<AccordionGroup>
  <Accordion title="What if I need to add multiple insurance policies for a patient?">
    Click the "+" button next to the insurance section to add additional insurance policies. You can add as many as needed for each patient.
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="How do I find a referring provider if I don't know their NPI number?">
    You need the NPI number to search for referring providers in the system. If you don't have it, you can look it up on the [NPI Registry](https://npiregistry.cms.hhs.gov/) website before adding the referring provider.
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="Can I edit an appointment after it's been created?">
    Yes. Click on the appointment in the calendar, then click the pencil icon in the Appointment Detail side menu to edit the appointment details.
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="What happens if I mark an appointment as No Show?">
    When you mark an appointment as No Show, it updates the appointment status. You can still view the appointment details and take other actions like rescheduling or adding notes.
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="How do I filter the calendar to see only specific providers?">
    Click the filters icon in the top right corner of the calendar, then select the providers you want to view. You can select multiple providers and facilities at once.
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="Where do patient intake forms appear?">
    Intake forms automatically appear in the patient's Attachments tab. You can access this tab from the patient demographics page.
  </Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

## Getting Started as an Owner/Administrator

> Source: https://docs.athelas.com/insights_onboard/getting_started_as_an_owneradministrator.md

# Getting Started as an Owner/Administrator

> Learn how to configure your practice preferences, set up providers, and manage essential settings in Insights

Welcome to Insights! This guide walks you through configuring your practice preferences and essential settings to get your practice up and running.

## Configure practice preferences

Set up your practice's preferences through each setting under the **Preferences** tab. These settings control how your practice operates and how your team interacts with the platform.

### General

Configure general practice settings that affect how modifiers, justifications, alerts, and calculations appear throughout the platform.

* Show or hide modifiers in various views
* Enable or disable justifications
* Configure alert settings
* Allow manual calculations
* Enable provider editing permissions

<Frame>

### FAQ

<AccordionGroup>
  <Accordion title="Where do I find the Preferences tab?">
    Navigate to the main menu and select **Preferences**. This tab contains all the settings you need to configure your practice.
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="Can I change preferences after initial setup?">
    Yes, you can modify any preference settings at any time. Changes take effect immediately and apply to future encounters and workflows.
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="Do preference changes affect existing data?">
    Most preference changes only affect new data created after the change. Some settings, such as calendar configurations, may affect how existing appointments are displayed.
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="How do I set up multiple providers?">
    Use the **Provider** section under Preferences to add each provider. Configure their credentials, schedules, and site assignments individually.
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="What is the Performance Analysis tab?">
    The Performance Analysis tab provides an overview of your practice's key performance indicators, including clinical outcomes and practice health metrics. Access it from the main navigation menu.
  </Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>
