## How to Apply an Air Scribe

> Source: https://docs.athelas.com/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/how_to_apply_an_air_scribe.md

# How to Apply an Air Scribe

> Preview an Air Scribe output, choose which sections to apply, and regenerate or rerecord a note.

The Scribe Application Page allows you to preview and select which generated outputs to apply to the patient chart note.

**Prerequisite:** Generate an Air Scribe for an appointment before you apply its output.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/KyhrvQLLT-eww2co/images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/how_to_apply_an_air_scribe/how_to_apply_an_air_scribe_1.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=KyhrvQLLT-eww2co&q=85&s=44108311f15717bd91595fefc089138c" alt="Air Scribe application page with generated note sections" width="658" height="1114" data-path="images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/how_to_apply_an_air_scribe/how_to_apply_an_air_scribe_1.png" />

Here’s a breakdown of this page:

* Clicking the Patient Name at the top will redirect you to the appointment details page for that patient. If you’re already on the appointment detail page, this link will not do anything.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/KyhrvQLLT-eww2co/images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/how_to_apply_an_air_scribe/how_to_apply_an_air_scribe_2.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=KyhrvQLLT-eww2co&q=85&s=d0046691cd977d69154a4a5ee106a6ac" alt="Patient name link at the top of the Air Scribe application page" width="1034" height="196" data-path="images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/how_to_apply_an_air_scribe/how_to_apply_an_air_scribe_2.png" />

* The tab menu allows you to easily scroll to a specific section that was generated by Air Scribe

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/KyhrvQLLT-eww2co/images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/how_to_apply_an_air_scribe/how_to_apply_an_air_scribe_3.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=KyhrvQLLT-eww2co&q=85&s=89cf409d555960bf74115e807e60c504" alt="Tab menu for navigating generated Air Scribe sections" width="796" height="132" data-path="images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/how_to_apply_an_air_scribe/how_to_apply_an_air_scribe_3.png" />

* Each section generated by Air Scribe has a checkbox that allows you to select whether or not to apply that section’s outputs to the patient chart note. For **Flowsheet**, **Services**, or **Treatments**, the initial selections follow the appointment type's **Is Checked for Scribe** setting. When this setting is on, all available service codes are selected. When it is off or not configured, no service codes are selected. Use the section checkbox to select or clear all service codes, and review every section before applying the Scribe.
  Most sections allow you preview their outputs, such as in the Daily SOAP Note example below. Most simple text outputs can be copied to clipboard using the “Copy” button.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/KyhrvQLLT-eww2co/images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/how_to_apply_an_air_scribe/how_to_apply_an_air_scribe_4.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=KyhrvQLLT-eww2co&q=85&s=0f84e03f3695809013c7235e21823e8c" alt="Generated Air Scribe section with an apply checkbox and output preview" width="1994" height="1322" data-path="images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/how_to_apply_an_air_scribe/how_to_apply_an_air_scribe_4.png" />

* After you have unchecked all the sections you do not want to apply, click “Apply Scribe” to apply all checked sections to the patient’s chart note. The application process should be quick, but it may take some time to refresh the page. If you notice it taking too long to refresh, you can manually refresh by clicking the refresh button in your web browser.

* Additional actions are available in the “More Actions” button menu:

* **Record Again** - Allows you to start a new recording for the same appointment. NOTE: The previous scribe will be lost when a new recording is uploaded for the same appointment.

* **Regenerate** - Allows you to regenerate the scribe using the same audio recording and the latest sections in the patient chart.

#### Re-Record a Scribe

If you would like record again for an appointment that already has a scribe, follow the steps below:

* When the widget opens, you should see the scribe outputs from the previous recording. At the bottom, click “More Actions”:

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/KyhrvQLLT-eww2co/images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/how_to_apply_an_air_scribe/how_to_apply_an_air_scribe_5.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=KyhrvQLLT-eww2co&q=85&s=99ad98ff6de59ca8197aef65e07d6875" alt="More Actions menu for a generated Air Scribe" width="728" height="1224" data-path="images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/how_to_apply_an_air_scribe/how_to_apply_an_air_scribe_5.png" />

* Click “Record Again” and can now start recording again

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/KyhrvQLLT-eww2co/images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/how_to_apply_an_air_scribe/how_to_apply_an_air_scribe_6.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=KyhrvQLLT-eww2co&q=85&s=7400dd8e3d89d0bc6542a8831839749c" alt="Record Again action for an Air Scribe" width="720" height="492" data-path="images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/how_to_apply_an_air_scribe/how_to_apply_an_air_scribe_6.png" />

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/KyhrvQLLT-eww2co/images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/how_to_apply_an_air_scribe/how_to_apply_an_air_scribe_7.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=KyhrvQLLT-eww2co&q=85&s=7ee139f5e5b27eee1264e47be1a0a571" alt="Air Scribe recording interface for the same appointment" width="748" height="948" data-path="images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/how_to_apply_an_air_scribe/how_to_apply_an_air_scribe_7.png" />

#### Regenerate a Scribe

If you add sections to a patient chart note after a recording is already uploaded, you will need to regenerate the scribe for those newly added sections. Regeneration is only available after the initial scribe for that appointment has been generated.

* Click the blue button in the bottom-right corner of the screen to show the new Air Scribe widget
* When the widget opens, you should see the scribe outputs from the previous recording. At the bottom, click “More Actions”:

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/KyhrvQLLT-eww2co/images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/how_to_apply_an_air_scribe/how_to_apply_an_air_scribe_8.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=KyhrvQLLT-eww2co&q=85&s=a3e43936a89c45c9b920abc27bbaaadf" alt="More Actions menu with the Regenerate option" width="766" height="1282" data-path="images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/how_to_apply_an_air_scribe/how_to_apply_an_air_scribe_8.png" />

* Click “Regenerate”

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/KyhrvQLLT-eww2co/images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/how_to_apply_an_air_scribe/how_to_apply_an_air_scribe_9.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=KyhrvQLLT-eww2co&q=85&s=ae3e6a32328a2577bf859ff596379a7b" alt="Regenerate action for an existing Air Scribe" width="570" height="328" data-path="images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/how_to_apply_an_air_scribe/how_to_apply_an_air_scribe_9.png" />

## Complete a Visit with Air Scribe

> Source: https://docs.athelas.com/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/complete_a_visit_with_air_scribe.md

# Complete a Visit with Air Scribe

Air Scribe is a powerful tool which will allow the conversation with your patient to be auto-populated into the encounter based on what was said.

Click the bottom right “Athelas AI” button - a window will open up with the option to “Start Recording”, click this to activate Air Scribe.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/KyhrvQLLT-eww2co/images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/complete_a_visit_with_air_scribe/complete_a_visit_with_air_scribe_1.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=KyhrvQLLT-eww2co&q=85&s=8b69ad67dedefe9d17267c2ba705a4b6" alt="" width="902" height="1196" data-path="images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/complete_a_visit_with_air_scribe/complete_a_visit_with_air_scribe_1.png" />

Record your conversation. While the Air Scribe widget is open, you can navigate to other Insights pages and continue to record in the background. However, you will not be able to navigate to pages outside of Insights unless you end/cancel the recording. You can click “Minimize” to minimize the widget. It will continue to record in the background while minimized.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/KyhrvQLLT-eww2co/images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/complete_a_visit_with_air_scribe/complete_a_visit_with_air_scribe_2.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=KyhrvQLLT-eww2co&q=85&s=f7ce20043fffd3b506f8be767aa09276" alt="" width="932" height="1050" data-path="images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/complete_a_visit_with_air_scribe/complete_a_visit_with_air_scribe_2.png" />

When you’re ready to upload the recording, click “End Recording”.

* After the recording is successfully uploaded, it will take some time for the backend to generate a scribe from your recording. At this point, you are free to wait for generating to finish, or close the window and do something else.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/KyhrvQLLT-eww2co/images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/complete_a_visit_with_air_scribe/complete_a_visit_with_air_scribe_3.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=KyhrvQLLT-eww2co&q=85&s=1cc48c1bd0b4606ba1153d46e904bf1e" alt="" width="1044" height="422" data-path="images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/complete_a_visit_with_air_scribe/complete_a_visit_with_air_scribe_3.png" />

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/KyhrvQLLT-eww2co/images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/complete_a_visit_with_air_scribe/complete_a_visit_with_air_scribe_4.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=KyhrvQLLT-eww2co&q=85&s=a4a9aabbf986c873870e737fde6adc9c" alt="" width="902" height="996" data-path="images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/complete_a_visit_with_air_scribe/complete_a_visit_with_air_scribe_4.png" />

Once generating completes, click “View Scribe” to view generated outputs.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/KyhrvQLLT-eww2co/images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/complete_a_visit_with_air_scribe/complete_a_visit_with_air_scribe_5.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=KyhrvQLLT-eww2co&q=85&s=1c7f52db35ec1b093e09a72e2563c319" alt="" width="744" height="861" data-path="images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/complete_a_visit_with_air_scribe/complete_a_visit_with_air_scribe_5.png" />

## Additional Context Feature

> Source: https://docs.athelas.com/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/additional_context_feature.md

# Additional Context Feature

#### Overview

The **Additional Context** feature allows healthcare providers to enhance AI-generated documentation by adding supplementary information to scribe notes.

You can provide context in two ways:

* **Audio Recording** – Capture additional conversation or dictate details
* **Text Input** – Type additional context or patient details
  Adding context helps improve the **accuracy and completeness** of documentation.

#### Accessing the Additional Context Feature

##### Location

The feature is available on the **Completed Scribe Page** after a scribe session is completed.

##### How to Use

* Navigate to a completed scribe session
* Click on the new **“Transcription & Context”** Tab
* Click **“Add Context”**
* The **Additional Context dialog** will open
* Add context via text or audio (*click the drop-downs below* **↓** for specific details on both methods)
* Click regenerate scribe after adding all relevant context

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/KyhrvQLLT-eww2co/images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/additional_context_feature/additional_context_feature_1.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=KyhrvQLLT-eww2co&q=85&s=fc089f8e6f5e3894e3bcd8f384cbb129" alt="" width="858" height="1247" data-path="images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/additional_context_feature/additional_context_feature_1.png" />

#### Using Audio Mode 🎙️

##### When to Use

Use audio when you want to:

* Capture additional patient conversation (such as a multi-part appointment)
* Capture lab or test results after the initial recording
* Longer additions
* Add context while multitasking

##### Steps to Use

* **Click the "Add Context" button**

* “By Audio” is selected by default

* **Start Recording**

* Click **“Record Audio”**

* Grant microphone permissions if prompted

* Recording begins immediately

* **End Recording**

* Click **“End Recording”**

* Audio uploads automatically

* Upload progress bar shows percentage

* **Completion**

* Success notification appears

* Dialog closes automatically

* Audio context begins processing

##### Recording Controls

* **End Recording** → Saves and uploads
* **Cancel & Discard** → Stops recording without saving

##### Tips For Audio Recording

* Record in a quiet environment
* Use a good quality microphone
* Check the mic level indicator
* Speak clearly and at a moderate pace

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/KyhrvQLLT-eww2co/images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/additional_context_feature/additional_context_feature_2.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=KyhrvQLLT-eww2co&q=85&s=f943ee7d7bdb2e9f2e8458ec5eba9909" alt="" width="798" height="780" data-path="images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/additional_context_feature/additional_context_feature_2.png" />

#### Using Text Mode 💬

##### When to Use

Use text input for:

* Specific patient details
* Structured or concise information
* Quick additions

##### Steps to Use

* **Click the "Add Context" button**

* **Switch to Text Mode**

* Click **“By Text”**

* **Enter Context**

* Type additional information (max 2,000 characters)

* **Submit Context**

* Click **“Add Context”**

* Context is added

* Dialog closes automatically

##### Tips For Text Input

* Be clear and concise
* Organize logically
* Include relevant terminology
* Use abbreviations when appropriate
* Monitor character counter

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/KyhrvQLLT-eww2co/images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/additional_context_feature/additional_context_feature_3.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=KyhrvQLLT-eww2co&q=85&s=cc21886e40311389b4727ee85f1e5fab" alt="" width="804" height="778" data-path="images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/additional_context_feature/additional_context_feature_3.png" />

#### Troubleshooting

##### Audio Recording Issues 🎙️

* **Problem:** "Failed to start recording"

**Solution:** Check browser microphone permissions

* Click the lock icon in your browser

* Allow microphone access

* Refresh the page and try again

* **Problem:** Low audio levels

**Solution:**

* Check microphone connection

* Adjust input settings

* Ensure correct microphone is selected

* **Problem:** Upload fails

**Solution:**

* Check your internet connection
* Retry recording
* Contact support if issue persists

##### Text Input Issues 💬

* **Problem:** "Add Context" button disabled

**Solution:**

* Type at least one character (not just spaces)

* **Problem:** Reached character limit

**Solution:**

* Remove unnecessary text
* Or submit current entry and start a new one

#### What Happens Next ⏭️

* Click **“Regenerate Scribe”**
* The AI processes a new scribe with your existing transcript along with your additional context
* Check the **“Scribe Notes”** tab to see your scribe progress
* Updated scribe appears with new context applied

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/KyhrvQLLT-eww2co/images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/additional_context_feature/additional_context_feature_4.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=KyhrvQLLT-eww2co&q=85&s=6affdec0dd52b3a9549d8cb92da6ea50" alt="" width="862" height="1262" data-path="images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/additional_context_feature/additional_context_feature_4.png" />

#### Multiple Context Entries 📚

* You can add multiple entries (audio or text)
* All added context is used during regeneration

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/KyhrvQLLT-eww2co/images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/additional_context_feature/additional_context_feature_5.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=KyhrvQLLT-eww2co&q=85&s=c73101a5ea3c4a0c630c0c9d7a26c53f" alt="" width="1944" height="1252" data-path="images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/additional_context_feature/additional_context_feature_5.png" />

#### Reminders❕

* **Be Specific** — Include precise missed details

* **Ensure Completeness** — Add all info before regenerating

* **Review Before Regenerating**

* **Prioritize Quality** — Relevant and accurate over length
  If issues persist:

* Contact your **system administrator**

* Submit a **support ticket**

* Report **bugs or feature requests** to the dev team

## Edit with Command+K

> Source: https://docs.athelas.com/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/edit_with_commandk.md

# Edit with Command+K

Command+K is a useful feature aimed at helping you quickly rewrite sections of the chart note.

You will be able to split sections into bullet points, summarize sections to make them more succinct, or change the tone of text (eg, narrative) through this quick toggle.

**Important:** Command+K only works in text sections of the chart note

##### Usage

To start, follow the steps below:

* Navigate to a patient chart note

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/KyhrvQLLT-eww2co/images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/edit_with_commandk/edit_with_commandk_1.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=KyhrvQLLT-eww2co&q=85&s=071e42bbeb85a6da531e07eba9e4f398" alt="" width="2562" height="1424" data-path="images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/edit_with_commandk/edit_with_commandk_1.png" />

* Highlight the **selection of text** that you wish to edit

* A black button will appear with the text “Cmd + K AI Edit”

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/KyhrvQLLT-eww2co/images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/edit_with_commandk/edit_with_commandk_2.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=KyhrvQLLT-eww2co&q=85&s=54f8b428884a9e4ce6c05e22dce007b7" alt="" width="2082" height="782" data-path="images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/edit_with_commandk/edit_with_commandk_2.png" />

* Use Command+K (keyboard) OR click the button that appears to toggle the Command+K modal

* This will open a modal from which you can type instructions for our AI to rephrase the selection of text

* We have also provided a list of quick options for the most common corrections

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/KyhrvQLLT-eww2co/images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/edit_with_commandk/edit_with_commandk_3.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=KyhrvQLLT-eww2co&q=85&s=fa94987dd40c2ea664a0464ad31215f7" alt="" width="2146" height="1284" data-path="images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/edit_with_commandk/edit_with_commandk_3.png" />

* Type your instructions

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/KyhrvQLLT-eww2co/images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/edit_with_commandk/edit_with_commandk_4.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=KyhrvQLLT-eww2co&q=85&s=7091ea378ce1363e4fb5e9573331c317" alt="" width="2134" height="1292" data-path="images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/edit_with_commandk/edit_with_commandk_4.png" />

* Press generate to generate the edits

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/KyhrvQLLT-eww2co/images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/edit_with_commandk/edit_with_commandk_5.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=KyhrvQLLT-eww2co&q=85&s=6b4a76d201b1091782cf5016face1a9e" alt="" width="2134" height="1292" data-path="images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/edit_with_commandk/edit_with_commandk_5.png" />

* The edits will appear for you to review

* The old text will appear in **red**

* The new text will appear in **green**

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/KyhrvQLLT-eww2co/images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/edit_with_commandk/edit_with_commandk_6.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=KyhrvQLLT-eww2co&q=85&s=c58ee90c9db32b8e8ce449bcfd0dc37b" alt="" width="2130" height="1330" data-path="images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/edit_with_commandk/edit_with_commandk_6.png" />

* Click **“apply edits”** to apply the edits

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/KyhrvQLLT-eww2co/images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/edit_with_commandk/edit_with_commandk_7.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=KyhrvQLLT-eww2co&q=85&s=472e79d883d2fa0f47fdf4d0745bb2c8" alt="" width="2130" height="1330" data-path="images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/edit_with_commandk/edit_with_commandk_7.png" />

* The edits will directly apply to the selection and you will see them immediately reflect in the chart note

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/KyhrvQLLT-eww2co/images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/edit_with_commandk/edit_with_commandk_8.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=KyhrvQLLT-eww2co&q=85&s=2352c0dfa30b49334696faf0d8128b7f" alt="" width="1382" height="226" data-path="images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/edit_with_commandk/edit_with_commandk_8.png" />

## How to Set up AI Compliance

> Source: https://docs.athelas.com/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/how_to_set_up_ai_compliance.md

# How to Set up AI Compliance

Compliance checkmarks are a feature within Insights that can be configured for any template. They are used to track specific details that should be captured within the chart note. If the detail is not captured, the compliance checkmark will be a grey color. If it is the icon will turn green. You have the ability to either type in this information or utilize scribe.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/KyhrvQLLT-eww2co/images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/how_to_set_up_ai_compliance/how_to_set_up_ai_compliance_1.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=KyhrvQLLT-eww2co&q=85&s=2365a68a1276c518ca6c538dba7d3fab" alt="" width="2128" height="1110" data-path="images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/how_to_set_up_ai_compliance/how_to_set_up_ai_compliance_1.png" />

#### How to Add Compliance Check Marks

Compliance check marks are created during the custom template creation process. For "Paragraph Answer" type template components, you're able to add the Question Trait, Prompt, and which notes types the compliance check mark will be applied to

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/KyhrvQLLT-eww2co/images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/how_to_set_up_ai_compliance/how_to_set_up_ai_compliance_2.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=KyhrvQLLT-eww2co&q=85&s=666563160968a2ede294462989f976ca" alt="" width="2414" height="1304" data-path="images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/how_to_set_up_ai_compliance/how_to_set_up_ai_compliance_2.png" />

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/KyhrvQLLT-eww2co/images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/how_to_set_up_ai_compliance/how_to_set_up_ai_compliance_3.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=KyhrvQLLT-eww2co&q=85&s=be5f9bb1c94f321e132d5143ebd112bc" alt="" width="1922" height="314" data-path="images/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/how_to_set_up_ai_compliance/how_to_set_up_ai_compliance_3.png" />

#### Check Mark Prompting Quick Tips

Compliance checks confirm whether required details are in your clinical note. Write each prompt so it can be answered **Yes (True)** or **No (False)**.

**Tips**

* Be specific: Name the exact info to look for.

* Good: "Does the note list blood pressure and heart rate?"

* Poor: "Did you record vitals?"

* **Use clinical language:** Match your documentation style.

* Good: "Is a follow-up plan documented in the Plan section?"

* **One item per prompt:** Split multiple checks into separate prompts.

* **Keep it yes/no:** Avoid open-ended questions.
  **Examples**

* "Is the patient’s chief complaint documented?"

* "Are range-of-motion measurements included?"

* "Is a diagnosis listed in the Assessment section?"

* "Are follow-up instructions included?"

# Getting Started with Chart Notes

The Chart Note is the essential workflow for a provider in Insights. This section covers its notable features and configuration options. At a high level, a Chart Note is made up of **Dynamic Templates** and **Sections** that let you set up a note to match your specific workflow.

## Fundamental components of a Chart Note

* **Plan of Care**
* **Measurements**
* **Goals**
* **Treatments**

## Setting up Chart Note preferences

When you open a Chart Note, you'll see a set of buttons for configuring its base setup.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/getting_started_with_chart_notes/getting_started_with_chart_notes_1.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX&q=85&s=61fd0e7c11b38e98755255c26a7e3af1" alt="Chart note with the setup buttons along the top" width="2490" height="1042" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/getting_started_with_chart_notes/getting_started_with_chart_notes_1.png" />

## AI Appointment Summaries

> Source: https://docs.athelas.com/insights_provider/chart_notes/ai_appt_summaries.md

# AI Appointment Summaries

Insights automatically generates an **AI Appointment Summary** at the top of each chart note section, so you can review a patient's history without opening every prior note.

## Where to find them

Open a patient's chart note. At the top of each section, you'll see a **Previous Appointment Summary** generated from the patient's earlier encounters.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/KyhrvQLLT-eww2co/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/ai_appt_summaries/ai_appt_summaries_1.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=KyhrvQLLT-eww2co&q=85&s=2c76d46ae4b67710ad99a4436486c808" alt="AI-generated Previous Appointment Summary at the top of a chart note section" width="2782" height="1010" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/ai_appt_summaries/ai_appt_summaries_1.png" />

## What they include

* A concise, section-specific recap drawn from **all previous patient encounters**.
* Context relevant to the current section, so each summary reflects what was documented before.

<Tip>
  ✨**Smart Tip:** Skim the summary before you start documenting so today's note builds on the patient's history.
</Tip>

## Auto-apply KX Modifier

> Source: https://docs.athelas.com/insights_provider/chart_notes/auto_apply_kx_modifier.md

# Auto-apply KX Modifier

#### Overview

The KX HCPCS modifier signals that “requirements specified in the medical policy have been met” and that services are medically necessary beyond a payer’s threshold (most commonly Medicare outpatient therapy thresholds for PT/OT/SLP). It attests that supporting documentation exists in the medical record. (Sources: [APTA](https://www.apta.org/your-practice/payment/medicare-payment/coding-billing/therapy-cap), [NGS Medicare](https://www.ngsmedicare.com/web/ngs/physical-therapy/occupational-therapy/speech-therapy?selectedArticleId=305496))

#### Why we need it

* Compliance: Medicare requires KX on claim lines once the beneficiary’s annual therapy threshold is exceeded (PT+SLP combined, and OT separately). Without KX, claims at/above the threshold can be denied.
* Payment continuity: KX allows medically necessary therapy to continue beyond the threshold, with the understanding those services may be subject to targeted medical review (generally over \$3,000).

#### Types of Thresholds for Medicare

**PT/SLP vs OT Medicare threshold remaining**

* PT/SLP and OT are tracked in two separate “buckets” each calendar year. For CY2026 the thresholds are (indexed annually to the Medicare Economic Index):

* PT + SLP combined: \$2,480

* OT: \$2,480

* Deductible and coinsurance count toward these amounts.

* “Threshold remaining” = threshold amount − total allowed therapy spend to date in that bucket (per calendar year)

#### CPT Codes that require a KX Modifier

**Physical & Occupational Therapy**

| CPT Code  | Description                                                                                  |
| --------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **97110** | Therapeutic exercise (per 15 min)                                                            |
| **97112** | Neuromuscular reeducation                                                                    |
| **97116** | Gait training therapy                                                                        |
| **97140** | Manual therapy techniques                                                                    |
| **97530** | Therapeutic activities                                                                       |
| **97535** | Self-care/home management training                                                           |
| **97542** | Wheelchair management training                                                               |
| **97750** | Physical performance test or measurement                                                     |
| **97760** | Orthotic fitting and training                                                                |
| **97761** | Prosthetic training                                                                          |
| **97763** | Orthotic/prosthetic management & training (follow-up)                                        |
| **97150** | Group therapeutic procedures (must document medical necessity individually for each patient) |
| **97597** | Selective debridement (when part of therapy plan)                                            |

**Speech-Language Pathology (SLP)**

| CPT Code  | Description                                         |
| --------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| **92507** | Treatment of speech, language, voice, communication |
| **92508** | Group speech therapy                                |
| **92526** | Treatment of swallowing dysfunction                 |
| **92609** | Therapeutic use of speech-generating device         |

**Common Occupational Therapy CPT Codes That Require the KX Modifier (when over threshold)**

| CPT Code  | Description                                       |
| --------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| **97110** | Therapeutic exercise                              |
| **97112** | Neuromuscular re-education                        |
| **97116** | Gait training therapy                             |
| **97150** | Group therapy                                     |
| **97140** | Manual therapy                                    |
| **97530** | Therapeutic activities (e.g., reaching, grasping) |
| **97535** | Self-care/home management training                |
| **97537** | Community/work reintegration training             |
| **97542** | Wheelchair management training                    |
| **97750** | Physical performance test                         |
| **97755** | Assistive technology assessment                   |
| **97760** | Orthotic training                                 |
| **97761** | Prosthetic training                               |
| **97763** | Orthotic/prosthetic follow-up                     |

#### When would be KX modifier auto-applied?

* Patient has Medicare benefits applicable to outpatient therapy for the encounter
* **Auto-apply KX modifier preference** is enabled
* Rendering provider’s discipline maps to PT/SLP or OT for Medicare service type
* The CPT code is in the qualifying therapy list for that service type (PT/SLP vs OT)
* The calculation year is the appointment’s calendar year
* The patient’s Medicare therapy threshold remaining for that service type is ≤ 0 (i.e., threshold exceeded)
* KX isn’t already on the line; it’s appended alongside other therapy modifiers (e.g., GP/GO/GN)
* If a precomputed “threshold remaining” value is supplied and indicates exceeded, it’s used

Setting PT/OT threshold on a per-patient level

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/auto_apply_kx_modifier/auto_apply_kx_modifier_26.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX&q=85&s=21fd47ee2e72b21417eca0605c31d52f" alt="" width="2111" height="692" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/auto_apply_kx_modifier/auto_apply_kx_modifier_26.png" />

#### Applying the KX modifier in the Flowsheet Intervention section

1. Go to an Appointment section of any selected Patient

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/auto_apply_kx_modifier/auto_apply_kx_modifier_28.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX&q=85&s=ac4f16bb588dc764e51d3a55b238642d" alt="" width="1255" height="477" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/auto_apply_kx_modifier/auto_apply_kx_modifier_28.png" />

2. You’ll notice that for Medicare thresholds, there are two types: the PT/SLP Medicare Threshold and the OT Medicare Threshold.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/auto_apply_kx_modifier/auto_apply_kx_modifier_29.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX&q=85&s=d44a214238cb2e56b592b5aa4d68c791" alt="" width="1267" height="285" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/auto_apply_kx_modifier/auto_apply_kx_modifier_29.png" />

3. Check if the remaining Medicare threshold (e.g., PT/SLP) is negative (i.e., the threshold has been crossed).

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/auto_apply_kx_modifier/auto_apply_kx_modifier_30.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX&q=85&s=21cc07347cdfd0b897927655a4e45c48" alt="" width="721" height="61" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/auto_apply_kx_modifier/auto_apply_kx_modifier_30.png" />

4. Scroll down to the Flowsheet section, where you can search for and choose a CPT code (i.e. “Search For Intervention”).

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/auto_apply_kx_modifier/auto_apply_kx_modifier_31.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX&q=85&s=83069264c219ea78dd91b44adb48769a" alt="" width="1896" height="1012" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/auto_apply_kx_modifier/auto_apply_kx_modifier_31.png" />

5. Select one of the interventions (e.g., Cervical Thrust Manipulation (HVLAT)).

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/auto_apply_kx_modifier/auto_apply_kx_modifier_32.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX&q=85&s=78f406a833e6c715c72b6f517cd7b985" alt="" width="1974" height="1066" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/auto_apply_kx_modifier/auto_apply_kx_modifier_32.png" />

6. Select one of the procedures (i.e., CPT codes) that is KX-modifier qualified (e.g., 97110)

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/auto_apply_kx_modifier/auto_apply_kx_modifier_33.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX&q=85&s=14b92fb96ff13867314cf5c48e2bfc3d" alt="" width="1914" height="1144" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/auto_apply_kx_modifier/auto_apply_kx_modifier_33.png" />

7. Now Mark it as Done

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/auto_apply_kx_modifier/auto_apply_kx_modifier_34.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX&q=85&s=6407cd29cbe4c0cbe87832466163e616" alt="" width="1874" height="970" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/auto_apply_kx_modifier/auto_apply_kx_modifier_34.png" />

8. The KX modifier will be applied automatically, and you can also see the tooltip.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/auto_apply_kx_modifier/auto_apply_kx_modifier_35.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX&q=85&s=01276cfc019b4e711428bcb4c6c15704" alt="" width="1971" height="686" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/auto_apply_kx_modifier/auto_apply_kx_modifier_35.png" />

---

## Download Chart Notes as PDFs

> Source: https://docs.athelas.com/insights_provider/chart_notes/download_chart_notes_as_pdfs.md

# Download Chart Notes as PDFs

Once a Chart Note has been completed, this will be visible within the *Appointments* Section of the Patient Demographic. A user can utilize the Status field to validate the stage of a given Chart Note.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/download_chart_notes_as_pdfs/download_chart_notes_as_pdfs_1.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX&q=85&s=f1c0b7b933b260cf94eae91a75d2e68e" alt="" width="2534" height="1568" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/download_chart_notes_as_pdfs/download_chart_notes_as_pdfs_1.png" />

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/download_chart_notes_as_pdfs/download_chart_notes_as_pdfs_2.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX&q=85&s=ebc175e21e8829d037261584c506f121" alt="" width="436" height="186" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/download_chart_notes_as_pdfs/download_chart_notes_as_pdfs_2.png" />

Once the Appointment is in a *Completed Status* you will have the ability to download the document. It will change from a gray eye icon to a black eye icon to indicate that you can. We offer both a **Medical Billing PDF and a Plan of Care PDF.**

After the user downloads the Chart Note they will be able to see the following document, depending on the selection.

#### Example of a Billing PDF

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/download_chart_notes_as_pdfs/download_chart_notes_as_pdfs_3.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX&q=85&s=861351c735743df98dd2d50683208e5c" alt="" width="1090" height="1414" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/download_chart_notes_as_pdfs/download_chart_notes_as_pdfs_3.png" />

#### Example of a Plan of Care PDF

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/download_chart_notes_as_pdfs/download_chart_notes_as_pdfs_4.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX&q=85&s=e75a22511fb2cd1b772e1016c279c423" alt="" width="1086" height="1406" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/download_chart_notes_as_pdfs/download_chart_notes_as_pdfs_4.png" />

Once you select the completed appointment, you can Fax PDF and select the PDF Type to Fax:

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/download_chart_notes_as_pdfs/download_chart_notes_as_pdfs_5.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX&q=85&s=90a463954fd06f4a220c40a6a16c6c9f" alt="" width="2434" height="1452" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/download_chart_notes_as_pdfs/download_chart_notes_as_pdfs_5.png" />

---

## How to add Measurements

> Source: https://docs.athelas.com/insights_provider/chart_notes/how_to_add_measurements.md

# How to add Measurements

To add new measurements to the chart note, click “Manage” in the Measurements section.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/how_to_add_measurements/how_to_add_measurements_1.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX&q=85&s=10f7ec6677670b9b19e3e5c60499f84a" alt="" width="2606" height="986" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/how_to_add_measurements/how_to_add_measurements_1.png" />

Measurements are divided into industry standard types (”Observation”, “Inspection”, etc) as well as groups. Custom groups and measurements can be added from the EHR Preferences page.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/how_to_add_measurements/how_to_add_measurements_2.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX&q=85&s=85ba63f2bcec5bf5b6f1e40a5006800f" alt="" width="2410" height="1524" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/how_to_add_measurements/how_to_add_measurements_2.png" />

Simply check the boxes for your selected measurements, and click Save to add them to your note.

## Import Previous Medical History

> Source: https://docs.athelas.com/insights_provider/chart_notes/import_previous_medical_history.md

# Import Previous Medical History

To Import a Medical Record to a given Appointment, you can navigate to the *Appointments* section within Insights, and select the “+” icon to “Set Up Chart Note” and upload an existing record:

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/import_previous_medical_history/import_previous_medical_history_1.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX&q=85&s=ddd2b45eb111f0dc1ad46638953de53e" alt="" width="2436" height="1408" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/import_previous_medical_history/import_previous_medical_history_1.png" />

Fill out the relevant sections to ensure that the given Medical Record aligns to the desired Case, Appointment Type and Clinical Note Type (Initial Eval, Progress Note, Daily Note, Discharge). Ensure that the correct PDF or RTF file is uploaded for import.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/import_previous_medical_history/import_previous_medical_history_2.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX&q=85&s=054e872281d8e0428c0cbd6fdffebe8b" alt="" width="794" height="104" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/import_previous_medical_history/import_previous_medical_history_2.png" />

> Enabling this feature allows a user to import a chart note that will not be marked as billable, this will be particularly useful if a user must manually add the Initial Evaluation and still continue the Plan of Care for a Progress Note or Re-Evaluation

Ultimately, this will populate the expected permutation of chart note + appointment type

You are also able to import an existing record through selecting “Athelas AI” at the bottom right corner of the page, and selecting “Import Existing Record"

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/import_previous_medical_history/import_previous_medical_history_3.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX&q=85&s=ffaff9453edfa3e95b1161644e67d1ad" alt="" width="624" height="850" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/import_previous_medical_history/import_previous_medical_history_3.png" />

You can also import a previous record through the chart note itself

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/import_previous_medical_history/import_previous_medical_history_4.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX&q=85&s=59911bfa15ef5bf71e99e85dc008f96d" alt="" width="1248" height="396" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/import_previous_medical_history/import_previous_medical_history_4.png" />

---

## Navigating Flowsheets

> Source: https://docs.athelas.com/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets.md

# Navigating Flowsheets

View the Flowsheets tab within your Chart notes: In order to add flowsheets as a feature onto a chart note, select it as one of the sections to add, “Select Sections”

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_1.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX&q=85&s=cf5f9a17a822e0277332b68da1054e1f" alt="" width="1210" height="600" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_1.png" />

Adding flowsheets to the chart note will remove treatments

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_2.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=2616d10e6845351794f28c4ddb917203" alt="" width="3024" height="1500" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_2.png" />

* Add an intervention - “+Add Interventions” through the Intervention manager in the nav bar, or within the chart note itself

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_3.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=55c6f2bbc8e618ecab62e1ae2946b2bf" alt="" width="3018" height="776" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_3.png" />

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_4.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=fbc00b13a7a5364abd9899d908a82983" alt="" width="1822" height="1262" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_4.png" />

Clicking the add interventions button will add all selected interventions to the flowsheet (currently in the order in which they were selected).

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_5.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=53297bfb3b9677e383411b94be9fea63" alt="" width="2392" height="862" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_5.png" />

* You can now select groups of interventions, reducing repetitive data entry

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_6.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=a1da6ecfba21d79ad20176ff526bef05" alt="" width="1900" height="1280" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_6.png" />

* When editing an Intervention, you can also auto-populate flowsheets with intervention details and exercise parameters

* Configure tying interventions to treatments, which means when interventions are added to the flowsheet, the configured treatment/CPT code will auto-populate as well

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_7.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=b2dadda259a133acf6fc5ef4ebb7fbb9" alt="" width="1936" height="1514" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_7.png" />

* Select a Procedure code in the Intervention drop down, and mark each intervention as done

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_8.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=6e980ba575ab12558290716928d89102" alt="" width="1924" height="976" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_8.png" />

* You must select a procedure code in order to mark an intervention as done, and the treatment time and units will auto populate

* You can configure your flowsheets by de-selecting “Auto-calculate Units” and/or “Auto-sum up Minutes” toggles to allow manual calculations- These toggles are default turned on

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_9.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=1d95462e7f9e9bd647e4c241f05c916f" alt="" width="2422" height="998" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_9.png" />

* You can also double click on an intervention in order to mark as “TO-DO”, and a green highlight will emerge

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_10.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=EOSU2-xYM7ToxOAX&q=85&s=810c1abbdd718aeaeceeed5c009238d9" alt="" width="2086" height="826" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_10.png" />

#### Adding Home Exercise Programs

By clicking the checkbox for an intervention marked as `HEP`, this will add this to a staging area where a Home Exercise Program can be prepared.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_11.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=2600b63f4d6a0f082cc0028144c8bb82" alt="" width="1796" height="784" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_11.png" />

Clicking the caret for HEP will open up the dropdown to assign any additional notes to the HEP section on a per intervention basis.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_12.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=b713943594adfffce0f93355c0b0a4f2" alt="" width="1970" height="710" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_12.png" />

You can “Preview and Send” to email, text and print the PDF

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_13.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=e37daee5129266b8bac05a4901fa8b02" alt="" width="2348" height="1450" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_13.png" />

#### Adding Evaluative Procedure

Often times, evaluative procedures may exist outside of being specified to a particular intervention. As such, we allow you to specify this from within the flowsheets feature and manage them independently.

Clicking Add Evaluative Procedure will bring up a modal where these CPT codes can be selected.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_14.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=596f991382ce2b65a9d1fc01543f49e8" alt="" width="1964" height="824" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_14.png" />

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_15.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=9652db17ea3a6f8a343c7197737590c6" alt="" width="1266" height="792" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_15.png" />

These evaluative procedures will be available in the blue header along with all procedures added from the interventions.

Evaluative procedures can be removed from here directly if needed.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_16.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=baef98d6f6179c7207f1000fc783916b" alt="" width="2636" height="668" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_16.png" />

#### Viewing Intervention Progress

Click on `Intervention Progress`in the Flowsheet section to view the stats from all previous interventions

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_17.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=71efdb938d53d0c500edeb371a0d8b81" alt="" width="1334" height="460" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_17.png" />

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_18.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=b8a55fb38056fcae45f358edff1dccc5" alt="" width="2526" height="918" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_18.png" />

If an intervention was performed for a specific visit, the background will be grey. The text inside the cells corresponds to the weight-sets-reps.

#### Viewing Intervention History

To view intervention history, click on the History icon on the Flowsheet section in the chart note

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_19.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=03e02884812defe5f5f004130f100558" alt="" width="1324" height="626" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_19.png" />

From there you can see a visit by visit history of interventions, including the weights, sets, repetitions and minutes

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_20.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=f0982a765d09b34e5557db4f96392bc1" alt="" width="2454" height="1058" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_20.png" />

You can select which Visit to view either through the Select dropdown, or by clicking the forward and back buttons

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_21.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=231704d742aaffd557bbea5f48084440" alt="" width="1254" height="1146" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_21.png" />

You can click on an intervention to select an intervention. You can select several interventions at once. To un-select an intervention, simply click it again

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_22.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=bfa84152161a4c841098a3eb7b2c613f" alt="" width="1080" height="1114" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_22.png" />

After selecting interventions you want to re-use the values from, click the Re-Use Selected Rows button, and that data will be pulled into the current visit

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_23.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=cda3c63dfcec19c59f3d0ea7516d5302" alt="" width="2632" height="1098" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_flowsheets/navigating_flowsheets_23.png" />

## Navigating Inbox Workflows

> Source: https://docs.athelas.com/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_inbox_workflows.md

# Navigating Inbox Workflows

The **Inbox** is your home for tracking which chart notes still need to be **signed and submitted**.

## How the Inbox is organized

Each row in the left navigation represents a note and shows the **patient name**, **date of service**, and **clinical note type**. Click a row to open that note on the right.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_inbox_workflows/navigating_inbox_workflows_1.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=d679d8563bc75e4fa8432a86ef5b921b" alt="Inbox list of notes with the selected note open on the right" width="1840" height="1072" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_inbox_workflows/navigating_inbox_workflows_1.png" />

## Working through your notes

1. **Select a note** from the left to open it.
2. **Review and complete** the note's sections.
3. **Sign and submit** the note when it's ready — it clears from your Inbox once submitted.

---

## Navigating the Chart Note

> Source: https://docs.athelas.com/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_the_chart_note.md

# Navigating the Chart Note

To view the chart note for a patient, you must first check in an appointment for the patient you’d like to conduct the appointment for. Navigate to Patients tab on the left navigation bar, select appointments, and select “Check in”

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_the_chart_note/navigating_the_chart_note_1.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=64bb0b00f553dd6e4d2fcf093dde982a" alt="" width="2480" height="808" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_the_chart_note/navigating_the_chart_note_1.png" />

Alternatively, you could take action in the Appointment Details section within the Calendar in the left navigation bar.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_the_chart_note/navigating_the_chart_note_2.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=7681ef15916c53fb4ca38a0b9184e9f4" alt="" width="1630" height="718" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_the_chart_note/navigating_the_chart_note_2.png" />

**Note:** *In order to check in an Appointment a Case must be present. This means that the user should add the relevant case to the Appointment so that a Chart Note can be created.*

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_the_chart_note/navigating_the_chart_note_3.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=3bc1f03e7797f70f5702846f63b3ba56" alt="" width="1728" height="1876" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_the_chart_note/navigating_the_chart_note_3.png" />

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_the_chart_note/navigating_the_chart_note_4.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=13412be095972fb4a4cec71e1814f4ec" alt="" width="594" height="118" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_the_chart_note/navigating_the_chart_note_4.png" />

If there is no given case, the user will receive an error when trying to check in.

**Required Fields for an Appointment :**

* Case
* Appointment Type
* Facility
* Insurance

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_the_chart_note/navigating_the_chart_note_5.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=6492630c551a9a2f150e1ca3190d8d09" alt="" width="1284" height="1870" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_the_chart_note/navigating_the_chart_note_5.png" />

**Case Set-Up:**

Upon the creation of an Appointment, a case will need to be present. If a user is creating a new case the **only required field** is the Case Name. However, since insurance is a required field within the Appointments page, we recommend that insurance priority is set if possible.

Once Checked-in, you can open the chart note via “View Note”

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_the_chart_note/navigating_the_chart_note_6.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=9e55067fd9cdcf4984222da5e61b84ce" alt="" width="946" height="1390" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_the_chart_note/navigating_the_chart_note_6.png" />

**Alternatively, you can navigate to the chart note via the patient’s profile:**

Click on “Patients” on the left hand menu and type in the patient’s name into the search bar.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_the_chart_note/navigating_the_chart_note_7.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=184b35f8674c0a2b8207a8de01d37eec" alt="" width="3840" height="1192" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_the_chart_note/navigating_the_chart_note_7.png" />

You’ll be automatically routed to the Appointments page of the patient’s profile.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_the_chart_note/navigating_the_chart_note_8.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=5dd48bce40651d9f04f2482fbc799f2a" alt="" width="3420" height="774" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_the_chart_note/navigating_the_chart_note_8.png" />

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_the_chart_note/navigating_the_chart_note_9.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=fde387f81389ab0111a706be2e245d36" alt="" width="680" height="144" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_the_chart_note/navigating_the_chart_note_9.png" />

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_the_chart_note/navigating_the_chart_note_10.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=628198dc3d6e1505725a2300148e0a02" alt="" width="650" height="142" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/navigating_the_chart_note/navigating_the_chart_note_10.png" />

If an appointment has yet to be checked in, the status will indicate that it is scheduled with a checkmark next to it. Clicking this checkmark will **check in** a patient.

If an appointment is checked in, the status will indicate as such. Clicking on the box icon with an arrow sticking out of the top right corner will **open up the chart note**.

## Set up Custom Chart Note Templates

> Source: https://docs.athelas.com/insights_provider/chart_notes/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates.md

# Set up Custom Chart Note Templates

To begin setting up custom templates, first locate the side navigation menu item titled "Utilities." Inside here, click on "Templates."

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates_1.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=5f2074e930810c2f784b0bac4a5c0363" alt="" width="3840" height="1482" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates_1.png" />

On this Templates page, you are able to search and filter for your different templates

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates_2.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=45290464557ba397193f26d43dd9683f" alt="" width="3840" height="1468" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates_2.png" />

To create a new template, click on “+Create New Template” on the top right corner.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates_3.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=422aef5124893afe6de05d5a0ab4e268" alt="" width="3840" height="636" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates_3.png" />

You’ll be navigated to a new page. This is how you will configure intake and chart note templates. At the top, you can title your template then drag and drop components from the left hand side to the right to add questions/sections into your template.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates_4.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=5fcbc7dba50866099524934bee2f26ad" alt="" width="3840" height="868" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates_4.png" />

Components are what you will be using to create your desired intake form. Drag and drop the components from the left to the right to add intake form fields. The different components available to you are:

**Single Choice:** Ask a question where only a single choice can be chosen as the answer. Click the + to make a new option.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates_5.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=55d7223d2f46c1aaff63b29810ca28fb" alt="" width="1992" height="644" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates_5.png" />

**Short Answer**: Ask a question where a short answer can be typed in, this is intended for short responses

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates_6.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=1b96b1b2c28e709bfbddc8f2f36a88e8" alt="" width="1978" height="450" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates_6.png" />

**Multiple Choice**: Ask a question where multiple options can be chosen as the answer. Click the + to make a new option.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates_7.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=a534f016827d13dc093c2113080d2ef4" alt="" width="1980" height="538" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates_7.png" />

**Paragraph Answer**: Ask a question where a paragraph answer can be typed in, this is intended for long responses

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates_8.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=c400da1fa28ba8b416d5220c45b15303" alt="" width="1992" height="680" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates_8.png" />

**Yes/No Question**: Ask a question where only yes or no can be chosen as the answer

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates_9.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=cd8c9008cd3950513858203f6ddd4626" alt="" width="1986" height="454" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates_9.png" />

**Number Answer**: Ask a question where only a number can be inputted as the answer

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates_10.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=99006e07b50b8e4c17ee7153eab36401" alt="" width="1978" height="450" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates_10.png" />

**Rating Question**: Ask a question where a rating from 1-5 is determined as the answer

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates_11.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=d9fafa41fb5264ae425c257243b28e98" alt="" width="1986" height="408" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates_11.png" />

**Table Answer**: Ask a question in a table format. Each line creates a new column, click the + button to create a new one

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates_12.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=5b056ece5e4c2e12cb448c301e1b1a1b" alt="" width="2002" height="620" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates_12.png" />

**Date Question**: Ask a question where only a date can be inputted as the answer

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates_13.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=3c4620c369ebeb60498d80da333984c4" alt="" width="1994" height="392" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates_13.png" />

**Text Box**: This component is not available for EHR templates and only for patient intake.

Once you’ve created your form, select the type of template you want it saved as and click on “Save”. You will create EHR chart note templates and patient intake forms based on what you save it as.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates_14.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=689bb4076096f133e235e8c4a6bc8e4b" alt="" width="3840" height="1082" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates/set_up_custom_chart_note_templates_14.png" />

You can also configure **compliance checkmarks** on **Paragraph Answer** components to automatically verify that required details are captured in the note — see [How to Set up AI Compliance](/insights_provider/ai_scribe_and_tooling/how_to_set_up_ai_compliance).

---

## Setting up Co-signers on Your Note

> Source: https://docs.athelas.com/insights_provider/chart_notes/setting_up_co_signers_on_your_note.md

# Setting up Co-signers on Your Note

If a note needs a **co-signature** from a referring provider, you can fax the encounter to them directly from the chart note.

## Add a co-signer

1. In the chart note, open the **co-signer** dropdown.
2. **Select the referring provider's name** from the list.
3. **Enter their fax number**.
4. Send the encounter to fax them the note for co-signature.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/setting_up_co_signers_on_your_note/setting_up_co_signers_on_your_note_1.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=0e826bef01b661b51721d63c9b6b814b" alt="Co-signer dropdown with a referring provider selected and a fax number entered" width="2104" height="440" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/setting_up_co_signers_on_your_note/setting_up_co_signers_on_your_note_1.png" />

---

## Sign a Chart Note

> Source: https://docs.athelas.com/insights_provider/chart_notes/sign_a_chart_note.md

# Sign a Chart Note

This section will compile all the compliance checkmarks within the chart note for a quick overview. If any of them are grey, the information was not captured within the chart note. This is also where the user can select co-signers under “Additional Providers” and for the rendering provider to sign as well.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/sign_a_chart_note/sign_a_chart_note_1.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=30v_Q4STuh8LLQSX&q=85&s=2e314c6bde1acf414377269d36ae8c63" alt="" width="2134" height="1134" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/sign_a_chart_note/sign_a_chart_note_1.png" />

Ensure the “Fax note to referring provider” checkbox is clicked. Optionally, you can include a section requesting signature if desired.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/sign_a_chart_note/sign_a_chart_note_2.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS&q=85&s=ff930012fbe7b517d7cc358e7fa5320b" alt="" width="662" height="212" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/sign_a_chart_note/sign_a_chart_note_2.png" />

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/sign_a_chart_note/sign_a_chart_note_3.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS&q=85&s=712627a5587f89e8c9a79df7b690ae42" alt="" width="717" height="228" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/sign_a_chart_note/sign_a_chart_note_3.png" />

To close the encounter and submit it as a claim, sign the note under “Notarize” and click “Submit”

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/sign_a_chart_note/sign_a_chart_note_4.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS&q=85&s=22034376287711b52971d1e49bc5495b" alt="" width="1930" height="74" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/sign_a_chart_note/sign_a_chart_note_4.png" />

To fax the completed chart note, click on “+Create Fax”. A side panel will open up where the faxing type can be selected.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/sign_a_chart_note/sign_a_chart_note_5.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS&q=85&s=25b24b39e3523c2462b1a76a27530f58" alt="" width="2160" height="138" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/sign_a_chart_note/sign_a_chart_note_5.png" />

**There are 3 faxing types currently available:**

* Provider
* Individual Fax Number
* Imaging Request.
  Each presents in a different way.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/sign_a_chart_note/sign_a_chart_note_6.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS&q=85&s=acdc489849e0fe9311042d98ecde5b78" alt="" width="1174" height="567" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/sign_a_chart_note/sign_a_chart_note_6.png" />

The provider fax has a dropdown selection of all referring providers within Insights. If the fax number is available for the provider, it will auto-populate.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/sign_a_chart_note/sign_a_chart_note_7.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS&q=85&s=54ff01dbbe2089f7802aab85db917500" alt="" width="1172" height="434" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/sign_a_chart_note/sign_a_chart_note_7.png" />

Individual fax number requires the user to know and input the fax number they’d like to send the completed chart note to.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/sign_a_chart_note/sign_a_chart_note_8.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS&q=85&s=e572767bfdc69d7fc71cea98eead72d3" alt="" width="1180" height="424" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/sign_a_chart_note/sign_a_chart_note_8.png" />

Imaging requests will fax out the chart note with an imaging request utilizing the details indicated within the section. This information includes:

* Diagnosis codes

* Procedure codes

* Rule Out Information

* Result Medium

* Attachments

* Chart Note

* Patient attachments

* Imaging facility

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS/images/insights_provider/chart_notes/sign_a_chart_note/sign_a_chart_note_9.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS&q=85&s=9be7a587fb0b97a2b7eef23f5853c738" alt="" width="1176" height="1234" data-path="images/insights_provider/chart_notes/sign_a_chart_note/sign_a_chart_note_9.png" />

When a note is signed and submitted, if the patient has future appointments scheduled- you will have the option of updating all future appointments with the chart note you just completed. Clicking *Next* will then ask if you’d like to review the appointment in RCM/ Billing. If you’d like to do so, simply click on *View Encounter Details* or *View Claim Details*. If not, click *Complete*.
