## Text Snippets For Your Note

> Source: https://docs.athelas.com/insights_provider/chart_notes/text_snippets_for_your_note.md

# Text Snippets For Your Note

*A quick-insert tool for boiler-plate phrases in chart notes.*

## What is it?

Text Snippets adds a lightweight "/" command palette to every text-entry field in the chart-note form.

Clinicians can drop pre-saved phrases (e.g., "Shoulder: full ROM") with a click or a single **Tab** — no more re-typing the same assessment dozens of times per day.

## Using snippets inside a note

| **Action**                          | **Result**                                             |
| :---------------------------------- | :----------------------------------------------------- |
| Type `/` at the end of any sentence | Palette opens under the cursor                         |
| Continue typing                     | Live-filter by **label / group** (`/hip`, `/exam:hip`) |
| **↑ / ↓**                           | Navigate results                                       |
| **Enter / Tab / Click**             | Insert highlighted snippet                             |
| **Esc**                             | Close palette (press twice if filtering by group)      |
| **Backspace** just after `/`        | Close palette                                          |
| Type **two spaces**                 | Quick close                                            |

**Example flow**

* Type `Hip /`
* Press **↓** to highlight *"Hip: tender to palpation"*
* Press **Tab** → the phrase is inserted, the caret moves to the end, and the palette closes

## Navigating the palette

**Search bar**

* Opens automatically after `/`
* Filters across **all labels and groups**
* Prefix with `group:` to filter (e.g., `/MSK:`)

**Group → snippet drill-down**

* Selecting a group tile shows only that group's snippets
* A chip in the header shows the active group; click **"×"** to clear

**Keyboard cheat-sheet**

| **Key**                           | **Palette open**                           | **Search bar focused**      |
| :-------------------------------- | :----------------------------------------- | :-------------------------- |
| `/`                               | Re-open palette                            | —                           |
| **↑ / ↓**                         | Cycle suggestions                          | Cycle suggestions           |
| **Enter / Tab**                   | Insert snippet / open group                | Insert / open               |
| **Esc**                           | Leave group → close search → close palette | Clear group → close palette |
| **⌫** (Backspace) right after `/` | —                                          | Close palette               |

## Managing snippets (Admin & power users)

1. Navigate to **Profile → Preferences → Text Snippets**.
2. Click **"Add Snippet"** or edit an existing one.
3. Fill in:
   * **Title** (required, no `:` or double-spaces)
   * **Group** (optional, same restrictions)
   * **Snippet text** (required)
4. Click **Save**.

**Note:** The drawer closes *only after* a successful save, and inline validation errors appear if any rules are broken. The *"Other"* group always displays last.

## Tips & best practices

* **Autosize inputs**: In *Minimal* design, single-line snippet fields auto-grow.
* **Clipboard helper**: The trailing clipboard icon copies read-only field values.
* **Mobile friendly**: The palette respects virtual keyboards.
* **Accessibility**: The "/" icon is skipped in tab order; keyboard users rely on the slash.

## Troubleshooting

| **Symptom**                                | **Likely cause**                            | **Fix**                                    |
| :----------------------------------------- | :------------------------------------------ | :----------------------------------------- |
| Typing `/` does nothing                    | Text Snippets not enabled for your practice | Contact your admin to enable Text Snippets |
| Palette shows "No items match"             | No snippets, or filter too narrow           | Add snippets or clear the search / group   |
| Validation error: "Title cannot contain …" | Forbidden character in title/group          | Edit the field                             |
| Palette closes unexpectedly                | Two spaces typed or `/` deleted             | Re-type `/`                                |

### FAQ

<Accordion title="Does it work in multiline fields?">
  Yes — the palette anchors under the textarea.
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="Can sites have different snippet sets?">
  Yes. The snippet list is scoped to the **site**.
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="Is any formatting inserted?">
  No — snippets are plain text plus a trailing space.
</Accordion>

## Designate Staff as Prescriber Agents

> Source: https://docs.athelas.com/insights_provider/medications/designate_staff_as_provider_agents.md

# Designate Staff as Prescriber Agents

#### Problem Statement

Providers can prescribe medications in Insights, but given their busy schedules, they often don’t have time to fill out multiple fields and submit prescriptions themselves. Instead, they rely on staff, typically MAs, to draft prescriptions for later review and sign-off, or to directly prescribe when the medications are not controlled.

#### Solution

Providers can designate staff members as **prescriber agents**, granting them the ability to **draft prescriptions for controlled medications** and **prescribe non-controlled medications** on their behalf. Providers can assign prescriber agents by facility and set permissions for whether they can only create draft prescriptions or also prescribe medications.

When a draft prescription is created, providers receive a task notification on the notification bell. Clicking the notification takes them to the **Tasks** page, where they can view the associated patient profile. From there, they can navigate to the patient’s profile page and review the draft prescriptions under the **Medications** section.

#### How it helps?

Providers save time by just signing off on medications instead of creating them. As part of MA’s day to day tasks, they create medications via this feature.

#### How to use this feature?

#### Prerequisite

* Provider should have the facilities they want to prescribe for: EHR > Preferences > Provider

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS/images/insights_provider/medications/designate_staff_as_provider_agents/designate_staff_as_provider_agents_1.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS&q=85&s=ea26d9ed4e6b21313c2aec8fd3ccd6c8" alt="" width="2595" height="1343" data-path="images/insights_provider/medications/designate_staff_as_provider_agents/designate_staff_as_provider_agents_1.png" />

* Provider should be nominated for the facilities they want to prescribe medications -EHR > Preferences > Medications > Provider Nominations

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS/images/insights_provider/medications/designate_staff_as_provider_agents/designate_staff_as_provider_agents_2.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS&q=85&s=59f09a7cecac36a7d2b480da114b16c7" alt="" width="2556" height="1322" data-path="images/insights_provider/medications/designate_staff_as_provider_agents/designate_staff_as_provider_agents_2.png" />

#### Step 1 - Add prescriber agents for the provider

Go to: EHR > Preferences > Medications > Prescriber Agents

Click on “Add Prescriber Agent”

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS/images/insights_provider/medications/designate_staff_as_provider_agents/designate_staff_as_provider_agents_3.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS&q=85&s=1de3e432a9b707e9ace6de2952d982b8" alt="" width="1650" height="999" data-path="images/insights_provider/medications/designate_staff_as_provider_agents/designate_staff_as_provider_agents_3.png" />

You will see yourself as the provider selected by default. This cannot be changed because prescriber agents should be set up by the provider/admin.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS/images/insights_provider/medications/designate_staff_as_provider_agents/designate_staff_as_provider_agents_4.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS&q=85&s=c17ee9abaf3135431dd674afb0053d7c" alt="" width="1670" height="1332" data-path="images/insights_provider/medications/designate_staff_as_provider_agents/designate_staff_as_provider_agents_4.png" />

Select agents, and add the facilities you want to allow the prescriber agent to create draft medications for. “Can Prescribe” allows the prescriber agent to prescribe uncontrolled substances directly.

If “Can prescribe” is checked, the prescriber agent can still be able to create draft, they will be able to choose to prescribe along with it.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS/images/insights_provider/medications/designate_staff_as_provider_agents/designate_staff_as_provider_agents_5.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS&q=85&s=ccaa0ca6eb191461b5e60d65e57bed6f" alt="" width="530" height="289" data-path="images/insights_provider/medications/designate_staff_as_provider_agents/designate_staff_as_provider_agents_5.png" />

Click submit after done. This creates the prescriber agents for the site and the facilities.

#### Step 2 - Create medications as prescriber agent

Prescriber Agent can go to the patient profile page, and select medications tab.

Create a medication order.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS/images/insights_provider/medications/designate_staff_as_provider_agents/designate_staff_as_provider_agents_6.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS&q=85&s=42e6de28208e4ee2595e5be3b181552a" alt="" width="2492" height="732" data-path="images/insights_provider/medications/designate_staff_as_provider_agents/designate_staff_as_provider_agents_6.png" />

When selecting an appointment, prescriber agent will only see appointments by facility for which they are appointed to be prescriber agent.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS/images/insights_provider/medications/designate_staff_as_provider_agents/designate_staff_as_provider_agents_7.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS&q=85&s=1788654fed01b1d39c83068fe11a2260" alt="" width="2950" height="1068" data-path="images/insights_provider/medications/designate_staff_as_provider_agents/designate_staff_as_provider_agents_7.png" />

On the medication form, they will be able to select either of the two options - “Prescribe as agent” or “save draft”. Save draft is the only option they can select if they are ineligible to prescribe for that facility, or if they are dealing with controlled medications.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS/images/insights_provider/medications/designate_staff_as_provider_agents/designate_staff_as_provider_agents_8.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS&q=85&s=1aafa0cb4b95c7f503beec4eab32dc7d" alt="" width="1502" height="1468" data-path="images/insights_provider/medications/designate_staff_as_provider_agents/designate_staff_as_provider_agents_8.png" />

On review, the medications which are marked as save as draft will show up as Draft

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS/images/insights_provider/medications/designate_staff_as_provider_agents/designate_staff_as_provider_agents_9.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS&q=85&s=5f8a0c0332796ea0e119f88ec4c050b7" alt="" width="1494" height="1702" data-path="images/insights_provider/medications/designate_staff_as_provider_agents/designate_staff_as_provider_agents_9.png" />

Once they submit the medications, the draft medications will appear on the medications table, and a confirmation toast will show the information of the medications created.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS/images/insights_provider/medications/designate_staff_as_provider_agents/designate_staff_as_provider_agents_10.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS&q=85&s=099a84242be9722cdb6f2fdaadd022ad" alt="" width="964" height="364" data-path="images/insights_provider/medications/designate_staff_as_provider_agents/designate_staff_as_provider_agents_10.png" />

A task will also be created for the provider, who can refer to it to sign off on the medications.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS/images/insights_provider/medications/designate_staff_as_provider_agents/designate_staff_as_provider_agents_11.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS&q=85&s=ff4b85ce627b1ce035dc329b36428e5e" alt="" width="794" height="290" data-path="images/insights_provider/medications/designate_staff_as_provider_agents/designate_staff_as_provider_agents_11.png" />

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS/images/insights_provider/medications/designate_staff_as_provider_agents/designate_staff_as_provider_agents_12.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS&q=85&s=d9860b3fdb77b11f39994e88c86a6bcf" alt="" width="670" height="626" data-path="images/insights_provider/medications/designate_staff_as_provider_agents/designate_staff_as_provider_agents_12.png" />

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS/images/insights_provider/medications/designate_staff_as_provider_agents/designate_staff_as_provider_agents_13.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS&q=85&s=91bfaca0d111878f34d75231292c8386" alt="" width="2214" height="574" data-path="images/insights_provider/medications/designate_staff_as_provider_agents/designate_staff_as_provider_agents_13.png" />

Prescriber agent can edit the draft medications, but they cannot prescribe draft medications once they have created the draft.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS/images/insights_provider/medications/designate_staff_as_provider_agents/designate_staff_as_provider_agents_14.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS&q=85&s=9118c832cf4c7ef41e9767b9dc013d99" alt="" width="2450" height="1542" data-path="images/insights_provider/medications/designate_staff_as_provider_agents/designate_staff_as_provider_agents_14.png" />

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS/images/insights_provider/medications/designate_staff_as_provider_agents/designate_staff_as_provider_agents_15.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS&q=85&s=be82a5a3278c854701391a244b987572" alt="" width="1534" height="1726" data-path="images/insights_provider/medications/designate_staff_as_provider_agents/designate_staff_as_provider_agents_15.png" />

#### Providers can also make changes to draft, but they cannot save drafts, they can only prescribe them directly.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS/images/insights_provider/medications/designate_staff_as_provider_agents/designate_staff_as_provider_agents_16.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS&q=85&s=c90132f7f5c6d8d0eb0c7507178661c4" alt="" width="1526" height="1718" data-path="images/insights_provider/medications/designate_staff_as_provider_agents/designate_staff_as_provider_agents_16.png" />

# Getting started with Patient Profile

Any patient’s profile can be accessed by clicking on Patients under the EHR section and typing in the name and selecting the patient.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS/images/insights_provider/patient_profiles/getting_started_with_patient_profile/getting_started_with_patient_profile_1.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS&q=85&s=1785cee3ec59791e2712ff0735b124b6" alt="" width="3686" height="1208" data-path="images/insights_provider/patient_profiles/getting_started_with_patient_profile/getting_started_with_patient_profile_1.png" />

Selecting the patient’s name will take you to the patient’s profile- specifically to the Appointments tab. Here, you will see several other options: Demographics, Attachments, Tasks, Medications, Allergies, Vitals, Immunizations, and Labs

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS/images/insights_provider/patient_profiles/getting_started_with_patient_profile/getting_started_with_patient_profile_2.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS&q=85&s=36fcac91b196af732d24425527a07e49" alt="" width="2388" height="592" data-path="images/insights_provider/patient_profiles/getting_started_with_patient_profile/getting_started_with_patient_profile_2.png" />

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS/images/insights_provider/patient_profiles/getting_started_with_patient_profile/getting_started_with_patient_profile_3.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS&q=85&s=c08adaa30c88d430be2212814b4a7ca0" alt="" width="1162" height="304" data-path="images/insights_provider/patient_profiles/getting_started_with_patient_profile/getting_started_with_patient_profile_3.png" />

You can access pinned “sticky” notes for storing quick-view notes on patients

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS/images/insights_provider/patient_profiles/getting_started_with_patient_profile/getting_started_with_patient_profile_4.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS&q=85&s=d8362e49e1a71692bf82aa09462dc5bf" alt="" width="2400" height="380" data-path="images/insights_provider/patient_profiles/getting_started_with_patient_profile/getting_started_with_patient_profile_4.png" />

Demographics are covered under the Patient Demographics tab. For attachments, see [Add attachments to Patient Profile](/insights_provider/patient_profiles/add_attachments_to_patient_profile).

## Labs

* Send and manage electronic lab orders via HealthGorilla ([100+ supported lab vendors](https://developer.healthgorilla.com/docs/list-of-connected-labs)) for consultation and in-place specimen collection
* Receive lab results via PDF in the patient profile
* Attach ask-at-order questions to lab orders
* Download PDFs of labs

## Prescribe Medications

> Source: https://docs.athelas.com/insights_provider/patient_profiles/prescribe_medications.md

# Prescribe Medications

#### Prescribing Medications - how to enable prescribing an uncontrolled substance for a provider:

You can prescribe and manage medications by brand or generic name, including both controlled and non-controlled substances, through SureScripts integration

Navigate to Preferences tab, select Medications and Nominate Provider in the top right. After clicking the "Nominate Provider" button select the provider and facility for which you want to nominate the provider.

This nomination is required because to prescribe an uncontrolled substance, you require a *SureScripts Prescription Identifier* (SPI) number.

Once these requirements are fulfilled, the provider can start prescribing uncontrolled substances.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS/images/insights_provider/patient_profiles/prescribe_medications/prescribe_medications_1.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS&q=85&s=137fdcafa2bb6fabfa72ed52f356150e" alt="" width="3366" height="1052" data-path="images/insights_provider/patient_profiles/prescribe_medications/prescribe_medications_1.png" />

“Create New” to Prescribe medication or log internal or historic records within the Medications tab of the Patient Profile. Logging internal or historic record would not send the order to the pharmacy

## View Patient's Appointments

> Source: https://docs.athelas.com/insights_provider/patient_profiles/view_patients_appointments.md

# View Patient's Appointments

The appointments tab is where you can see all upcoming and past appointments for the patient. You are also able to create new appointments here, though you are able to do so on any tab in the patient’s profile as well.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS/images/insights_provider/patient_profiles/view_patients_appointments/view_patients_appointments_1.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS&q=85&s=032cacf2586d21311b0fa0d7b7040281" alt="" width="2860" height="932" data-path="images/insights_provider/patient_profiles/view_patients_appointments/view_patients_appointments_1.png" />

This list of appointments can be easily filtered by clicking on the *Filters* icon which will open up a side panel with several options.

Selecting a date, or date range on the calendar will only show appointments for the date(s) selected. Additional filters include:

* Providers
* Cases
* Facilities
* Appointment Status
  You can combine different filters to find specific appointments that the patient has/ had.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS/images/insights_provider/patient_profiles/view_patients_appointments/view_patients_appointments_2.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS&q=85&s=ebb1dfbd30068d3babba507ebd178795" alt="" width="660" height="1354" data-path="images/insights_provider/patient_profiles/view_patients_appointments/view_patients_appointments_2.png" />

In the table, you’ll be able to view the different statuses of their appointments:

* **Cancelled**

* Clicking on the eye icon will show the cancellation reason

* **Confirmed**

* The patient has confirmed their appointment via their appointment reminder text/ email

* An Appointment can only be updated to Confirmed if “Confirmed” via completion of the patient’s intake form

* Front office staff are unable to “Confirm” an appointment for a patient

* **Checked** **In**

* Clicking on the box arrow icon will open up the chart note

* **Scheduled**

* Clicking on the checkmark will check in the patient for that appointment

* **Completed**

* Clicking on the box arrow icon will open up the completed chart note

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS/images/insights_provider/patient_profiles/view_patients_appointments/view_patients_appointments_3.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=TWUEY6TA5GfBBNTS&q=85&s=694880983046197c8ab64f8f9fac90c5" alt="" width="954" height="588" data-path="images/insights_provider/patient_profiles/view_patients_appointments/view_patients_appointments_3.png" />

To the left of the appointment date/time are 3 icons:

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/3lVinlZOrncYjwTY/images/insights_provider/patient_profiles/view_patients_appointments/view_patients_appointments_4.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=3lVinlZOrncYjwTY&q=85&s=cbb5737104cbe5d29a5b78f0308c7975" alt="" width="1714" height="988" data-path="images/insights_provider/patient_profiles/view_patients_appointments/view_patients_appointments_4.png" />

#### Faxing Through Appointments

You can easily bulk fax and download PDFs by clicking on the checkbox at the very top of the appointments table. All of the completed appointments will have a checkbox next to them. You’ll be able to uncheck any that you don’t want to download or simply check the boxes next to the appointments you’d like to download or fax.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/3lVinlZOrncYjwTY/images/insights_provider/patient_profiles/view_patients_appointments/view_patients_appointments_5.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=3lVinlZOrncYjwTY&q=85&s=0fced7193d6bc46f343af728975335ca" alt="" width="1010" height="890" data-path="images/insights_provider/patient_profiles/view_patients_appointments/view_patients_appointments_5.png" />

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/3lVinlZOrncYjwTY/images/insights_provider/patient_profiles/view_patients_appointments/view_patients_appointments_6.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=3lVinlZOrncYjwTY&q=85&s=17bc9102a990518c209e7ed694c2a9de" alt="" width="966" height="914" data-path="images/insights_provider/patient_profiles/view_patients_appointments/view_patients_appointments_6.png" />

#### Faxing through Chart Note

Providers can also Fax the chart note through the Chart note itself. Navigate to the "Fax" section of the Chart note. You can “+ Create Fax”, select the Faxing Type, and input required information:

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/air_athelas/3lVinlZOrncYjwTY/images/insights_provider/patient_profiles/view_patients_appointments/view_patients_appointments_7.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=3lVinlZOrncYjwTY&q=85&s=a1ea6e4835ff4004d5df833ae5224d97" alt="" width="1312" height="1494" data-path="images/insights_provider/patient_profiles/view_patients_appointments/view_patients_appointments_7.png" />
